title: Deep learning retinal vascular biomarker predicts preeclampsia in a multicenter prospective cohort
zh_title: 视网膜血管深度学习生物标志物预测子痫前期：多中心前瞻队列
summary: Retina-PE 多模态模型整合眼底照片、孕妇临床因素与平均动脉压，基于8616名孕妇的前瞻性多中心数据预测子痫前期，并做了外部验证。
key_points: 基于8616名孕妇的前瞻性多中心数据，回顾性建模
外部验证 AUC 约0.73–0.82，低于开发集
增益因任务而异，患者层面事件数较少
reason: 前瞻性多中心大样本并有外部验证，属重要档；眼科影像加分，但外部性能下降
abstract: Preeclampsia (PE) causes maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality, yet noninvasive screening remains limited. We developed Retina-PE, a multimodal deep learning model integrating retinal photographs, maternal clinical factors, and mean arterial pressure to predict subsequent PE. Prospectively collected multicenter data from 8616 pregnant individuals were used for retrospective model development and evaluation. Development-dataset image-level areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) were 0.853 and 0.708 for PE occurrence at 24–28 and 28–32 weeks, 0.871 and 0.791 for 1- and 4-week preterm PE, and 0.979 and 0.862 for 1- and 4-week early-onset PE. Corresponding external-validation-dataset AUCs were 0.728 and 0.815, 0.801 and 0.801, and 0.776 and 0.766. Incremental performance was task-specific. Patient-level analyses showed similar patterns but included few events in some tasks. These findings support prospective evaluation of retinal imaging for maternal risk stratification.
zh_abstract: 子痫前期（preeclampsia，PE）可导致孕产妇及围产期的发病和死亡，但无创筛查手段仍然有限。我们开发了 Retina-PE，这是一种多模态深度学习模型，整合视网膜照片、孕妇临床因素和平均动脉压，用于预测随后发生的 PE。研究使用前瞻性收集的、来自多中心的 8616 名孕妇数据，进行回顾性模型开发和评估。在开发数据集中，图像水平的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为：预测 24–28 周和 28–32 周发生 PE 分别为 0.853 和 0.708；预测 1 周和 4 周早产型 PE 分别为 0.871 和 0.791；预测 1 周和 4 周早发型 PE 分别为 0.979 和 0.862。外部验证数据集中的相应 AUC 分别为 0.728 和 0.815、0.801 和 0.801，以及 0.776 和 0.766。增量性能因任务而异。患者水平分析显示出相似的模式，但部分任务中的事件数较少。这些发现支持对视网膜成像用于孕产妇风险分层开展前瞻性评估。

title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery
zh_title: OpenScientist：面向临床与生物医学发现的开源智能体AI协作科学家
summary: Nature Medicine 发表开源智能体 OpenScientist，可依据科学家提出的问题生成有数据依据、可验证的分析，并经领域专家在五个生物医学案例中评估。
key_points: 五个案例由领域专家评估，分析数分钟完成
生成血浆蛋白组生存模型，在隐藏评估队列中预测生存
多发性骨髓瘤假设在外部队列中得到验证
reason: 同行评审、开源，含隐藏队列与外部队列验证；契合科学发现智能体偏好，但仅五个案例
abstract: Biomedical research is constrained by the time and domain expertise required to analyze increasingly large and complex datasets. Here we present OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist designed to address this gap by investigating scientist-defined queries and generating verifiable, data-grounded analyses. OpenScientist was evaluated by domain experts across five biomedical case studies, completing analyses in minutes that otherwise would take months of human time and expertise. It accurately quantified Alzheimer’s blood biomarker performance, generated a plasma proteomic survival model that predicted survival in a hidden-evaluation cohort, proposed a reproducible mechanism linking tau pathology to altered lysosomal acidification, generated multiple myeloma hypotheses validated in an external cohort with attenuated signal in randomized controls, and demonstrated concordance with an independent human analysis in a blinded, prespecified proteomic comparison. These results support the use of OpenScientist to assist biomedical data analysis in concert with human experts. To support research involving sensitive clinical datasets, OpenScientist can operate in a fully air-gapped environment using open-source models for inference. OpenScientist demonstrates that open, auditable, agentic AI can support real-world clinical research by researching the literature, generating hypotheses, executing analyses, and generating insights from complex datasets.
zh_abstract: 生物医学研究受限于分析日益庞大和复杂的数据集所需的时间和领域专业知识。在此，我们介绍 OpenScientist，这是一种开源的智能体（agentic）AI 协同科学家，旨在通过研究科学家定义的问题并生成可验证、以数据为依据的分析来弥补这一差距。领域专家在五个生物医学案例研究中对 OpenScientist 进行了评估，其在数分钟内完成了原本需要人类耗费数月时间和专业知识才能完成的分析。它准确量化了阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物的表现；生成了一个血浆蛋白质组生存模型，该模型在隐藏评估队列中可预测生存；提出了一种可重复的、将 tau 病理与溶酶体酸化改变相联系的机制；生成了多发性骨髓瘤假设，这些假设在外部队列中得到验证，而在随机对照中信号减弱；并且在一项盲法、预先设定的蛋白质组比较中，与独立的人工分析结果表现出一致性。这些结果支持将 OpenScientist 用于与人类专家协同辅助生物医学数据分析。为支持涉及敏感临床数据集的研究，OpenScientist 可在完全物理隔离（air-gapped）的环境中运行，并使用开源模型进行推理。OpenScientist 表明，开放、可审计的智能体 AI 能够通过检索文献、生成假设、执行分析以及从复杂数据集中产生见解，来支持真实世界的临床研究。

title: STBI: dataset of over 12000 brain CT scans for machine learning in traumatic brain injury
zh_title: STBI：含1.2万余例脑CT的创伤性脑损伤机器学习数据集
summary: 发布Shiraz-TBI数据集，含3602例患者、12,155次连续脑CT，附结构化标注、时间变量及部分多模态临床与功能结局。
key_points: 37.6万余张DICOM图像，另提供NIfTI格式
放射科医生标注出血亚型、中线移位等
1259例子集含临床、治疗及功能结局
reason: 大规模公开纵向影像数据集，附临床结局，属重要档
abstract: Publicly available traumatic brain injury (TBI) imaging datasets remain limited by the absence of longitudinal imaging, standardized annotations, and linked clinical outcomes. We developed and validated the Shiraz-TBI (STBI) dataset, a large-scale multimodal resource comprising 3602 patients, 12,155 serial non-contrast brain CT examinations, and 376,195 DICOM images, with all studies additionally available in NIfTI format. Radiologists generated structured annotations for intracranial hemorrhage subtypes, mass effect, midline shift, skull fractures, Marshall CT scores, and other imaging features, while temporal variables and time-to-surgery outcomes were derived. Internal validation by neurosurgeons demonstrated near-perfect inter-rater agreement (κ > 0.85 for most variables). A multimodal subset of 1259 patients includes demographic, clinical, laboratory, treatment, and functional outcome data. By integrating patient-level longitudinal chronologically ordered serial neuroimaging with standardized annotations, temporal information, and prognostic outcomes, STBI provides a publicly available, machine learning-ready resource for imaging analysis, disease progression modeling, prognostic prediction, and clinical decision support in TBI.
zh_abstract: 公开可用的创伤性脑损伤（TBI）影像数据集仍受限于缺乏纵向影像、标准化标注以及关联的临床结局。我们开发并验证了 Shiraz-TBI（STBI）数据集，这是一个大规模多模态资源，包含 3602 名患者、12,155 次连续非增强脑部 CT 检查和 376,195 幅 DICOM 图像，所有检查另提供 NIfTI 格式。放射科医生对颅内出血亚型、占位效应、中线移位、颅骨骨折、Marshall CT 评分及其他影像特征进行了结构化标注，同时衍生出时间变量和手术时间结局。神经外科医生进行的内部验证显示评分者间一致性近乎完美（大多数变量 κ > 0.85）。一个包含 1259 名患者的多模态子集纳入了人口统计学、临床、实验室、治疗及功能结局数据。通过将患者层面按时间顺序排列的纵向连续神经影像与标准化标注、时间信息和预后结局相整合，STBI 为 TBI 的影像分析、疾病进展建模、预后预测和临床决策支持提供了一个公开可用、适用于机器学习的资源。

title: Interpretable AI links routine clinical gout phenotypes to multi-omic signatures and divergent health trajectories
zh_title: 可解释AI将痛风常规表型与多组学特征及健康轨迹关联
summary: 基于UK Biobank、中国GoutRe注册和MIMIC-IV共21,235人，用六项常规检验无监督聚类出三个痛风亚型，并关联复发与死亡风险。
key_points: 三个队列共21,235名参与者，含外部评估
六项常规检验无监督聚类得三个亚型
C2复发风险更高，C3死亡率更高
reason: 多队列外部评估、样本较大，但为亚型发现，未见临床结局干预证据
abstract: Integrative frameworks that connect scalable clinical phenotypes with molecular mechanisms are needed to resolve disease heterogeneity. We developed and externally evaluated an interpretable gout clinical-subset framework using routine data from 21,235 participants across UK Biobank (UKB; n = 10,599), the multicentre Chinese GoutRe registry (n = 8617), and MIMIC-IV (n = 2019). Unsupervised learning on six prespecified routine laboratory variables identified three subsets: C1, a low-burden state with preserved reserve; C2, a urate-metabolic inflammatory state with the greatest recurrence liability and a greater cardiometabolic and hepatic comorbidity burden; and C3, a state characterized by systemic vulnerability and higher mortality. In UKB, death-competing recurrence analysis showed a higher recurrence incidence for C2 versus C1 (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR] 1.896, 95% CI 1.710–2.101), whereas C3 did not differ from C1 (sHR 0.994, 95% CI 0.887–1.112). A six-variable CRT model reconstructed the locked subset labels using nested 10-fold out-of-fold evaluation in UKB and external application without retraining in GoutRe and MIMIC-IV. One-versus-rest AUCs were 0.965/0.945/0.980 in UKB, 0.906/0.914/0.953 in GoutRe, and 0.912/0.898/0.962 in MIMIC-IV for C1/C2/C3, respectively. Genetic, proteomic, and metabolomic analyses supported distinct urate-inflammatory and systemic-vulnerability axes, although the C3 senescence-related genetic signal was nominal and requires replication. Routine laboratory data can identify gout clinical subsets with distinct molecular profiles and patterns of recurrence and mortality; whether these subsets can guide clinical management requires prospective evaluation.
zh_abstract: 需要能够将可规模化的临床表型与分子机制相联系的整合性框架，以解析疾病异质性。我们利用来自英国生物银行（UK Biobank，UKB；n = 10,599）、多中心中国 GoutRe 登记研究（n = 8617）和 MIMIC-IV（n = 2019）共 21,235 名参与者的常规数据，开发并在外部评估了一个可解释的痛风临床亚型框架。基于六个预先设定的常规实验室变量进行无监督学习，识别出三个亚型：C1，低负担状态，储备功能保留；C2，尿酸代谢-炎症状态，复发倾向最高，且心血管代谢及肝脏合并症负担更重；C3，以全身脆弱性和更高死亡率为特征的状态。在 UKB 中，考虑死亡竞争风险的复发分析显示，C2 相比 C1 的复发发生率更高（亚分布风险比 [sHR] 1.896，95% CI 1.710–2.101），而 C3 与 C1 无差异（sHR 0.994，95% CI 0.887–1.112）。一个包含六个变量的 CRT 模型在 UKB 中采用嵌套 10 折袋外评估重建了锁定的亚型标签，并在 GoutRe 和 MIMIC-IV 中不经重新训练进行外部应用。C1/C2/C3 的一对多 AUC 在 UKB 中分别为 0.965/0.945/0.980，在 GoutRe 中分别为 0.906/0.914/0.953，在 MIMIC-IV 中分别为 0.912/0.898/0.962。遗传学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学分析支持存在不同的尿酸-炎症轴和全身脆弱性轴，但 C3 与衰老相关的遗传信号仅为名义水平，尚需重复验证。常规实验室数据可以识别具有不同分子特征以及复发和死亡模式的痛风临床亚型；这些亚型能否指导临床管理仍需前瞻性评估。

title: Interpretable distance-resolved graph learning for cancer gene priority screening
zh_title: 可解释距离分辨图学习用于癌症基因优先级筛选
summary: 提出CGMap图学习框架，在生物分子网络中按距离分辨通道定位分散信号，筛选潜在癌症基因并提供可追溯的机制线索。
key_points: 距离分辨通道捕获多尺度拓扑信号
全局扩散模块量化通路背景下基因协同
泛癌设置下分析12,022个基因
reason: 新方法有可解释性，但摘要未见实验验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Systematic screening for cancer genes (CGs) is still a central goal in precision oncology, yet integrating sparse and spatially dispersed oncogenic signals to identify testable candidates remains challenging. Here we present CGMap, an interpretable graph-learning framework that uses a width-oriented parallel architecture to prioritize potential CGs from biomolecular networks and trace mechanistic cues. By constructing distance-resolved channels, CGMap localizes spatially dispersed CG signals across multiple topological scales while avoiding representation homogenization. A global diffusion module quantifies gene cooperativity along pathway contexts and yields traceable virtual interactions that map predictions to potential regulatory hypotheses, providing intrinsic interpretability for model decisions. Across multiple biomolecular networks in a pan-cancer setting, CGMap analysed 12,022 genes, consistently outperformed existing methods while remaining computationally efficient and prioritized 70 reliable candidates, including those previously unannotated in established databases. Importantly, the prioritized candidates were associated with the suppression of tumour-related phenotypes, including reduced cell proliferation, migration and invasion, along with a shift of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-related features toward a non-mesenchymal state, as supported by parallel loss-of-function assays across cancer and non-malignant cell lines.
zh_abstract: 系统性筛选癌症基因（CGs）仍是精准肿瘤学的核心目标，但整合稀疏且空间分散的致癌信号以识别可检验的候选基因仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出 CGMap，一种可解释的图学习框架，采用面向宽度的并行架构，从生物分子网络中对潜在癌症基因进行优先排序并追溯机制线索。通过构建距离解析通道，CGMap 在多个拓扑尺度上定位空间分散的癌症基因信号，同时避免表征同质化。全局扩散模块沿通路背景量化基因间的协同性，并产生可追溯的虚拟相互作用，将预测结果映射到潜在的调控假说，从而为模型决策提供内在可解释性。在泛癌设置下的多个生物分子网络中，CGMap 分析了 12,022 个基因，始终优于现有方法且计算效率较高，并优先筛选出 70 个可靠候选基因，其中包括在既有数据库中此前未被注释的基因。重要的是，经癌细胞系和非恶性细胞系的平行功能缺失实验支持，这些优先候选基因与肿瘤相关表型的抑制相关，包括细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭减少，同时上皮-间质转化（EMT）相关特征向非间质状态转变。

title: External validation of an artificial intelligence-based ECG algorithm for the early diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction: a prospective diagnostic cohort study.
source: PubMed · The Lancet regional health. Europe
zh_title: 基于AI的心电图算法早期诊断急性心梗的前瞻性外部验证
summary: AI-ECG模型（AiTiA MI）在两个欧洲前瞻性急诊队列中进行外部验证，并与BASEL评分、hs-cTnT、HEART评分及医生判断比较。
key_points: 模型基于韩国数据开发，在欧洲人群验证
两个前瞻性队列，AMI由中心裁定
与多种临床评分及肌钙蛋白直接对比
reason: 前瞻性多队列外部验证并与临床标准对照，属重要档
abstract: [The Lancet regional health. Europe] A novel artificial intelligence-based electrocardiogram (AI-ECG) model (AiTiA MI v2.00.00) for the early diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction (AMI) was developed using data from Korean patients. Its performance in a European population remains unknown. Patients presenting to the emergency department (ED) with suspected AMI were enrolled in two prospective European cohorts (APACE & APACE-Light; ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT00470587). The primary outcome was AMI, centrally adjudicated according to the fourth Universal Definition of MI. The AI-ECG model was applied to 12-lead ECGs recorded at ED presentation. Its diagnostic performance for AMI was directly compared to that of the BASEL score, high-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (hs-cTnT), the recalibrated HEART score (all at ED presentation), and integrated physician judgment at 90 min, with the last two only available in APACE. Predefined AI-ECG triage thresholds for early rule-out and rule-in of AMI were also evaluated. Among 12,630 patients with an available digital 12-lead ECG (5047 in APACE and 7583 in APACE-Light), adjudicated AMI was diagnosed in 19% (968/5047) and 18% (1386/7583) of patients, respectively. In patients with hs-cTnT at presentation (n = 5031 and n = 7565), the AI-ECG model showed good diagnostic performance for AMI with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.78 (95% CI: 0.77-0.80) and 0.84 (0.83-0.85) and an area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) of 0.56 (0.53-0.59) and 0.65 (0.62-0.67). Its discrimination was inferior to hs-cTnT (AUC 0.94 [0.93-0.95] and 0.93 [0.92-0.94]). The AI-ECG model provided some incremental diagnostic value when combined with hs-cTnT (AUC 0.95 [0.94-0.96] and 0.95 [0.94-0.95], p < 0.001). The predefined triage thresholds ruled out 14% (706/5031) and 19% (1437/7565) of patients, with a sensitivity for AMI of 97.6% (96.5-98.5) and 97.5% (96.6-98.3), respectively. AI-ECG showed high, but not very high, diagnostic accuracy for AMI. As a diagnosis of AMI is unlikely to be ruled out on ECG alone, combining AI-ECG with hs-cTnT may improve decision making in the ED, warranting prospective studies. zh_abstract: [The Lancet regional health. Europe] 一种用于急性心肌梗死（AMI）早期诊断的新型基于人工智能的心电图（AI-ECG）模型（AiTiA MI v2.00.00）利用韩国患者的数据开发而成。其在欧洲人群中的表现尚不清楚。因疑似 AMI 到急诊科（ED）就诊的患者被纳入两个欧洲前瞻性队列（APACE 和 APACE-Light；ClinicalTrials.gov 编号 NCT00470587）。主要结局为 AMI，依据第四版心肌梗死通用定义进行中心裁定。AI-ECG 模型应用于 ED 就诊时记录的 12 导联心电图。将其对 AMI 的诊断表现与 BASEL 评分、高敏心肌肌钙蛋白 T（hs-cTnT）、重新校准的 HEART 评分（均为 ED 就诊时）以及 90 分钟时的医生综合判断直接比较，后两者仅在 APACE 中可用。同时评估了预先设定的用于 AMI 早期排除和确诊的 AI-ECG 分诊阈值。在 12,630 例有可用数字 12 导联心电图的患者中（APACE 5047 例，APACE-Light 7583 例），经裁定诊断为 AMI 的比例分别为 19%（968/5047）和 18%（1386/7583）。在就诊时有 hs-cTnT 的患者中（n = 5031 和 n = 7565），AI-ECG 模型对 AMI 显示出良好的诊断表现，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）分别为 0.78（95% CI：0.77-0.80）和 0.84（0.83-0.85），精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）分别为 0.56（0.53-0.59）和 0.65（0.62-0.67）。其区分能力低于 hs-cTnT（AUC 分别为 0.94 [0.93-0.95] 和 0.93 [0.92-0.94]）。AI-ECG 模型与 hs-cTnT 联合时提供了一定的增量诊断价值（AUC 分别为 0.95 [0.94-0.96] 和 0.95 [0.94-0.95]，p < 0.001）。预先设定的分诊阈值分别排除了 14%（706/5031）和 19%（1437/7565）的患者，对 AMI 的敏感度分别为 97.6%（96.5-98.5）和 97.5%（96.6-98.3）。AI-ECG 对 AMI 显示出较高但不是非常高的诊断准确性。由于仅凭心电图不太可能排除 AMI 诊断，将 AI-ECG 与 hs-cTnT 联合可能改善 ED 的决策，值得开展前瞻性研究。资助方：瑞士国家科学基金会、瑞士心脏基金会、Innosuisse、巴塞尔大学医院、巴塞尔大学、Abbott、Beckman Coulter、Idorsia、LSI Medience Corporation、Roche、Ortho Clinical Diagnostics、Quidel、Siemens、SpinChip、Upstream 和 Singulex、韩国健康产业开发院（KHIDI）。

title: Dual chain-of-thought AI‑PDCA framework for clinical history taking and documentation

summary: 构建病例库与双思维链LLM支持的教师PDCA培训框架，评估AI评分与教师评估的一致性，并回顾分析135名本科医学生的教学数据。
key_points: 构建临床病例库与AI-PDCA培训框架
评估AI评分相对教师评估的可靠性

reason: 单校回顾性教育研究，样本小，增量档
abstract: Clinical history-taking and documentation are foundational competencies in undergraduate medical training, yet scalable and individualized training tools remain limited. Large language model (LLM)-based systems provide automated practice opportunities but often lack structured medical reasoning, closed-loop instructional design, and integration into formal curricula. As part of a curriculum reform initiative, we constructed a clinical case repository, developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated faculty Plan–Do–Check–Act (PDCA) training framework supported by dual chain-of-thought (CoT)-driven LLMs, and evaluated the reliability of AI-based scoring against faculty assessment. We then conducted a retrospective observational analysis of routinely collected educational performance data from 135 undergraduate medical students enrolled in one of three existing instructional configurations: traditional instruction, AI-assisted training, or AI + PDCA training. Educational outcomes were assessed using standardized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) assessments. The AI + PDCA configuration was associated with the highest OSCE performance in both history-taking and clinical documentation. Among the two AI-supported configurations, longitudinal mixed-effects modeling showed steeper learning trajectories in the AI + PDCA configuration than in the AI-assisted configuration. These findings suggest that integrating AI-derived learning analytics with faculty-guided instructional intervention may support a closed-loop educational model associated with favorable competency acquisition while maintaining human oversight. This framework offers a scalable approach for implementing trustworthy, competency-based AI-enhanced medical education in routine academic practice.
zh_abstract: 临床病史采集与文书记录是本科医学教育的基础能力，但可规模化且个体化的训练工具仍然有限。基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统可提供自动化练习机会，但往往缺乏结构化的医学推理、闭环教学设计，也未融入正式课程。作为课程改革举措的一部分，我们构建了临床病例库，开发了由双重思维链（CoT）驱动的LLM支持的、融合人工智能（AI）的教师“计划–执行–检查–处理”（PDCA）培训框架，并评估了基于AI的评分与教师评分相比的可靠性。随后，我们对135名本科医学生的常规收集的教育表现数据进行了回顾性观察分析，这些学生分别参加三种现有教学配置之一：传统教学、AI辅助训练或AI + PDCA训练。教育结果采用标准化客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）进行评估。AI + PDCA配置在病史采集和临床文书记录两方面的OSCE成绩均最高。在两种AI支持的配置中，纵向混合效应模型显示，AI + PDCA配置的学习轨迹比AI辅助配置更陡。这些结果提示，将AI衍生的学习分析与教师指导的教学干预相结合，可能支持一种闭环教育模式，该模式与良好的能力获得相关，同时保持人工监督。该框架为在日常教学实践中实施可信赖的、以能力为导向的AI增强型医学教育提供了一种可规模化的方法。

title: Image-guided and augmented reality-assisted robotic surgery.
zh_title: 影像引导与增强现实辅助机器人手术综述
summary: 综述近12-18个月泌尿外科机器人手术中3D模型、AR及AI辅助配准的证据，含一项AI驱动3D-AR引导前列腺切除的随机试验。
key_points: 一项随机试验显示AI 3D-AR引导降低总体切缘阳性率
部分肾切除中3D模型发展到灌注图与自动AI配准
关注证据向比较性与随机研究的推进及推广性
reason: 综述类上限6分；涉及RCT证据但为转述，属值得一看档
abstract: [Current opinion in urology] Image-guided and augmented-reality (AR)-assisted robotic surgery is moving from static preoperative visualization toward dynamic, automated navigation. This review summarizes evidence from the past 12-18 months on three-dimensional (3D) virtual models, AR, and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted registration in robotic urology, focusing on which applications have moved to comparative and randomized evidence, and on how far this rationale now generalizes beyond the centers that first described it. In radical prostatectomy, a randomized trial of AI-driven 3D-AR guidance vs. cognitive MRI guidance showed lower overall positive margins, less postoperative radiotherapy, and better 12-month continence. In partial nephrectomy, 3D models have progressed from anatomical planning to perfusion-mapped clamping and automated AI-based registration, with favorable outcomes across comparative, meta-analytic, and propensity-matched series, including in horseshoe kidneys and totally endophytic tumors. Independent European groups have reported automated registration, segmentation, and nephrometry tools, and small series have extended image guidance to kidney transplantation, vena cava thrombectomy, upper tract urothelial carcinoma, and testicular cancer surgery. Randomized evidence in prostatectomy, a maturing pathway in partial nephrectomy, and growing independent replication support an expanding but still procedure-limited role for image-guided robotic surgery. Standardized protocols, objective accuracy metrics, multicenter validation, and structured training remain necessary before wider adoption.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in urology] 图像引导和增强现实（AR）辅助的机器人手术正从静态术前可视化转向动态、自动化的导航。本综述总结了过去12至18个月内关于机器人泌尿外科中三维（3D）虚拟模型、AR和人工智能（AI）辅助配准的证据，重点关注哪些应用已进入对照和随机证据阶段，以及这一原理在多大程度上可推广到最初报道它的中心之外。在根治性前列腺切除术中，一项比较AI驱动的3D-AR引导与认知融合MRI引导的随机试验显示，总体切缘阳性率更低，术后放疗更少，12个月控尿情况更好。在肾部分切除术中，3D模型已从解剖规划发展到灌注图指导的阻断和基于AI的自动配准，在对照研究、荟萃分析和倾向匹配系列中均获得良好结局，包括马蹄肾和完全内生型肿瘤。欧洲的多个独立团队报道了自动配准、分割和肾脏评分（nephrometry）工具，小型系列研究还将图像引导扩展到肾移植、腔静脉取栓、上尿路尿路上皮癌和睾丸癌手术。前列腺切除术中的随机证据、肾部分切除术中日趋成熟的研究路径，以及不断增加的独立重复验证，支持图像引导机器人手术的作用正在扩大，但仍局限于特定术式。在更广泛应用之前，仍需要标准化方案、客观的准确性指标、多中心验证和结构化培训。

abstract: [Journal of medical systems] Clinical registries capture adverse events (AEs) in free-text fields that are rarely analyzed. We developed a reproducible large language model (LLM)-assisted workflow using 11,216 free-text entries from 18,069 patients in the German Stroke Registry; 9,146 informative entries were retained after filtering. Embedding-based clustering showed poor separation, whereas an LLM-guided taxonomy identified 89 leaf labels. On the model-assisted 1,000-entry development set used for model and prompt selection, GPT-5.4 reached F1 92.4% (95% confidence interval [CI] 91.4-93.4). On 300 held-out entries, weighted F1 against clinician consensus was 96.5% (94.6-98.1) for frozen GPT-5.4 labels and 90.5% (87.5-93.5) for locally run Qwen 3.5 27B. For AE concepts with a comparable structured field, free text documented 1,345 additional instances (+19.6% over 6,867 structured instances); it also documented 7,546 instances of AE concepts without a structured equivalent, most often pneumonia, urinary tract infection and delirium. Beyond baseline covariates and the structured AE count, integrated complication concepts increased the area under the curve for prediction of good functional outcome by 0.025 (95% CI 0.021-0.028) and for death by 0.018 (0.014-0.021); gains were minimal after including the discharge National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) score. On 1,979 public coronary-trial fragments from the Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov (AACT), the software ran end to end, demonstrating its technical applicability to a second clinical text corpus. In conclusion, this workflow enables structured analysis of clinical registry free text and complements structured adverse-event documentation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical systems] 临床登记系统在自由文本字段中记录了不良事件（AE），但这些内容很少被分析。我们利用德国卒中登记中18,069例患者的11,216条自由文本记录，开发了一种可重复的大语言模型（LLM）辅助工作流程；筛选后保留了9,146条有信息量的记录。基于嵌入的聚类分离效果较差，而LLM引导的分类体系识别出89个叶节点标签。在用于模型和提示词选择的、经模型辅助的1,000条开发集上，GPT-5.4的F1达到92.4%（95%置信区间[CI] 91.4-93.4）。在300条留出记录上，与临床医生共识相比，冻结的GPT-5.4标签的加权F1为96.5%（94.6-98.1），本地运行的Qwen 3.5 27B为90.5%（87.5-93.5）。对于存在可比结构化字段的AE概念，自由文本额外记录了1,345例（比6,867例结构化记录多19.6%）；它还记录了7,546例没有结构化对应项的AE概念，最常见的是肺炎、尿路感染和谵妄。在基线协变量和结构化AE计数之外，整合的并发症概念使预测良好功能结局的曲线下面积增加0.025（95% CI 0.021-0.028），预测死亡的曲线下面积增加0.018（0.014-0.021）；纳入出院时美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表（NIHSS）评分后，增益极小。在来自ClinicalTrials.gov汇总分析数据库（AACT）的1,979条公开冠状动脉试验文本片段上，该软件可端到端运行，证明其在第二个临床文本语料库上的技术适用性。总之，该工作流程可对临床登记的自由文本进行结构化分析，并对结构化不良事件记录形成补充。

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled clinical decision support: device regulation and decision influence.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

AI 输出难以在常规诊疗中核验

reason: 监管视角观点文章，受观点类上限约束
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled clinical decision support (CDS) challenges core assumptions of the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) recently updated CDS guidance, including the concepts of independent clinician review of outputs and manufacturer-intended use for exempting certain CDS tools from medical device regulation. We examine the FDA's January 2026 CDS guidance in the context of the evolving landscape of AI-enabled CDS tools, clinician interaction studies with AI-enabled CDS, and AI governance frameworks. Although the FDA's framework distinguishes non-device CDS from regulated software, AI-enabled CDS may synthesize and transform clinical information in ways that are difficult to verify during routine care, increasing clinician susceptibility to automation bias. Incorporating pragmatic triggers into existing governance frameworks can help identify scenarios with a heightened risk for clinical decision influence. Oversight calibrated to real-world clinical decision influence is needed to strengthen practical safety standards for AI-enabled CDS.

title: Machine learning for small-molecule antibiotics - discovery to pre-clinical optimization.
source: PubMed · Clinical microbiology and infection : the official publication of the European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases
zh_title: 小分子抗生素的机器学习：从发现到临床前优化
summary: 综述机器学习在小分子抗生素从发现到临床前优化中的应用，背景为抗菌素耐药危机和药物管线匮乏。

reason: 药物发现领域综述，受综述上限约束
abstract: [Clinical microbiology and infection : the official publication of the European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases] The rapid rise of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) poses a critical global health crisis, with 4.71 million associated deaths and 1.14 million attributable deaths in 2021. By 2050, these tolls are forecasted to rise to 8.22 million associated deaths and 1.91 million attributable deaths annually. Despite this growing burden, the antibacterial pipeline is alarmingly lean, with few candidates exhibiting truly novel mechanisms of action (MOA). This innovation gap is worsened by the lack of economic incentives for large pharmaceutical companies to develop new antibiotics, placing increasing pressure on academic laboratories and small biotechnology companies. Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising, albeit unproven, toolset to accelerate and reduce the cost of antibiotic discovery and development. To review a cross-section of ML methods and their applications across the preclinical antibiotic discovery and development pipeline. Google Scholar and PubMed were searched through June 2026, combining terms for machine learning, deep learning, and artificial intelligence with antibiotic discovery and development, virtual screening, generative molecular design, and ADMET prediction. Primary research articles were prioritized, with preprints from arXiv and bioRxiv included where no peer-reviewed version was available. Reference lists of retrieved articles and WHO antibacterial pipeline reports were also screened. ML approaches enable more efficient exploration of vast chemical spaces in silico, facilitating the discovery of structurally novel antibacterial compounds in phenotype- and target-based applications. Both discriminative and generative models have demonstrated success in discovering new scaffolds and in multi-property optimization tasks. In target-based discovery, ML-guided docking strategies have improved scalability relative to more computationally demanding physics-based methods. ML-guided methods can improve the efficiency, scalability, and success rate of antibiotic discovery and development programs. However, the implementation of these models will require high-quality training data and rigorous experimental validation prior to end-to-end integration.
zh_abstract: [Clinical microbiology and infection：欧洲临床微生物学和传染病学会官方出版物] 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）的迅速上升构成严峻的全球健康危机，2021年相关死亡人数为471万，归因死亡人数为114万。预计到2050年，这些数字将分别升至每年822万例相关死亡和191万例归因死亡。尽管负担日益加重，抗菌药物研发管线却极为贫乏，真正具有全新作用机制（MOA）的候选药物寥寥无几。由于大型制药公司缺乏研发新型抗生素的经济激励，这一创新缺口进一步扩大，使学术实验室和小型生物技术公司承受的压力日益增加。机器学习（ML）已成为一种有前景但尚未得到证实的工具集，可加速抗生素的发现与开发并降低成本。目的：综述各类ML方法及其在临床前抗生素发现与开发管线中的应用。检索了截至2026年6月的Google Scholar和PubMed，检索词结合了机器学习、深度学习和人工智能，以及抗生素发现与开发、虚拟筛选、生成式分子设计和ADMET预测。优先纳入原始研究文章；对于没有同行评审版本的，纳入arXiv和bioRxiv的预印本。同时筛查了所检索文章的参考文献列表以及WHO抗菌药物研发管线报告。ML方法能够在计算机上更高效地探索庞大的化学空间，有助于在基于表型和基于靶点的应用中发现结构新颖的抗菌化合物。判别式模型和生成式模型均已在发现新骨架及多属性优化任务中取得成功。在基于靶点的发现中，相较于计算要求更高的基于物理的方法，ML引导的对接策略提高了可扩展性。ML引导的方法可以提高抗生素发现与开发项目的效率、可扩展性和成功率。然而，在实现端到端整合之前，这些模型的应用需要高质量的训练数据和严格的实验验证。

title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
zh_title: Bonbon：分子相互作用基础模型的涌现生物学能力
summary: 预印本提出 Bonbon，基于约3.2万亿token的蛋白-配体序列配对训练，零样本展现功能、残基、化学键三级涌现能力，并可泛化到分布外复合物。
key_points: 仅用序列训练，无结构坐标与任务监督
零样本识别作用机制、结合位点（含变构）及共价/非共价
六种规模（42M至1.6B）的受控缩放实验
reason: 预印本，基础模型方法新颖、训练规模大，但摘要未见代码开放或外部实验验证
abstract: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.
zh_abstract: 在大规模无标注语料上训练的基础模型会产生涌现能力，即超出训练目标的任务。我们将这一范式扩展到多模态生物学，提出 Bonbon，一种用于分子相互作用的基础模型，在约 3.2 万亿个配对蛋白质-配体序列 token 上训练。Bonbon 在单一表示空间中展现出三种处于不同分辨率层级的零样本涌现能力：功能层面（作用机制）、残基层面（结合位点定位，包括正构/变构位点区分）以及化学键层面（共价与非共价结合）。这三种能力均可泛化到分布外复合物。Bonbon 仅在蛋白质-配体序列上训练，没有任何任务特异性监督，也没有结构坐标。我们在从 42M 到 1.6B 参数的六种模型规模上进行了受控的缩放实验；尽管预训练损失平滑下降，所评估的每种能力在最大规模上，其连续指标均出现陡然跃升。这表明仅凭基于损失的缩放定律不足以预测零样本涌现能力何时出现。这里报告的能力是在 1:2,000 的参数与 token 比例下训练后出现的，以适应配对生物相互作用数据的稀疏性。同样的冻结表示在结合与亲和力预测上达到最先进水平，速度比共折叠（co-folding）方法快五个数量级。在涵盖七个蛋白家族、九个疾病靶点的前瞻性湿实验验证中，Bonbon 对从头设计化合物的剂量-反应命中率达 61.5%，产生了此前未报道可抑制这些蛋白的结构新颖分子，其中包括针对分布外靶点的分子。

title: Who Benefits from Telemonitoring? Uplift Modelling of a Nationwide Home Blood Pressure Monitoring Programme
zh_title: 谁受益于远程监测？全国家庭血压监测项目的提升建模
summary: 基于新加坡PTEC-HT项目16,694例回顾性数据，估计项目对血压控制的平均效应，并用提升建模分析异质性获益。
key_points: 倾向评分匹配后血压控制率74%对69%
基线未控制者提升12个百分点（63%对50%）
进一步用uplift建模识别获益人群
reason: 全国项目较大样本，但为回顾性无外部验证，上限6
abstract: Home blood pressure (BP) telemonitoring programmes are being deployed at national scale, yet enrolment resources are finite and the benefit of telemonitoring is unlikely to be uniform across patients. We study the Primary Technology-Enhanced Care for Hypertension (PTEC-HT) programme, a nationwide telemonitoring programme for hypertensive patients in Singapore. Using retrospective data on 16,694 patients registered between August 2020 and May 2024, we first estimate the average treatment effect of the programme on 6-month BP control against a propensity-score-matched non-participant cohort, finding an absolute improvement of 5 percentage points in the rate of BP control (74% vs. 69%, $p = 3\times10^{-12}$), rising to 12 percentage points (63% vs. 50%, $p = 1\times10^{-15}$) among patients with uncontrolled BP at baseline. We then move beyond the average effect and apply uplift modelling to estimate individual treatment effects. Across five uplift learners evaluated with 5-fold cross-validation and Qini curves, an uplift random forest performed best on the full cohort and an S-learner on the uncontrolled-baseline subcohort, although performance bands overlapped across learners. On held-out patients, realised uplift was largest in the top predicted-uplift groups and declined across the ranking. These patients had higher baseline BP grade, more recent hypertension diagnosis and lower medication and diagnosis burden, a profile we offer as hypothesis-generating for targeted enrolment. A handcrafted rule built from these features was competitive with the learned models, outperforming all of them on the uncontrolled-baseline cohort, suggesting that uplift models are useful for discovering heterogeneity that can be distilled into simple enrolment criteria for directing limited care team capacity.
zh_abstract: 家庭血压（BP）远程监测项目正在全国范围内推广，但入组资源有限，且远程监测的获益不太可能在所有患者中一致。我们研究了新加坡面向高血压患者的全国性远程监测项目——初级技术增强型高血压护理（PTEC-HT）项目。利用2020年8月至2024年5月登记的16,694例患者的回顾性数据，我们首先以倾向评分匹配的非参与者队列为对照，估计该项目对6个月血压控制的平均处理效应，发现血压控制率绝对提高5个百分点（74%对69%，$p = 3\times10^{-12}$），在基线血压未控制的患者中升至12个百分点（63%对50%，$p = 1\times10^{-15}$）。随后我们超越平均效应，应用提升建模（uplift modelling）估计个体处理效应。在采用5折交叉验证和Qini曲线评估的五种提升学习器中，提升随机森林在全队列中表现最佳，S-learner在基线未控制亚队列中表现最佳，但各学习器的性能区间存在重叠。在留出患者中，实际提升在预测提升最高的组中最大，并沿排序递减。这些患者的基线血压分级更高、高血压诊断时间更近，且用药和诊断负担更低，该特征可作为针对性入组的假设生成性依据。基于这些特征构建的手工规则与学习模型相比具有竞争力，在基线未控制队列中优于所有学习模型，提示提升模型有助于发现异质性，并可将其提炼为简单的入组标准，以引导有限的护理团队能力。

title: Viro-BERT: Whole-Genome Attention for Robust Viral Pathogen Classification from Next-Generation Sequencing Data.
zh_title: Viro-BERT：全基因组注意力的病毒病原体分类
summary: 提出将完整病毒基因组切分为重叠512 token窗口、共享DistilBERT编码并后期融合平均概率的分类方法，以解决固定窗口截断问题。
key_points: 针对猴痘、HSV-1等大DNA病毒的截断盲区
窗口独立处理，显存不随基因组长度增长
