reason: 新方法有基线对比，但摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Virus research] Classifying viral pathogens from next-generation sequencing (NGS) data is central to diagnosis and genomic surveillance. Most deep learning classifiers, however, read only a fixed window at the start of each genome, typically a few hundred to a few thousand base pairs, and so ignore more than 95% of the sequence of large DNA viruses such as monkeypox virus (MPV) and herpes simplex virus 1 (HSV-1). We refer to this problem as Truncation Blindness. Here we present Viro-BERT, which splits a complete genome into overlapping 512-token windows, encodes each window with a shared DistilBERT encoder, and averages the window-level class probabilities in a Late Fusion Consensus layer. Because the windows are processed independently, memory use does not grow with genome length. We compared Viro-BERT with one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN), bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) and RoBERTa baselines on 14 viral classes, using the same segmentation and training protocol for all models. Viro-BERT reached 96.79% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.17%. We then added random substitution noise to the test genomes. At 5% noise, the accuracy of the 1D-CNN fell by 5.57 percentage points, whereas Viro-BERT still classified 93.68% of genomes correctly. Positional and attention analyses on HSV-1 showed that Viro-BERT uses diagnostic signal from across the genome rather than from its 5' end alone. These results indicate that whole-genome context is needed for viral classifiers that remain reliable on noisy clinical data.
zh_abstract: [病毒研究] 基于新一代测序（NGS）数据对病毒病原体进行分类，是诊断和基因组监测的核心。然而，大多数深度学习分类器只读取每个基因组起始处的固定窗口（通常为几百至几千个碱基对），因此忽略了猴痘病毒（MPV）和单纯疱疹病毒1型（HSV-1）等大型DNA病毒超过95%的序列。我们将这一问题称为“截断盲区”（Truncation Blindness）。在此，我们提出 Viro-BERT：它将完整基因组切分为相互重叠的512个token窗口，用共享的 DistilBERT 编码器对每个窗口编码，并在“后期融合共识”（Late Fusion Consensus）层中对各窗口级别的类别概率取平均。由于各窗口独立处理，内存使用不随基因组长度增长。我们在14个病毒类别上，将 Viro-BERT 与一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）、双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）和 RoBERTa 基线模型进行比较，所有模型均采用相同的切分方式和训练方案。Viro-BERT 的准确率达到96.79%，宏平均F1分数为96.17%。随后，我们向测试基因组中加入随机替换噪声。在5%噪声下，1D-CNN 的准确率下降了5.57个百分点，而 Viro-BERT 仍能正确分类93.68%的基因组。对 HSV-1 的位置分析和注意力分析表明，Viro-BERT 利用的是来自整个基因组的诊断信号，而非仅来自其5'端。这些结果表明，要使病毒分类器在含噪声的临床数据上保持可靠，需要利用全基因组上下文。

title: BioLM-Score: Language-Prior Conditioned Probabilistic Geometric Potentials for Protein-Ligand Scoring.
zh_title: BioLM-Score：语言先验条件的蛋白-配体打分
summary: 将冻结的蛋白与分子语言模型嵌入融入残基-原子距离似然框架，在DEKOIS 2.0筛选终点上优于匹配几何基线，但亲和力打分与排序未一致提升。
key_points: 结合预训练生物分子语言模型嵌入与门控图卷积
DEKOIS 2.0三个筛选终点均优于几何基线
亲和力打分与排序提升不一致
reason: 同行评审的药物发现方法，有对照但提升不均
abstract: [Bioinformatics (Oxford, England)] Protein-ligand scoring must address affinity prediction, pose selection, and virtual screening, but these objectives are not necessarily optimized together. Geometric likelihood models may generalize poorly when training-set structural coverage is limited. We test whether pretrained biomolecular representations improve scoring under a controlled geometric baseline. BioLM-Score integrates frozen protein and molecular language-model embeddings into a residue-atom distance-likelihood framework via gated graph convolutions. We evaluate geometry-only, jointly trained, and two-stage fine-tuned variants, using the jointly trained variant for the primary controlled comparisons. All three DEKOIS 2.0 screening endpoints improve over the matched geometric baseline with target-level paired support, but affinity scoring and ranking do not improve uniformly. Under a time-split protocol, scoring is significantly lower and ranking is also lower than the geometric baseline, while screening gains persist. On BDB2020+, the difference in affinity correlation between BioLM-Score and GenScore narrows after LP-PDBBind-compatible retraining. Shuffling protein embeddings at inference reduces the screening advantage. However, retrained shuffle controls recover much of the performance, so correct alignment is not established as necessary. BioLM-Score strengthens geometric scoring on screening tasks without retraining the language models. Code, dataset-split identifiers, preprocessing and evaluation scripts, and language-model embedding-generation utilities are available at https://github.com/SZU-ADDG/BioLM-Score. An archival code snapshot and pretrained model weights are available at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21878818. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
zh_abstract: [Bioinformatics (Oxford, England)] 蛋白质-配体打分必须同时处理亲和力预测、结合构象（pose）选择和虚拟筛选，但这些目标不一定能被共同优化。当训练集的结构覆盖有限时，几何似然模型的泛化能力可能较差。我们检验在受控的几何基线下，预训练生物分子表示是否能改进打分。BioLM-Score 通过门控图卷积，将冻结的蛋白质和分子语言模型嵌入整合到残基-原子距离似然框架中。我们评估了仅几何、联合训练和两阶段微调三种变体，并使用联合训练变体进行主要的受控比较。在 DEKOIS 2.0 的全部三个筛选终点上，相较于匹配的几何基线均有改进，并获得靶标层面的配对支持，但亲和力打分和排序并未一致改善。在时间划分方案下，打分显著较低，排序也低于几何基线，而筛选方面的增益依然存在。在 BDB2020+ 上，经与 LP-PDBBind 兼容的重新训练后，BioLM-Score 与 GenScore 在亲和力相关性上的差异缩小。在推理时打乱蛋白质嵌入会降低筛选优势。然而，重新训练的打乱对照恢复了大部分性能，因此尚不能确定正确对齐是必要的。BioLM-Score 在不重新训练语言模型的情况下增强了几何打分在筛选任务上的表现。代码、数据集划分标识符、预处理和评估脚本以及语言模型嵌入生成工具可在 https://github.com/SZU-ADDG/BioLM-Score 获取。归档代码快照和预训练模型权重可在 doi:10.5281/zenodo.21878818 获取。补充数据可在 Bioinformatics 在线获取。

title: Clinician Assessment of Laryngeal Disease with Auditory AI before Laryngoscopy: A Paired Reader Study
zh_title: 喉镜检查前听觉 AI 辅助喉部疾病评估：配对读者研究
summary: 开发听觉大语言模型，基于嗓音生成评估卡片和恶性提示；32 名耳鼻喉科医生在 800 次配对评估中，使用评估卡片后准确率由 49.8% 升至 56.8%。
key_points: 听觉 LLM 输出类别、嗓音评分与依据
32 名医生配对读者研究，800 次评估
reason: 人机对照读者研究，但单中心预印本
abstract: Background: Before laryngoscopy, clinicians assess the likely cause of hoarseness and whether to suspect a precancerous or malignant lesion. Whether voice-based artificial intelligence (AI) supports pre-laryngoscopic categorization is unknown. Methods: We developed an auditory large language model that generates a patient-level assessment card (provisional category, voice-quality ratings, and rationale) and a prespecified malignancy alert from voice recordings, patient information, and acoustic measures obtained before laryngoscopy at one center. We evaluated both in a held-out test set and a later cohort. In a sequential reader study, 32 otolaryngology clinicians categorized held-out cases without AI and, 1 to 2 weeks later, reviewed their initial categories with the card (without the alert). Results: Across 800 paired assessments, reader accuracy was 49.8% before and 56.8% after review (difference, 7.0 percentage points; 95% CI, 1.7 to 13.5; P < 0.001); 99 categories changed from incorrect to correct and 43 from correct to incorrect (ratio, 2.30; 95% CI, 1.22 to 5.31). Accuracy rose 14.7 points when the model was correct and fell 8.7 when incorrect. Provisional-category accuracy was 72% in held-out testing and 67% in temporal validation. The malignancy alert flagged 85.7% and 86.8% of precancerous or malignant lesions. Sensitivity for precancerous or malignant lesions increased from 53.9% to 75.0% after AI-assisted review (difference, 21.1 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.3 to 42.0). Conclusions: In this single-center study, clinicians' pre-laryngoscopic categorization accuracy was higher after reviewing the AI assessment card, although the sequential design cannot fully separate AI assistance from reassessment; gains depended on model correctness without clearly selective adoption. Randomized and external evaluations, including of the malignancy alert, are needed.
zh_abstract: 【背景】在喉镜检查前，临床医生会评估声音嘶哑的可能原因，以及是否应怀疑癌前或恶性病变。基于嗓音的人工智能（AI）能否支持喉镜检查前的分类尚不清楚。【方法】我们开发了一种听觉大语言模型，可根据在一个中心于喉镜检查前获得的嗓音录音、患者信息和声学测量指标，生成患者层面的评估卡（初步类别、嗓音质量评分及依据）和预先设定的恶性肿瘤警示。我们在留出的测试集和后续队列中对二者进行了评估。在一项序贯读者研究中，32名耳鼻喉科临床医生在无AI辅助的情况下对留出病例进行分类，并在1至2周后结合评估卡（不含警示）复核其最初的分类。【结果】在800次配对评估中，读者准确率在复核前为49.8%，复核后为56.8%（差值7.0个百分点；95% CI，1.7至13.5；P < 0.001）；99个分类由错误变为正确，43个由正确变为错误（比值2.30；95% CI，1.22至5.31）。当模型正确时，准确率上升14.7个百分点；当模型错误时，准确率下降8.7个百分点。初步类别的准确率在留出测试中为72%，在时间验证中为67%。恶性肿瘤警示分别识别出85.7%和86.8%的癌前或恶性病变。AI辅助复核后，对癌前或恶性病变的敏感度由53.9%升至75.0%（差值21.1个百分点；95% CI，4.3至42.0）。【结论】在这项单中心研究中，临床医生在查看AI评估卡后，其喉镜检查前分类的准确率更高，但序贯设计无法完全区分AI辅助与重新评估的作用；准确率的提高取决于模型是否正确，且未见明确的选择性采纳。需要开展随机化和外部评估，包括对恶性肿瘤警示的评估。

title: HEmIF-Bench: Benchmarking H&E-to-mIF Models BeyondVirtual-StainFidelity
zh_title: HEmIF-Bench：超越虚拟染色保真度的 H&E 到 mIF 模型基准
summary: 构建基准，在八个数据集上评估五个冻结的 H&E 到 mIF 生成器，涵盖分子到患者尺度的下游任务，并与病理基础模型 UNI2 对比。
key_points: 评估五个生成器、八个数据集
任务含 CD3 恢复、TLS/GC 分割、生存预测
基于基础模型的 MIPHEI-ViT 在生成器中领先
reason: 病理基准，多尺度下游评估，预印本
abstract: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-to-multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) generators predict spatial protein expression from routine histology, yet pixel-level marker reconstruction does not establish downstream utility. We present HEmIF-Bench, evaluating five frozen generators across eight datasets spanning molecular, cellular, tissue, and patient scales. HEmIF-Bench decouples internal encoder features from generated outputs, benchmarking both against the pathology foundation reference UNI2. Mirroring the clinical workflow where pathologists rely on mIF to define cell phenotypes, delineate tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) and germinal centers (GCs), and stratify patient risk, we evaluate external CD3 recovery, single-cell classification, dense nuclear segmentation, TLS/GC segmentation, and patient survival prediction. Across the benchmark, foundation-model-based MIPHEI-ViT leads among the generators, while non-foundation models show task-specific strengths. Comparing the two routes reveals that internal encoder features generally outperform generated outputs, and larger output marker panels do not guarantee stronger downstream utility across datasets. Moreover, neither internal encoder features nor generated outputs consistently surpass frozen UNI2. These findings show that pixel-level stain fidelity does not equate to downstream utility, and that generators trained at current paired-data scales have yet to surpass large-scale pure-H&E foundation models. With the expansion of paired translation cohorts and the advancement of foundation-based generative architectures, HEmIF-Bench establishes a definitive benchmark for tracking when H&E-to-mIF generation crosses the threshold to deliver genuine value beyond routine histology for tumor microenvironment analysis and precision oncology.
zh_abstract: 苏木精-伊红（H&E）到多重免疫荧光（mIF）的生成器可根据常规组织学预测空间蛋白表达，但像素级标志物重建并不能确立其下游效用。我们提出了HEmIF-Bench，在涵盖分子、细胞、组织和患者尺度的八个数据集上评估五种冻结的生成器。HEmIF-Bench将内部编码器特征与生成输出解耦，并以病理基础模型参照UNI2为基准对二者进行评测。为模拟病理医生依赖mIF来界定细胞表型、勾画三级淋巴结构（TLS）和生发中心（GC）以及对患者风险分层的临床工作流程，我们评估了外部CD3恢复、单细胞分类、密集细胞核分割、TLS/GC分割和患者生存预测。在整个基准测试中，基于基础模型的MIPHEI-ViT在各生成器中领先，而非基础模型则在特定任务上表现出优势。比较两种途径发现，内部编码器特征总体上优于生成输出，且更大的输出标志物组合并不能保证各数据集上更强的下游效用。此外，无论是内部编码器特征还是生成输出，均未能持续超越冻结的UNI2。这些发现表明，像素级染色保真度并不等同于下游效用，且在当前配对数据规模下训练的生成器尚未超越大规模纯H&E基础模型。随着配对转换队列的扩大和基于基础模型的生成架构的进步，HEmIF-Bench确立了一个权威基准，用于追踪H&E到mIF的生成何时越过门槛，在肿瘤微环境分析和精准肿瘤学中提供超越常规组织学的真正价值。

title: ROUNDS: Source-Framed Diagnostic Revision after Multi-Turn Clinical Evidence
zh_title: ROUNDS：多轮临床证据下的诊断修正评测
summary: 提出ROUNDS框架，评估LLM在多轮临床证据、无选项诊断及不同来源意见（医生/外行）影响下的诊断修正能力，覆盖7个模型、1035例病例。
key_points: 比较有无答案选项的诊断
同一错误诊断以医生与外行口吻呈现
7个模型、5个数据集，有选项平均准确率76.9%
reason: 多轮诊断评测框架有新意、规模适中，预印本
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high scores on medical benchmarks, but does this performance translate into reliable diagnosis as a conversation unfolds? In diagnostic conversations, users can provide clinical findings across multiple turns, ask for a diagnosis without supplying answer options, and introduce opinions from others. Models must therefore form diagnoses from the available evidence and decide how to respond to subsequent advice. We introduce ROUNDS, a framework that evaluates these abilities after a fixed sequence of clinical evidence delivered over multiple turns. ROUNDS compares diagnosis with and without answer options, presents the same incorrect diagnosis under clinician and lay framing, and varies support for competing diagnoses in written five-clinician panels. Across seven models and 1,035 cases from five datasets, average accuracy was 76.9% with answer options and 57.0% without them. Clinician-framed misleading advice produced lower final accuracy than lay-framed advice in every model, with differences of 4.6 to 38.2 percentage points. Initially correct diagnoses more often became incorrect answers than abstentions, and many adopted the suggested disease. Conversely, accuracy increased as more panel members supported the correct diagnosis, including when the majority opinion remained unchanged. These findings reveal a gap between medical benchmark performance and reliable diagnosis in conversation: models respond to external opinions, but remain vulnerable to abandoning correct diagnoses without new clinical evidence.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在医学基准测试中取得了高分，但这种表现能否转化为随着对话展开而可靠的诊断？在诊断对话中，用户可以在多轮中提供临床发现，在不提供答案选项的情况下要求给出诊断，并引入他人的意见。因此，模型必须根据现有证据形成诊断，并决定如何回应后续建议。我们提出了ROUNDS框架，用于在多轮中按固定顺序提供临床证据后评估这些能力。ROUNDS比较有答案选项与无答案选项时的诊断，在临床医生口吻与外行口吻下呈现相同的错误诊断，并在书面的五位临床医生小组中改变对相互竞争诊断的支持程度。在来自五个数据集的七个模型和1,035个病例中，有答案选项时平均准确率为76.9%，无答案选项时为57.0%。在每个模型中，临床医生口吻的误导性建议导致的最终准确率均低于外行口吻的建议，差异为4.6至38.2个百分点。最初正确的诊断更常变成错误答案而非弃答，且许多模型采纳了所建议的疾病。相反，随着更多小组成员支持正确诊断，准确率随之升高，包括多数意见保持不变的情况。这些发现揭示了医学基准测试表现与对话中可靠诊断之间的差距：模型会对外部意见做出反应，但在没有新的临床证据时仍容易放弃正确诊断。

title: Where slide-level foundation-model classifiers fail on atypical breast lesions
zh_title: 切片级病理基础模型分类器在非典型乳腺病变上为何失败
summary: 用四种病理基础模型分析非典型乳腺病变分类失败原因，发现切片标签取最严重病变，病变级标签训练可改善边界分类。
key_points: 仅39%的ADH标注切片被标为ADH
注意力常未将病变排第一
病变级标签训练改善四类非典型边界
reason: 病理基础模型失败分析，预注册假设并含院内与HISTAI验证
abstract: Whether a ductal breast lesion is called atypical hyperplasia or low-grade carcinoma in situ increasingly determines surgery. However, slide-level classifiers built on pathology foundation models (PFMs) perform worst on these lesions. Using four PFMs, cross-validation on BRACS and preregistered hypotheses, we studied where the classification of atypia fails. Because slides are labelled with their most severe lesion, only 39% of the slides with annotated atypical ductal hyperplasia (ADH) were labelled ADH. Attention ranked the lesion high but rarely first, and showing the model only the lesion helped little, whereas classifiers trained per decision with lesion-level labels improved all four atypical boundaries. ADH regions inserted into benign slides raised the probability of malignancy more than that of atypia. In a hospital with pathologist-labelled single-subtype slides and in HISTAI, benign slides were scored closer to lesions and triage specificity fell from 0.48-0.53 to 0.00-0.07 and 0.22.

title: EndoComparer: Comparative Surgical Video Question Answering with Pseudo-Siamese Visual Adaptation and Perceive-then-Compare Reasoning
zh_title: EndoComparer：手术视频对比问答的视觉语言模型
summary: 提出伪孪生视觉LoRA与先感知后比较的思维链，用于比较两段手术视频，并构建约1.1万题的EndoDiffVQA基准。
key_points: 每个视频槽独立低秩适配器
Perceive-then-Compare思维链推理
构建EndoDiffVQA多选问答基准
reason: 手术视觉语言模型新方法并发布基准，预印本证据有限
abstract: Purpose: Surgical training benefits from explicit comparison between cases: in patient condition, in technique and in skill proficiency. Surgical vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising and flexible interface for this purpose. Yet current VLMs typically see one video at a time, and they often fall short when asked to compare videos. Methods: We propose EndoComparer, a VLM for comparative surgical video question answering with two components. (a) A Pseudo-Siamese Visual LoRA (PSVL) gives each video slot its own low-rank adapter over a shared frozen vision encoder, separating the two videos in the visual pathway at the cost of a single encoder pass. (b) A Perceive-then-Compare chain of thought (PtC-CoT) trains the model to first state what each video shows, then derive the answer from these statements. We further curate EndoDiffVQA, a benchmark of nearly 11K multiple-choice questions on video-pair over cholecystectomy and gastric bypass procedures, covering anatomy, tool, action and skill. Results: EndoComparer outperforms strong generalist and surgical VLMs on detecting and specifying difference between videos. Ablations show that two proposed components contribute complimentarily, and the model remains more robust under a video-swap control that exposes confusion between the two videos. Conclusion: Providing a dedicated visual reasoning path through PSVL and PtC-CoT makes cross-case comparison of surgical videos more robust for VLMs. EndoDiffVQA and EndoComparer provide a benchmark and a strong baseline for this task. Project page: https://camma-public.github.io/endocomparer

title: PathLoop: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Reasoning for Evidence-Grounded Whole-Slide Image Analysis
zh_title: PathLoop：面向全切片图像分析的自进化多智能体推理
summary: 提出融合组学数据的自进化多智能体框架PathLoop，在切片、图块、像素层级协同视觉与组学解读，并以病理知识库核查证据一致性。
key_points: 组学信号引导区域选择，兼顾局部细节与全局特征
判断智能体对照Pathology-Wiki知识库核查证据
旨在改善区域选择偏差与跨病例经验复用
reason: 病理多智能体新方法，预印本，摘要未见充分验证；命中偏好小幅上调
abstract: Analyzing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires combining evidence across tissue regions and spatial scales. Multi-agent systems offer a promising approach to this task. However, existing systems make limited use of molecular evidence, often select visually prominent but less representative regions while overlooking global context, and struggle to reuse experience from previous cases. To address these challenges, we present PathLoop, a self-evolving multi-agent framework that integrates omics data for evidence-grounded WSI analysis. Specifically, PathLoop coordinates visual and omics interpreters across slide, patch, and pixel levels, using molecular signals to guide region selection and combining local tissue details with global slide features. A judgment agent then checks the consistency of the collected evidence against Pathology-Wiki, a knowledge base built from 48 entries across 24 organ systems, and triggers re-examination when the evidence is inconsistent. To reuse past experience, a four-level memory stores reasoning trajectories, practical tips, skills, and tools to guide future cases, forming a loop of evidence collection, review, and memory update. We evaluate PathLoop on four TCGA cohorts with biomarker prediction, survival prediction, and subtype classification. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of PathLoop across these tasks and support its use for evidence-grounded WSI analysis.
zh_abstract: 分析全切片图像（WSI）需要整合不同组织区域和空间尺度上的证据。多智能体系统为这一任务提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，现有系统对分子证据的利用有限，常选取视觉上显著但代表性较差的区域而忽视全局背景，并且难以复用既往病例的经验。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PathLoop，一种整合组学数据、用于基于证据的WSI分析的自进化多智能体框架。具体而言，PathLoop在切片、图块和像素层面协调视觉解读器与组学解读器，利用分子信号引导区域选择，并将局部组织细节与全局切片特征相结合。随后，判断智能体对照Pathology-Wiki（一个由涵盖24个器官系统的48个条目构建的知识库）检查所收集证据的一致性，并在证据不一致时触发重新检查。为复用既往经验，一个四级记忆存储推理轨迹、实用技巧、技能和工具，以指导后续病例，从而形成证据收集、审查与记忆更新的闭环。我们在四个TCGA队列上评估了PathLoop，任务包括生物标志物预测、生存预测和亚型分类。结果证明了PathLoop在这些任务中的有效性，并支持其用于基于证据的WSI分析。

title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams
zh_title: OpenAI：推进面向医疗团队的计算机操作智能体
summary: OpenAI发布关于面向医疗团队的计算机操作智能体的内容（仅有标题信息）。
reason: 大厂医疗智能体动态，但仅标题，信息不足

title: Large language models as oncology world models
zh_title: 大语言模型作为肿瘤学世界模型
summary: 系统考察LLM内部的肿瘤学世界模型：生成病例同质化，对生物标志物与治疗逻辑部分遵循，并提出Clinical State Space动态表征框架。
key_points: 同癌种生成患者在基线特征上高度雷同(81.0%–93.2%)
36个模型-场景评估中29个遵循生物标志物/治疗逻辑
LLM预测12个月生存率89.9%，实际观察为72.2%
reason: world model+肿瘤预后方向新颖，预印本且证据有限，档内上调
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.

title: SLICES: A Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Self-Supervised Learning on Sparse ICU Time Series
zh_title: SLICES：ICU稀疏时间序列自监督学习基准与评估框架
summary: 提出在MIMIC-IV、eICU上统一设置比较MAE、JEPA、对比学习的ICU自监督基准；MAE在多数比较中领先。
key_points: 固定24小时输入、Transformer编码器、患者级划分
覆盖四个终点、两种适配协议、五个种子
MAE在9组冻结比较中均领先平均AUPRC
reason: 有新意的基准与对比充分，但为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) results for intensive care unit (ICU) time series are hard to compare when data processing, encoders, and adaptation vary together. We present SLICES, a benchmark and evaluation framework for comparing and extending SSL methods under a shared clinical setup. It fixes 24-hour value and observation-mask inputs, a Transformer encoder, patient-level splits, four endpoints, two adaptation protocols, and five matched seeds across MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD, and their pooled union. Masked autoencoding (MAE), joint-embedding prediction (JEPA), and contrastive learning provide reference implementations. Among these objectives, MAE leads mean AUPRC in all nine frozen classification comparisons, also under converged probes, and in seven of nine fine-tuning comparisons. Fine-tuned MAE leads hospital mortality at full labels and scores higher than a supervised Transformer of the same architecture at every label fraction, and SSL fine-tuning gives the lowest length-of-stay error. Supervised baselines remain strong elsewhere: GRU-D leads 24-hour mortality and XGBoost leads acute kidney injury in all three regimes. Rankings depend on the adaptation protocol, the comparator set, and whether the probe loss matches the metric. A two-seed MIMIC-IV rerun with the maintained code stays within two across-seed SDs of the reference in all 48 downstream runs. The code repository supports new objectives, shared downstream evaluation, and regeneration of the reference results, so new SSL methods can be compared with these references under the same conditions. Generalization to unseen hospitals is not tested here and is the natural next extension.
zh_abstract: 当数据处理、编码器和适配方式同时变化时，重症监护病房（ICU）时间序列的自监督学习（SSL）结果难以比较。我们提出 SLICES，这是一个用于在统一临床设置下比较和扩展 SSL 方法的基准与评估框架。它固定了 24 小时数值与观测掩码输入、Transformer 编码器、患者层面的数据划分、四个终点、两种适配方案，以及在 MIMIC-IV、eICU-CRD 及二者合并数据上的五个匹配随机种子。掩码自编码（MAE）、联合嵌入预测（JEPA）和对比学习提供了参考实现。在这些目标函数中，MAE 在全部九项冻结编码器分类比较中的平均 AUPRC 均领先（在收敛探针下亦然），并在九项微调比较中的七项领先。微调后的 MAE 在全量标签下的医院死亡率任务上领先，并且在每个标签比例下得分均高于相同架构的有监督 Transformer；SSL 微调给出最低的住院时长误差。其他方面有监督基线依然很强：GRU-D 在 24 小时死亡率上领先，XGBoost 在三种设置下均在急性肾损伤上领先。排名取决于适配方案、对比方法集合，以及探针损失是否与评价指标相匹配。使用维护后代码在 MIMIC-IV 上进行的两种子重复实验，在全部 48 次下游运行中均保持在参考结果的两个跨种子标准差之内。该代码库支持新的目标函数、共享的下游评估以及参考结果的重新生成，因此新的 SSL 方法可在相同条件下与这些参考结果进行比较。本文未检验对未见医院的泛化能力，这是自然的下一步扩展。

title: When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
zh_title: 何时信任模拟患者反应：用于升压药决策支持的支持度门控世界模型
summary: 在propose-simulate-refine智能体上加入支持度门控，对支持不足或集成分歧大的预测予以弃权，在eICU留出医院上评估。
key_points: eICU含70家医院、30,700次决策转移
62.0%覆盖率下MAP平均误差7.3 mmHg
随机选择同覆盖率下为9.2 mmHg
reason: 医学世界模型+留出医院评估，但为回顾性预印本
abstract: Clinical world models expose language-model agents to predicted patient responses, but simulations can be unreliable for poorly supported treatments or unfamiliar hospitals. We introduce Support-Gated World-Model decision support, a lightweight extension of a propose--simulate--refine agent. A recurrent dynamics ensemble predicts short-horizon physiological responses to documented norepinephrine dose categories, while a behavior model estimates observational action support. The interface withholds predictions with insufficient support or excessive ensemble disagreement and abstains when no candidate qualifies. Evaluation on eICU-CRD includes 70 hospitals and 30,700 decision transitions, with 14 hospitals held out for testing. At 62.0% factual-transition coverage, joint gating yields a MAP mean absolute error of 7.3 mmHg, compared with 9.2 mmHg for random selection at the same coverage. The gated agent achieves 60.0% agreement with recorded actions at 81.0% decision coverage, compared with 55.0% agreement and 99.5% coverage for an ungated ensemble agent. Component ablations show lower factual risk with joint gating than with either gate alone.These results characterize a reliability--coverage trade-off in selective clinical simulation; they do not identify individualized treatment effects or establish improved patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: 临床世界模型使语言模型智能体能够接触到预测的患者反应，但对于支持不足的治疗或不熟悉的医院，模拟结果可能不可靠。我们提出支持门控世界模型决策支持（Support-Gated World-Model decision support），这是对“提出—模拟—优化”智能体的一种轻量级扩展。循环动力学集成模型预测对已记录的去甲肾上腺素剂量类别的短期生理反应，而行为模型则估计观察性动作支持度。当支持不足或集成分歧过大时，该接口会拒绝给出预测，并在没有候选方案符合条件时弃权。在 eICU-CRD 上的评估包括 70 家医院和 30,700 次决策转换，其中 14 家医院留作测试。在 62.0% 的事实转换覆盖率下，联合门控使 MAP 平均绝对误差为 7.3 mmHg，而相同覆盖率下随机选择为 9.2 mmHg。门控智能体在 81.0% 的决策覆盖率下与记录动作的一致率为 60.0%，而未门控的集成智能体一致率为 55.0%、覆盖率为 99.5%。组件消融显示，联合门控的事实风险低于任一单独门控。这些结果刻画了选择性临床模拟中可靠性与覆盖率之间的权衡；它们并不能识别个体化治疗效应，也不能证明患者结局得到改善。

title: CARET: Clinical Assertion-Aware Residual Calibration for Medical Image-Text Alignment
zh_title: CARET：面向医学图文对齐的临床断言感知残差校准
summary: 提出参数高效的图像侧适配方法，利用正负临床陈述区分明确存在、否定与不确定表述，提升零样本分类。
key_points: 保留预训练图像与文本编码器
有界残差沿语义校正方向调整图像特征
CheXpert 5×200零样本准确率67.80%
reason: 医学视觉语言模型新方法，有基线对比，仅预印本
abstract: Medical vision--language models align radiographs with free-text reports, but radiology language distinguishes explicit findings, negation, uncertainty, and omission. Treating these report states as interchangeable during feature adaptation can change image predictions without supporting visual evidence. We introduce CARET, a parameter-efficient image-side adaptation method that retains pretrained image and text encoders and uses paired positive and negative clinical statements to define a low-dimensional semantic correction space. A bounded residual adjusts image features along these directions, while assertion-aware supervision distinguishes explicitly present and absent findings from uncertain or unmentioned ones. At inference, the adapter requires only an image; textual references remain fixed. In zero-shot classification, CARET achieves 67.80\% accuracy on CheXpert 5$\times$200 and 65.20\% on RSNA. These scores exceed the published CLEFT-LoRA results by 1.06 and 0.27 percentage points, respectively. Comparisons to literature baselines are informative but not controlled for differences in pretraining and evaluation protocols. Ablations across eight components identify the four-state distinction and assertion objective as major contributors, with task-dependent effects for nonmention preservation and pair alignment.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型将X线片与自由文本报告对齐，但放射学语言区分明确发现、否定、不确定和遗漏。在特征适配过程中将这些报告状态视为可互换，可能在缺乏视觉证据支持的情况下改变图像预测。我们提出CARET，一种参数高效的图像侧适配方法：保留预训练的图像和文本编码器，并利用成对的阳性与阴性临床陈述定义一个低维语义校正空间。有界残差沿这些方向调整图像特征，同时断言感知监督将明确存在和明确不存在的发现与不确定或未提及的发现区分开来。在推理时，适配器仅需图像；文本参照保持固定。在零样本分类中，CARET在CheXpert 5×200上达到67.80%的准确率，在RSNA上达到65.20%。这些得分分别比已发表的CLEFT-LoRA结果高1.06和0.27个百分点。与文献基线的比较具有参考价值，但未对预训练和评估方案的差异进行控制。针对八个组成部分的消融实验表明，四状态区分和断言目标是主要贡献因素，而未提及保留和配对对齐的作用则取决于具体任务。

title: Unlocking Fine-Grained Cell Representations via Soft-Interior Rim Dense-Grid Pooling in Pathology Foundation Models
zh_title: 病理基础模型中基于软内部-边缘密集网格池化的细粒度细胞表征
summary: 提出无需训练的SRDP读出方法，在冻结病理基础模型上提取更细粒度的细胞表征，并在四个数据集、六种编码器上评估。
key_points: 免训练、几何感知的细胞特征池化
半步长偏移网格与分数覆盖权重，结合内部与边缘池化
对比HoVer-Net与CellViT++的做法
reason: 病理基础模型新方法，多数据集多编码器对比，预印本
abstract: Fine-grained cell representations are essential for characterizing cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization in computational pathology. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide powerful pretrained features for transferable tissue analysis. HoVer-Net uses task-trained segmentation and typing, whereas CellViT++ averages native-grid tokens assigned to detected nuclei. However, the former requires cell-specific training; the latter ignores fractional nuclear coverage and can mix nuclear content with neighbouring tissue. Therefore, we propose SRDP, short for Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling, a training-free geometry-aware readout. We apply the frozen patch projection at half stride, interleave four offset lattices, map the cell mask to fractional coverage weights, and concatenate whole-cell pooling with two inner boundary pools. Across four datasets and six frozen encoders, SRDP improves mean balanced accuracy by 5.68 percentage points over native token averaging across 24 settings, including 11.22 points on average for CoNIC and Lizard. SRDP converts a coarse frozen PFM lattice into a mask-aligned, fine-grained cell representation without updating the encoder.
zh_abstract: 细粒度细胞表征对于在计算病理学中刻画细胞异质性和组织结构至关重要。病理基础模型（PFM）为可迁移的组织分析提供了强大的预训练特征。HoVer-Net采用经任务训练的分割与分型，而CellViT++则对分配给检测到的细胞核的原生网格token取平均。然而，前者需要针对特定细胞进行训练；后者忽略了细胞核的部分覆盖，并可能将核内容与邻近组织混合。因此，我们提出SRDP，即软内部边缘密集网格池化（Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling），一种无需训练、具有几何感知的读出方法。我们以半步长应用冻结的图块投影，交错四个偏移晶格，将细胞掩膜映射为部分覆盖权重，并将全细胞池化与两个内部边界池化拼接。在四个数据集和六个冻结编码器上，SRDP在24种设置中使平均平衡准确率较原生token平均提高了5.68个百分点，其中在CoNIC和Lizard上平均提高11.22个百分点。SRDP无需更新编码器，即可将粗糙的冻结PFM晶格转换为与掩膜对齐的细粒度细胞表征。

title: Which Model, For Which Variable? Per-Variable Forecast Combination in Sparse ICU Time Series
zh_title: 逐变量预测组合：稀疏ICU时间序列中的模型选择
summary: 在五个ICU数据库、94个通道、14个模型的24小时预测中，逐变量加权组合较最佳单模型均方误差降低6.1–11.0%。
key_points: 没有单一架构在所有变量上最优
五库平均MSE降低8.7%
最稀疏三分之一通道提升11.9%
reason: 多数据库（含独立单中心）对比充分，但为预印本且方法增量
abstract: Clinical forecasting papers typically report a single best architecture. We show that on multivariate ICU physiology this question conceals variable-specific differences: no architecture is best on every variable, and which model wins changes from variable to variable. Across five ICU databases (MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, eICU, HiRID, and UMM (University Medicine Mannheim), a German single-center ICU) we forecast 94 channels over a 24-hour horizon with a pool of 14 models, and combine them with weights fitted per variable. On test, the combination beats the best single model on all five databases by 6.1-11.0% mean squared error (mean 8.7%). The gain is concentrated where clinical data is thinnest: the sparsest third of channels improves by 11.9% and laboratory values by 7.5%, against 3.1% for the densest third. Rank-based harmonic weighting of the best five models per variable, with no fitted weights at all, recovers about four-fifths of the gain. Extending the pool afterwards with a per-channel gradient-boosted tree, ARIMA and ETS makes the tree the validation-selected best single model on all five databases; per-variable combination still improves on it by 2.9-5.9% (significant on four of five), while equal weighting of the same members does not. As on univariate benchmarks, learned combination beats simple averaging - but only once the weights are constrained. We also report which model to prefer when, and show that the ordering changes with database size.

title: Same Evidence, Different Verdicts: Delivery of CT Images and DICOM Metadata Changes VLM Quality-Control Decisions
zh_title: 证据相同结论不同：CT图像与DICOM元数据的呈现顺序改变VLM质控决策
summary: 在60对NLST胸部CT上发现，视觉语言模型在质控中后出现的信息倾向压过先出现的，错误元数据可推翻多数正确检测。
key_points: 错误头信息后置时推翻91%检测（Claude Haiku）
顺序颠倒后图像可推翻98–100%的头信息错误
非泛化的迎合行为，后到来源占优
reason: VLM临床质控安全性有新发现，但样本仅60对、预印本
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are being proposed as automated checks on clinical imaging inputs, where a scan and its DICOM metadata can disagree; a truncated CT series wrongly admitted to volumetric follow-up, such as lung-nodule growth assessment in screening, biases the measurement. A natural safeguard is to let the model judge the image before it sees the metadata. We find this backfires. On 60 NLST chest CT pairs with coverage defects whose ground truth is computed from scan geometry, a false header that Claude Haiku 5.5 resisted when shown with the image (2% of its detections overruled) overturned 91% of them when it arrived after the model's answer (Nemotron-3.5-VL 43% to 100%). With the order reversed, the image overturned 98-100% of the header's errors (Claude models): whichever source came second won. This is not generic sycophancy: a neutral "please confirm" reversed 0 of 1,072 correct refusals, and the effect persisted when the header arrived as a tool result, as in agentic pipelines. One warning sentence cut sequential reversal to at most 9%, and the pattern held on 24 real mismatched pairs. Contributions: (i) evidence that VLM input-check decisions on identical evidence depend on delivery; (ii) a testbed with exact geometric ground truth; (iii) a validation protocol for clinical VLM input checks. Code, prompts and all call logs: https://github.com/nav92061/ct-vlm-delivery-order

title: Naegele's rule is not a 280-day count: generative AI conflates two distinct pregnancy-dating algorithms.
zh_title: 内格勒法则不等于280天计数：生成式AI混淆两种预产期算法
summary: 计算78163个LMP日期，两种方法在55.7%的日期上预产期不同；评估5个生成式AI共60条回答对方法的披露与标注。
key_points: 78163个日期中43554个结果不同
测试5个生成式AI，共60条回答
评估AI是否披露并准确标注方法
reason: 小型提示测试，揭示具体风险，但范围窄
abstract: [Journal of perinatal medicine] Naegele's calendar rule and an exact 280-day count are commonly treated as equivalent methods for estimating the due date (EDD), although their calendar arithmetic differs. We quantified this difference and evaluated whether generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems disclosed and accurately labeled the method used. A deterministic script calculated EDDs for every last menstrual period (LMP) date from January 1, 1812, through December 31, 2025, using Naegele's calendar rule and a fixed 280-day count. Five generative AI systems answered four prespecified LMP prompts, representing agreement and differences of 1, 2, and 3 days. Each prompt was submitted in three separate conversations, yielding 60 responses. Among 78,163 LMP dates, the methods produced identical EDDs in 34,609 cases (44.3 %) and different EDDs in 43,554 (55.7 %). Naegele's calendar rule produced dates 1 day later in 27.0 %, 2 days later in 21.0 %, and 3 days later in 7.7 %. The methods never agreed among 14,828 intervals containing February 29. Of 60 AI responses, 57 (95.0 %) included the exact 280-day date and 48 (80.0 %) stated a calculation method. Only 18 of 45 responses to divergent dates distinguished the algorithms. Twelve of 48 method-stating responses contained a method-label mismatch. Naegele's calendar rule and fixed 280-day counting are distinct algorithms. Their small numerical differences are unlikely to be clinically important, but they provide a deterministic test of computational transparency. Generative AI systems should disclose the calculation used, distinguish non-equivalent methods, and label them accurately.
zh_abstract: [Journal of perinatal medicine] 内格勒（Naegele）日历规则与精确的280天计数通常被视为估算预产期（EDD）的等效方法，尽管二者的日历运算并不相同。我们量化了这一差异，并评估生成式人工智能（AI）系统是否披露并准确标注所用方法。我们使用确定性脚本，按Naegele日历规则和固定280天计数，计算了1812年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间每个末次月经（LMP）日期的EDD。5个生成式AI系统回答了4个预先设定的LMP提示，分别代表结果一致以及相差1、2和3天的情形。每个提示在3次独立对话中提交，共产生60条回答。在78,163个LMP日期中，两种方法得出相同EDD的有34,609例（44.3%），EDD不同的有43,554例（55.7%）。Naegele日历规则得出的日期晚1天的占27.0%，晚2天的占21.0%，晚3天的占7.7%。在包含2月29日的14,828个时间区间中，两种方法从未一致。在60条AI回答中，57条（95.0%）包含精确280天的日期，48条（80.0%）说明了计算方法。针对结果不同的日期的45条回答中，仅18条区分了这两种算法。48条说明了方法的回答中有12条存在方法标注不符。Naegele日历规则与固定280天计数是不同的算法。二者微小的数值差异不太可能具有临床重要性，但它们为检验计算透明度提供了一个确定性测试。生成式AI系统应披露所用的计算方法，区分不等效的方法，并对其进行准确标注。

title: Autonomous surgical systems and artificial intelligence integration: where are we now?
zh_title: 自主手术系统与AI融合：现状如何？
summary: 综述手术自主性与AI整合现状，以泌尿外科为重点：已获批机器人多为低自主水平，有条件自主已进入临床，如AI引导的Aquablation。
key_points: 多数已获批手术机器人自主水平较低
Aquablation结合影像规划与医生授权的机器人执行
临床前系统已能学习缝合等多步操作
reason: 综述类文章，信息为现状概述，属增量档
abstract: [Current opinion in urology] Interest in autonomous surgery has intensified as artificial intelligence (AI) has progressed from preoperative applications to intraoperative perception, decision support, and robotic action. This review examines the current state of surgical autonomy and AI integration, with emphasis on urology. Most cleared surgical robots remain at low levels of autonomy, but conditional autonomy has entered clinical practice. In urology, AI-guided Aquablation combines image-based treatment planning with robotic execution under surgeon authorization. In preclinical settings, autonomous systems have progressed from predefined tasks to learned control of soft-tissue manipulation, suturing, and multistep surgical actions. In parallel, surgical AI can recognize operative phases and gestures, assess technical performance, and provide real-time intraoperative decision support, with emerging multimodal and vision-language models further expanding these capabilities. Surgical autonomy remains predominantly task-specific and human-supervised, with more advanced autonomous execution largely confined to preclinical settings. Near-term progress will likely involve increasing integration of conditional-autonomy functions and AI decision support into existing robotic platforms, with the surgeon retaining a central role in supervision and decision-making. Broader clinical adoption will require generalizable models, rigorous validation, and appropriate regulatory and accountability frameworks.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in urology] 随着人工智能（AI）从术前应用发展到术中感知、决策支持和机器人操作，人们对自主手术的兴趣日益增强。本综述探讨了手术自主性与AI整合的现状，重点关注泌尿外科。大多数已获批的手术机器人仍处于低自主水平，但有条件自主已进入临床实践。在泌尿外科，AI引导的水刀消融术（Aquablation）将基于图像的治疗规划与在外科医生授权下的机器人执行相结合。在临床前研究中，自主系统已从预定义任务发展到对软组织操作、缝合和多步骤手术动作的学习型控制。与此同时，手术AI可以识别手术阶段和手势、评估技术表现，并提供实时术中决策支持，新兴的多模态和视觉语言模型进一步扩展了这些能力。手术自主性仍主要是针对特定任务且由人类监督的，更高级的自主执行主要局限于临床前环境。近期的进展可能是将有条件自主功能和AI决策支持日益整合到现有机器人平台中，外科医生仍在监督和决策中发挥核心作用。要实现更广泛的临床应用，需要具有泛化能力的模型、严格的验证，以及适当的监管和问责框架。

title: AI-Assisted Interpretation of Prostate MRI: A Narrative Review.
source: PubMed · Journal of computer assisted tomography
zh_title: AI辅助前列腺MRI判读：叙述性综述
summary: 综述2023年1月至2025年4月AI辅助双参数/多参数前列腺MRI判读的证据，指出泛化性、数据集偏倚与验证方面的问题。
key_points: 检索PubMed与Google Scholar，覆盖2023–2025年研究
AI用于前列腺分割与病灶检测，结果不一
存在泛化性、数据偏倚与验证不足等顾虑
reason: 叙述性综述，上限6分；信息泛泛，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of computer assisted tomography] Multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) improves detection of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) but is limited by inter-reader variability. Artificial intelligence (AI) has been increasingly applied to prostate segmentation and lesion detection, with heterogeneous results. Concerns remain regarding generalizability, data set bias, and validation. This review summarizes recent evidence on AI-assisted prostate MRI interpretation, identifies knowledge gaps, and outlines directions for future research. A systematic literature search of PubMed and Google Scholar was performed for studies published between January 2023 and April 2025 evaluating AI-assisted interpretation of biparametric or multiparametric prostate MRI. Reference lists were manually reviewed. Eligible studies assessed diagnostic performance of AI alone or in combination with radiologists. Eighteen studies met inclusion criteria from 157 screened. Standalone AI systems achieved areas under the curve (AUCs) ranging from 0.77 to 0.91, with sensitivities of 65.4% to 96% and specificities of 77.6% to 91%, occasionally outperforming radiologists. Hybrid AI-radiologist models improved inter-reader agreement, reduced interpretation time by up to 50%, and enhanced detection accuracy for equivocal (PI-RADS 3) lesions. AI assistance particularly benefited junior and general radiologists, improving diagnostic performance, confidence, and reproducibility. In active surveillance cohorts, AI demonstrated greater accuracy than radiologists for detecting disease progression (AUC=0.86 vs. 0.69), although specificity limitations persisted. Overall, AI integration into prostate MRI workflows demonstrates substantial potential to improve detection efficiency and standardization. Broader clinical adoption will require large-scale, multicenter validation, harmonized imaging protocols, and rigorous outcome-based evaluation.

title: [Expert consensus on artificial intelligence optical navigation-assisted CT-guided percutaneous for thoracic lesions].
source: PubMed · Zhonghua nei ke za zhi
zh_title: AI光学导航辅助CT引导胸部病灶穿刺专家共识
summary: 中国多学会专家共识，旨在规范AI光学导航与机械臂辅助的CT引导胸部病灶穿刺技术。
key_points: AI光学导航结合机械臂执行预设穿刺路径
目标是规范并推广该技术
由CSCO等多家学会专家组织制定
reason: 专家共识类，规范临床应用，但无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Zhonghua nei ke za zhi] Conventional CT-guided percutaneous for thoracic lesions is primarily performed via freehand manipulation by the operator, and its accuracy is constrained by individual experience. Artificial intelligence optical navigation-assisted systems enable precise execution of preplanned puncture trajectories and visual guidance through high-precision spatial localization and robotic arm navigation, thereby markedly improving puncture success rate and procedural safety. To standardize and promote this technique and advance the precision diagnosis and treatment of thoracic tumors, this consensus was formulated by domestic experts organized jointly by the Ablation Expert Committee of the Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology (CSCO), the Society of Tumor Ablation Therapy of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association, the Expert Group on Tumor Ablation Therapy of the Chinese Medical Doctors Association, the Tumor Ablation Committee of the Chinese College of Interventionalists,following in-depth discussions. This consensus mainly covers: (1) artificial intelligence optical navigation systems and puncture devices; (2) protocols and precautions for artificial intelligence optical navigation-assisted CT-guided percutaneous puncture for thoracic lesions.
zh_abstract: [中华内科杂志] 传统的CT引导下胸部病灶经皮穿刺主要由术者徒手操作，其准确性受个人经验限制。人工智能光学导航辅助系统通过高精度空间定位和机械臂导航，能够精确执行预先规划的穿刺路径并提供可视化引导，从而显著提高穿刺成功率和操作安全性。为规范和推广该技术，推动胸部肿瘤的精准诊疗，本共识由中国临床肿瘤学会（CSCO）消融专家委员会、中国抗癌协会肿瘤消融治疗专业委员会、中国医师协会肿瘤消融治疗专家组、中国介入医师学院肿瘤消融委员会组织国内专家，经深入讨论后制定。本共识主要涵盖：（1）人工智能光学导航系统及穿刺器械；（2）人工智能光学导航辅助CT引导下胸部病灶经皮穿刺的操作规程及注意事项。

title: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Pulmonary Hypertension Using Early-Fused CTPA and Pulmonary Artery Segmentation Maps.
zh_title: 融合CTPA与肺动脉分割图的肺动脉高压深度学习分类
summary: 将CTPA图像与肺动脉分割结果早期融合，用四种深度网络区分PH、CTEPH与无PH，纳入317例。
key_points: 纳入92例CTEPH、85例其他PH、140例无PH
比较ResNet50、DenseNet、SENet、Swin Transformer
早期融合CTPA与分割图
reason: 单中心小样本（数百例），摘要未见外部验证，增量档
abstract: [Pulmonary circulation] Computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is vital for diagnosing pulmonary hypertension (PH), especially thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH). However, manual image interpretation of CTPA often leads to misdiagnosis. This study aims to automatically segment the pulmonary artery from CTPA images and develop a deep learning model by fusing CTPA images with pulmonary artery segmentation results to distinguish pulmonary hypertension (PH vs. subjects without PH (no-PH)) and its PH subtype, CTEPH (CTEPH, other PH vs. no-PH). The study included 92 patients with CTEPH, 85 patients with other types of PH, and 140 no-PH. We completed the image preprocessing and segmentation of the pulmonary arterial tree of all the sample data. Based on four deep learning model classifiers-ResNet50, DenseNet, SENet, and Swin Transformer, we respectively developed four distinct network architectures: Single input channel for CTPA images, as well as early, middle, and late fusion strategies that combine CTPA images with their corresponding pulmonary vascular segmentation maps. The performance of the testing experiments has shown that the DenseNet (CTPA-seg) early fusion model achieves optimal performance in the binary classification task of pulmonary hypertension (PH vs. no-PH), with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.927. Meanwhile, the Swin Transformer (CTPA-seg) early fusion model shows the best performance in the ternary classification of pulmonary hypertension subtypes (CTEPH, other PH vs. no-PH), achieving an AUC of 0.855. Compared with models that only use clinical images, the early feature fusion strategy shows significantly higher accuracy in classifying and diagnosing PH, which is beneficial for the differential diagnosis of CTEPH.
zh_abstract: [肺循环] 计算机断层扫描肺动脉造影（CTPA）对于诊断肺动脉高压（PH），尤其是慢性血栓栓塞性肺动脉高压（CTEPH）至关重要。然而，CTPA 的人工影像判读常导致误诊。本研究旨在从 CTPA 图像中自动分割肺动脉，并通过融合 CTPA 图像与肺动脉分割结果建立深度学习模型，以区分肺动脉高压（PH 与无 PH 受试者（no-PH））及其 PH 亚型 CTEPH（CTEPH、其他 PH 与 no-PH）。研究纳入 92 例 CTEPH 患者、85 例其他类型 PH 患者和 140 例 no-PH 者。我们完成了所有样本数据的图像预处理及肺动脉树分割。基于 ResNet50、DenseNet、SENet 和 Swin Transformer 四种深度学习模型分类器，我们分别构建了四种不同的网络架构：仅以 CTPA 图像为单输入通道，以及将 CTPA 图像与其对应的肺血管分割图相结合的早期、中期和晚期融合策略。测试实验结果显示，DenseNet（CTPA-seg）早期融合模型在肺动脉高压二分类任务（PH 与 no-PH）中表现最佳，曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.927。同时，Swin Transformer（CTPA-seg）早期融合模型在肺动脉高压亚型三分类（CTEPH、其他 PH 与 no-PH）中表现最佳，AUC 为 0.855。与仅使用临床图像的模型相比，早期特征融合策略在 PH 的分类与诊断中准确率显著更高，有利于 CTEPH 的鉴别诊断。

title: Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection
zh_title: 人机协同证据校准选择：规模化 LLM 辅助治疗线判定
summary: 提出证据校准选择（ECS）框架，在肿瘤队列构建中用 LLM 判定治疗线，并通过人机协同筛出需人工复核的病例。
key_points: 针对肿瘤队列构建中的治疗线判定瓶颈
LLM 判定可靠性随患者复杂度而异
ECS 为 LLM 判定提供证据支持并识别需人工复核病例
reason: 新颖预印本方法，肿瘤电子病历 LLM，证据有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prioritizes patients with the least-supported assignments for follow-up review, and returns completed adjudications to the model as precedent. As the evidence base grows, ECS continuously calibrates confidence to estimate residual error, thus enabling more efficient use of clinician time. In simulations on 136 clinician adjudicated patients with multiple myeloma, ECS achieved a residual error of 5% after review of 44.6% of patients, compared to 62.2% when review was directed by LLM self-reported confidence and 81.9% under random sampling. These results support a scalable approach to study-specific LoT adjudication, using clinician evidence to inform automated predictions, minimize error, and reduce review burden.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）使传统上依赖详尽人工审查的临床裁定任务得以规模化。治疗线（LoT）裁定是肿瘤学队列构建中的主要瓶颈，是一个典型例子。必须根据细致入微、因研究而异的定义，在每位患者的每一次方案转换处，从纵向治疗史中推断治疗线的界限。LLM可以大规模执行这种裁定，但其可靠性因患者而异。治疗史的复杂程度各不相同，模棱两可或非典型的模式依赖于专家的临床判断。因此，可靠的自动化需要为模型的判定提供经过验证的支持，并能识别需要人工审查的病例。在此，我们提出证据校准选择（ECS），这是一种用于扩展LLM辅助LoT裁定的人在回路框架。ECS根据已观察到的临床医生裁定得出置信度，优先选择判定支持最少的患者进行后续审查，并将完成的裁定作为先例返还给模型。随着证据基础的增长，ECS持续校准置信度以估计剩余误差，从而更高效地利用临床医生的时间。在对136例经临床医生裁定的多发性骨髓瘤患者进行的模拟中，ECS在审查44.6%的患者后达到5%的剩余误差，而由LLM自报置信度指导审查时为62.2%，随机抽样时为81.9%。这些结果支持一种可扩展的、针对具体研究的LoT裁定方法：利用临床医生的证据为自动化预测提供依据，最小化误差并减轻审查负担。

title: Safety-Preserving Medical LLM Fine-Tuning via Bilevel Data Selection
zh_title: 基于双层数据选择的医学LLM安全保持微调
summary: 提出可扩展双层数据选择S-BDS，在医学指令微调中筛选样本以提升医学能力并控制面向患者的风险。
key_points: 通过控制选择权重集中度实现大候选池排序
结合临床医生验证的安全数据与筛选数据
联合评估医学能力与患者侧安全性
reason: 有新方法与评估的预印本，细节有限
abstract: As general large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted for patient-facing medical applications, improving medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks remains a critical challenge. Large-scale medical instruction data are essential for acquiring domain knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but unsafe responses can undermine existing safety alignment. To address this problem, we propose Scalable Bilevel Data Selection (S-BDS) for safety-preserving medical SFT. By controlling selection-weight concentration, S-BDS enables reliable sample ranking over large candidate pools and identifies training examples that improve medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks. We combine clinician-validated safe data and selected data with unscreened medical instruction data for SFT, and jointly evaluate medical capability and patient-facing safety on HealthBench and PatientSafetyBench, respectively. Experiments across Llama and Qwen models show that S-BDS achieves the highest safe rates among all compared methods, outperforming the strongest baselines by 4.64 and 3.00 percentage points, respectively, while maintaining competitive medical capability. Further experiments show that varying the safety-oriented weight during SFT controls the trade-off between medical capability and patient-facing safety.
zh_abstract: 随着通用大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于面向患者的医疗应用，在提升医学能力的同时控制面向患者的风险仍是一项关键挑战。大规模医学指令数据对于通过监督微调（SFT）获取领域知识至关重要，但不安全的回答可能会破坏已有的安全对齐。为解决这一问题，我们提出了用于保持安全性的医学 SFT 的可扩展双层数据选择方法（Scalable Bilevel Data Selection，S-BDS）。通过控制选择权重的集中程度，S-BDS 能够在大型候选池上实现可靠的样本排序，并识别出在控制面向患者风险的同时提升医学能力的训练样本。我们将经临床医生验证的安全数据和所选数据与未筛选的医学指令数据结合用于 SFT，并分别在 HealthBench 和 PatientSafetyBench 上联合评估医学能力和面向患者的安全性。在 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上的实验表明，S-BDS 在所有比较方法中取得了最高的安全率，分别比最强基线高出 4.64 和 3.00 个百分点，同时保持了具有竞争力的医学能力。进一步的实验表明，在 SFT 期间改变面向安全的权重可控制医学能力与面向患者的安全性之间的权衡。

title: Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes
zh_title: 决策模型能否从癌症病理报告中提取临床数据
summary: 在1113份口腔癌病理报告上评估两种开放权重决策模型的25个字段抽取，与生成式模型比较准确率与校准。
key_points: Tev1平均准确率0.917，与Qwen3.5 9B相当且快四倍
GLM-5.3-flash达0.986，Nimble为0.862
分档测量类字段表现较弱
reason: 单中心回顾性预印本，有多模型对比，新类模型首评
abstract: Decision models are a new class of language model that, instead of generating text, choose one option per question from a fixed list and return a probability for every option. They have not yet been evaluated on clinical text. We evaluated two open-weights decision models, Nimble 9B and Tev1 4B, for extracting 25 fields from 1,113 oral cavity cancer pathology reports from a single centre, against a prospectively maintained clinical database. We compared them with two generative models: Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, and GLM-5.3-flash, run through a cloud API. Tev1 reached a mean field accuracy of 0.917 (95% CI 0.913 to 0.920), the same as Qwen3.5 9B (0.918; p = 0.26), and was four times faster (15 s against 61 s per report). Nimble reached 0.862 and GLM-5.3-flash 0.986. Both decision models matched GLM-5.3-flash on simple dichotomous categories. They were weak on measurements binned into categories, on fields whose correct answer was not reported, and on some complex decisions (e.g. involved margins). We found that the main cause of the inferior performance of Nimble's came from asking 25 questions in one request: with two questions per request, its accuracy improved. Pooled over fields, the returned probabilities were well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.022 and 0.026), but they did not flag systematic errors within single fields. A simulated strategy of sending answers with a probability below 0.94 to GLM-5.3-flash raised Tev1's accuracy to 0.982, with 38% of answers escalated. Decision models can extract explicitly stated findings from pathology reports quickly on local hardware and return useful probabilities. They should be validated in the configuration in which they will be used, restricted to the fields in which they are reliable, and combined with other methods for numeric values.
zh_abstract: 决策模型（decision models）是一类新型语言模型，它不生成文本，而是针对每个问题从固定列表中选择一个选项，并为每个选项返回一个概率。其在临床文本上的表现尚未得到评估。我们评估了两个开放权重的决策模型 Nimble 9B 和 Tev1 4B，用于从单中心 1,113 份口腔癌病理报告中提取 25 个字段，并以前瞻性维护的临床数据库作为参照。我们将其与两个生成式模型进行比较：本地运行的 Qwen3.5 9B，以及通过云端 API 运行的 GLM-5.3-flash。Tev1 的平均字段准确率为 0.917（95% CI 0.913 至 0.920），与 Qwen3.5 9B（0.918；p = 0.26）相同，且速度快四倍（每份报告 15 秒对 61 秒）。Nimble 的准确率为 0.862，GLM-5.3-flash 为 0.986。两个决策模型在简单的二分类类别上与 GLM-5.3-flash 相当。它们在分箱为类别的测量值、正确答案为“未报告”的字段以及某些复杂判定（如切缘受累）上表现较弱。我们发现，Nimble 表现较差的主要原因在于一次请求中询问 25 个问题：当每次请求仅包含两个问题时，其准确率有所提高。对所有字段汇总后，返回的概率校准良好（期望校准误差分别为 0.022 和 0.026），但无法标示单个字段内的系统性错误。模拟策略为将概率低于 0.94 的答案发送给 GLM-5.3-flash，可使 Tev1 的准确率提高到 0.982，其中 38% 的答案被上报转交。决策模型能够在本地硬件上快速从病理报告中提取明确陈述的发现，并返回有用的概率。它们应在实际使用的配置下进行验证，限定于其可靠的字段，并与其他方法结合处理数值。

title: iEEG Can Help EEG: Improving Clinical Scalp EEG Analysis through Intracranial Priors
zh_title: iEEG助力EEG：以颅内先验改进临床头皮EEG分析
summary: 提出仅用iEEG拟合信号到信号模型并冻结为跨模态先验的重编程方法，以改善受干扰的头皮EEG信号质量。
key_points: 头皮EEG受非神经干扰与容积传导影响
iEEG稀缺且与EEG少有配对数据
基于两种模态共有的神经元同步机制
reason: 有新意的EEG跨模态方法，预印本，摘要证据有限
abstract: Scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is a cornerstone of clinical brain monitoring, making the quality of its signal fundamental to downstream tasks and models. However, that signal is heavily contaminated by non-neural interference and blurred by volume conduction. Existing methods operate almost exclusively within the scalp modality, so they inherit the contamination they would need to overcome. In practice, intracranial EEG (iEEG) observes the neural activity with far higher fidelity, yet it is invasive and therefore scarce, and the two modalities are rarely recorded as pairs at scale, share no common channel space, and offer no clean ground truth to directly supervise a mapping. Motivated by the neuronal synchronization mechanism shared by the two modalities, we propose a reprogramming approach that fits a signal-to-signal model on iEEG alone and freezes it as a cross-modal prior. We introduce ReBrain, a framework to transfer an iEEG-learned prior to scalp EEG, which re-expresses any scalp signal through that prior and can be inserted upstream of any downstream model with no pairing or fine-tuning. ReBrain consistently improves host models across recordings from multiple hospitals and across architecture families, and our analysis traces this gain to genuine neural structure carried by iEEG rather than to the architecture itself. This work provides evidence that a scarce clean modality can serve as a transferable prior for an abundant noisy one, offering a general recipe for cross-modal transfer among biosignals. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xianglong-Bao/ReBrain.

title: Governing Clinical AI Deployment: A Mathematical Framework for Transparency-Dependent Autonomy.
zh_title: 临床AI部署治理：透明度依赖自主性的数学框架
summary: 提出结合置信度、解释质量与指南一致性的信任分数规则，用于决定临床AI何时可免人工复核，并在MIMIC-IV、eICU等数据上回顾性评估。

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Healthcare institutions lack explicit, quantitative rules for deciding when a clinical artificial intelligence (AI) system may act without human review. Objective: To formalize and retrospectively evaluate a transparency-dependent deployment rule. Methods: A trust score, T = 0.60C + 0.24E + 0.16S, combines calibrated confidence in the predicted class (C), explanation quality (E), and guideline alignment (S) and is compared with an adaptive threshold, τ(E) = θ0 + κ(1 - E); equivalently, a prediction is deployed when 0.60C + 0.44E + 0.16S ≥ 0.70. We evaluated the rule in 5000 MIMIC-IV intensive care unit patients, 5000 eICU patients from about 200 hospitals, and a MIMIC-III cohort, against confidence-only and random deferral at matched coverage, and tested a confidence threshold with a finite-sample guarantee on the error rate among deployed predictions. Results: In MIMIC-IV, areas under the curve were 0.77-0.81 (prolonged stay) and 0.83-0.88 (mortality). Within each model, the rule's decisions matched deferral of the least-confident cases by C alone (99.4-100% agreement); E and S acted as model-level offsets, and re-optimized weights selected confidence alone. Computational E was not correlated with physician-rated utility (r = -0.15). The guaranteed threshold certified an error rate of at most 10% for 86-97% of mortality predictions but, for the primary prolonged-stay model, deployed on average only 15% of predictions at a 20% error budget, whereas the default rule deployed 77% with no error guarantee. Conclusions: Transparency is better suited to setting system-level error budgets than per-case thresholds; per case, autonomous deployment should rest on calibrated confidence with a certified error guarantee.

title: Predicting Cirrhotic Patients' Transition From Compensated to Decompensated Stage: A Graph-Based Multitask Deep Learning Method.

abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Cirrhosis is a chronic liver disease, manifested by fibrosis and regenerative nodules. It can be classified clinically as compensated or decompensated. Accurate predictions of patients' transition from compensated to decompensated cirrhosis are important but difficult because of the multifactorial nature of disease progression, comorbid conditions, and patient heterogeneity. To effectively identify at-risk patients with cirrhosis and facilitate timely interventions across chronic diseases and patient populations, this study aimed to develop a deep learning-based method to estimate patient transition from compensated to decompensated cirrhosis. The proposed method seeks to provide superior predictive utilities and help physicians derive actionable clinical insights by modeling comorbidity relationships and symptom interdependencies that influence the progression of cirrhosis among patients. The proposed method was guided by clinical knowledge, considers patient demographics and medications, and leverages a graph structure to capture important comorbidity interplays. This method was augmented with post hoc interpretability to help clinicians understand its predictions for clinical decision-making and patient management. Using clinical data from 29,915 patients with cirrhosis, we evaluated the proposed method in comparison with 12 prevalent methods. The proposed method attained an average area under the curve (AUC) of 0.871 (SD 0.004), F-measure of 0.678 (SD 0.010), recall of 0.741 (SD 0.022), and precision of 0.663 (SD 0.005). It showed a 6.09% improvement in AUC and a 13.95% improvement in F-measure over the best-performing benchmark method. Supported by post hoc interpretation analyses, this method can provide physicians with interpretable visualizations of the underlying comorbidity and symptom dynamics to better support their decision-making and adoption. Empirical results underscore the value of demographic similarity, comorbidity graphs, and extended loss functions for identifying patients at higher risk of decompensation by capturing finer-grained information from essential patient features that tend to be overlooked by most existing methods. The proposed method not only supports physicians' clinical decision-making and patient management but can also enhance health care organizations' resource allocation efficiency and cost containment.

title: A Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Question-Answering System for Chinese Patent Medicines in Pediatric Influenza: Development and Evaluation Study.
