abstract: [JMIR AI] Pediatric influenza is an important public health concern. Chinese patent medicines are used in its treatment, but relevant clinical evidence is dispersed across guidelines, expert consensus statements, and clinical studies. The multidimensional knowledge required for syndrome-based prescribing complicates information retrieval and standardized clinical use. This study aimed to develop a traceable knowledge graph of Chinese patent medicines for pediatric influenza, integrate it with a large language model (LLM) to support evidence-based question answering, and evaluate answer quality and preliminary usability. We systematically searched for clinical practice guidelines, expert consensus statements, and clinical studies. Evidence segmentation, ontology development, LLM-assisted extraction with manual verification, terminology normalization, and knowledge integration were used to construct a Neo4j knowledge graph. Structured graph retrieval was combined with retrieval-augmented generation to develop a question-answering system. A standalone LLM and the knowledge graph-enhanced LLM (KG-LLM) each answered 80 standardized questions. Three clinical experts independently evaluated anonymized, randomly ordered answers for core task accuracy, completeness, and unsupported factual content. Five physicians participated in an exploratory usability evaluation using the System Usability Scale (SUS), study-specific Likert items, and self-reported evidence-location outcomes. We included 142 publications and generated 1294 evidence units. The knowledge graph contained 3211 nodes and 19,671 relationships, linking structured knowledge to evidence units and source publications. Across 80 paired questions, KG-LLM achieved higher accuracy scores than the standalone LLM (mean 3.05, SD 1.88 vs mean 2.02, SD 1.54; Holm-adjusted P<.001) and higher completeness scores (mean 3.11, SD 1.84 vs mean 2.42, SD 1.62; adjusted P=.002). Among 78 pairs with determinate assessments, unsupported factual content was identified in 11 standalone LLM answers (14.1%) and no KG-LLM answers (0/78, 0%; adjusted P=.002). The mean SUS score was 96.50 (SD 2.85). Of 5 physicians, 4 (80%) reported locating both the original publication and the corresponding evidence. The traceable knowledge graph and graph-enhanced question-answering system integrated clinical evidence on Chinese patent medicines for pediatric influenza. KG-LLM achieved higher accuracy and completeness and less unsupported factual content o
zh_abstract: [JMIR AI] 儿童流感是重要的公共卫生问题。中成药用于其治疗，但相关临床证据分散于指南、专家共识声明和临床研究中。基于证候开方所需的多维知识使信息检索和标准化临床使用变得复杂。本研究旨在构建可溯源的儿童流感中成药知识图谱，将其与大语言模型（LLM）整合以支持循证问答，并评估回答质量和初步可用性。我们系统检索了临床实践指南、专家共识声明和临床研究。采用证据分段、本体构建、LLM辅助抽取结合人工核验、术语规范化和知识整合来构建Neo4j知识图谱。将结构化图谱检索与检索增强生成相结合，开发了问答系统。单独的LLM和知识图谱增强的LLM（KG-LLM）各自回答80个标准化问题。三名临床专家对匿名、随机排序的回答独立评估核心任务准确性、完整性和无依据的事实性内容。五名医生参与探索性可用性评估，使用系统可用性量表（SUS）、研究特定的Likert条目以及自报的证据定位结果。我们纳入142篇文献，生成1294个证据单元。知识图谱包含3211个节点和19,671条关系，将结构化知识与证据单元和来源文献相连接。在80个配对问题中，KG-LLM的准确性得分高于单独LLM（均值3.05，SD 1.88 对 均值2.02，SD 1.54；Holm校正P<.001），完整性得分也更高（均值3.11，SD 1.84 对 均值2.42，SD 1.62；校正P=.002）。在78个有明确评估结果的配对中，单独LLM有11个回答（14.1%）被发现含有无依据的事实性内容，KG-LLM则无（0/78，0%；校正P=.002）。SUS平均得分为96.50（SD 2.85）。5名医生中有4名（80%）报告能够同时找到原始文献和相应证据。该可溯源知识图谱及图谱增强问答系统整合了儿童流感中成药的临床证据。KG-LLM取得了更高的准确性和完整性，且无依据的事实性内容更少。

title: Modeling distinct pathogenesis of early- and late-onset preeclampsia via hierarchical representation learning of interactome.
zh_title: 互作组层级表征学习建模早发与晚发子痫前期发病机制
summary: 用可解释神经网络和大模型对互作组做层级表征学习，在开发177例、验证352例中识别早发与晚发子痫前期相关新基因。
key_points: 开发队列177例、验证队列352例
结合可视化神经网络、Grad-CAM与大模型
提出与HELLP、绒毛膜羊膜炎相似的候选基因
reason: 样本量较小，基因发现偏探索，缺少独立外部验证
abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] We developed and validated the pathogenesis models by hierarchical representation learning of interactomes connecting endometrial maturation, placentation, chorioamnionitis, and hemolysis, elevated liver enzyme, and low platelet (HELLP) syndrome. We utilized 19 gene sets from our previous work to infer interactomes to develop (n = 177) and validate (n = 352) explainable artificial intelligence models for each preeclampsia subtype using deep-insight visible neural network, gradient-weighted class activation mapping, and large language model. The hierarchically learned representations identified novel genes for late-onset preeclampsia (LOPE), similar to chorioamnionitis (ANKRD13A, SLA), and HELLP syndrome (PDE5A). We also identified novel genes for early-onset preeclampsia (EOPE), similar to HELLP syndrome (SWAP70, GREM2, GPR146, PIP5K1B, EZR). Our pathogenesis models connected HELLP syndrome with both LOPE and EOPE. However, chorioamnionitis was only connected with LOPE.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 我们通过对连接子宫内膜成熟、胎盘形成、绒毛膜羊膜炎以及溶血、肝酶升高和血小板减少（HELLP）综合征的相互作用组进行层次化表征学习，开发并验证了发病机制模型。我们利用既往工作中的 19 个基因集推断相互作用组，并使用 deep-insight 可视化神经网络、梯度加权类激活映射和大语言模型，针对每种子痫前期亚型开发（n = 177）并验证（n = 352）可解释人工智能模型。层次化学习到的表征识别出晚发型子痫前期（LOPE）中与绒毛膜羊膜炎相似的新基因（ANKRD13A、SLA）以及与 HELLP 综合征相似的新基因（PDE5A）。我们还识别出早发型子痫前期（EOPE）中与 HELLP 综合征相似的新基因（SWAP70、GREM2、GPR146、PIP5K1B、EZR）。我们的发病机制模型将 HELLP 综合征与 LOPE 和 EOPE 均联系起来，而绒毛膜羊膜炎仅与 LOPE 相联系。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Sentiment Analysis in Pregnancy-Related Weight Discussions on Reddit: Human Performance-Aligned Comparative Evaluation Study.
zh_title: 大模型对孕期体重相关Reddit讨论的情感分析基准评估
summary: 整理15619条Reddit帖文，以200条专家共识为参照，在150条测试集上评估10个模型与专家判断的一致性。
key_points: 15619条帖文，200条共识参考集
固定测试集150条评估10个模型
关注与专家一致性及解释歧义
reason: 小规模测试集，无外部临床验证，增量档
abstract: [JMIR formative research] Pregnancy-related weight gain is both physiologically complex and socially charged, and online discussions often combine clinical information with implicit emotional distress. Although automated sentiment analysis could support research on pregnancy-related discourse, model performance in this context remains inadequately characterized relative to expert human judgment. This study aimed to benchmark contemporary sentiment classification models on pregnancy-related weight discussions, with emphasis on agreement with expert consensus, interpretive ambiguity, task adaptation, and deployment across posts and comments. We curated 15,619 Reddit posts and comments using a large language model (LLM)-guided keyword expansion strategy and established an adjudicated consensus reference set of 200 posts. We evaluated 10 models on a fixed held-out test set (N=150) using aligned text inputs, weighted performance metrics, and 1000-resample bootstrap CIs. RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers Approach) and BERTweet (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers for Tweets) were additionally evaluated in a 5-fold fine-tuning sensitivity analysis. Gemini-3-Flash (Google DeepMind [Google LLC]) and Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT)-OSS (OpenAI) were then applied to 400 unlabeled posts and 15,019 comments with intermodel agreement assessment. To expand expert-labeled coverage, a separate 106-post annotation extension was used for secondary evaluation of the 2 models carried forward to post-level corpus inference, and cross-source recoverability of the API-derived retrieval was assessed using Arctic Shift (Arthur Heitmann). The 2 primary experts (FAK and BMW) achieved 59.0% preadjudication agreement (Cohen κ=0.344). In the fixed held-out comparison, Gemini-3-Flash had the numerically highest weighted F1-score of 0.662 (κ=0.478), followed by GPT-OSS (F1-score=0.645; κ=0.436), with overlapping CIs across leading models. Under the harmonized direct-argmax decision rule with minimally processed text, BERTweet achieved an F1-score of 0.623 (κ=0.369), and RoBERTa achieved an F1-score of 0.605 (κ=0.339). In the separate fine-tuning sensitivity analysis, the mean cross-validated F1-score was 0.708 (SD 0.087) for RoBERTa and 0.616 (SD 0.079) for BERTweet. Among Gemini-3-Flash errors, 55.8% (29/52) occurred in posts on which the 2 primary experts disagreed. In the 106-post annotation extension, primary-expert agreement was 64.
zh_abstract: [JMIR formative research] 妊娠相关体重增加在生理上复杂，在社会层面上也颇受关注，网络讨论常将临床信息与隐含的情绪困扰混杂在一起。尽管自动化情感分析可为妊娠相关话语研究提供支持，但与专家人工判断相比，模型在这一情境下的表现仍缺乏充分刻画。本研究旨在以妊娠相关体重讨论为对象，对当代情感分类模型进行基准测试，重点关注与专家共识的一致性、解释上的歧义、任务适配，以及在帖子和评论中的部署。我们采用大语言模型（LLM）引导的关键词扩展策略整理了15,619条Reddit帖子和评论，并建立了包含200条帖子的经裁定共识参考集。我们在固定留出测试集（N=150）上，使用对齐的文本输入、加权性能指标和1000次重采样的bootstrap置信区间，评估了10个模型。另外，在5折微调敏感性分析中评估了RoBERTa（Robustly Optimized Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers Approach）和BERTweet（Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers for Tweets）。随后将Gemini-3-Flash（Google DeepMind [Google LLC]）和Generative Pretrained Transformer（GPT）-OSS（OpenAI）应用于400条未标注帖子和15,019条评论，并评估模型间一致性。为扩大专家标注的覆盖范围，使用另外106条帖子的标注扩展集，对进入帖子层面语料推断的2个模型进行二次评估，并使用Arctic Shift（Arthur Heitmann）评估基于API获取数据的跨来源可复现性。2位主要专家（FAK和BMW）在裁定前的一致率为59.0%（Cohen κ=0.344）。在固定留出集比较中，Gemini-3-Flash的加权F1分数在数值上最高，为0.662（κ=0.478），其次为GPT-OSS（F1分数=0.645；κ=0.436），领先模型之间的置信区间相互重叠。在统一的直接argmax决策规则和最小化文本处理条件下，BERTweet的F1分数为0.623（κ=0.369），RoBERTa的F1分数为0.605（κ=0.339）。在单独的微调敏感性分析中，RoBERTa的平均交叉验证F1分数为0.708（SD 0.087），BERTweet为0.616（SD 0.079）。在Gemini-3-Flash的错误中，55.8%（29/52）发生在2位主要专家意见不一致的帖子上。在106条帖子的标注扩展集中，主要专家一致率为64.

title: Gender-Stratified Transmission Model for Multi-Type HPV with Multivalent Vaccines: PINN Calibration and Optimal Vaccination Strategies for China.
zh_title: 基于PINN的中国多型HPV性别分层传播模型与疫苗策略
summary: 构建性别分层多价HPV传播模型，用MLP-PINN基于2010-2023年中国数据校准参数，并分析最优接种策略。
key_points: 涵盖二价、四价、九价疫苗
PINN将常微分方程作为损失约束进行校准
使用中国人口与宫颈癌患病率数据
reason: 建模研究，方法增量，缺乏外部验证信息
abstract: [Mathematical biosciences] The transmission and prevention of human papillomavirus (HPV) require a rigorous mathematical framework reflecting multivalent vaccines and gender heterogeneous dynamics. This study establishes a gender-stratified multivalent HPV transmission model, including three core viral type groups and three vaccine valencies (bivalent, quadrivalent, nonavalent). To estimate complex time-varying epidemiological parameters, an MLP-based Physics-Informed Neural Network (MLP-PINN) is selected based on ablation experiments. By embedding governing ordinary differential equations as physical constraints in the loss function, this deep learning architecture is used for model calibration using Chinese demographic and cervical cancer prevalence data from 2010 to 2023. Theoretically, we rigorously prove the model's well-posedness, derive the basic reproduction number, and analyze the stability of the disease-free equilibrium and uniform persistence of the system. Numerical simulations confirm that vaccination reduces female infection burden and provides indirect protection to males. Using Pontryagin's Maximum Principle, we formulate an optimal control problem to evaluate multi-vaccine allocation strategies. The optimal control results show that the nonavalent vaccine plays a central role in protection across the three modeled HPV groups: the nonavalent-only strategy achieves the greatest disease burden reduction, whereas the bivalent-nonavalent combination provides a favorable balance between the two model-derived indicators under the assumptions of the present model.
zh_abstract: [数学生物科学] 人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）的传播与预防需要一个反映多价疫苗和性别异质性动态的严谨数学框架。本研究建立了一个按性别分层的多价 HPV 传播模型，包括三个核心病毒型别组和三种疫苗价型（二价、四价、九价）。为估计复杂的随时间变化的流行病学参数，基于消融实验选择了基于多层感知机的物理信息神经网络（MLP-PINN）。通过将控制常微分方程作为物理约束嵌入损失函数，该深度学习架构被用于利用 2010 年至 2023 年中国人口和宫颈癌患病数据进行模型校准。在理论上，我们严格证明了模型的适定性，推导了基本再生数，并分析了无病平衡点的稳定性和系统的一致持久性。数值模拟证实，疫苗接种可降低女性感染负担，并为男性提供间接保护。我们利用庞特里亚金极大值原理构建了最优控制问题，以评估多种疫苗的分配策略。最优控制结果显示，九价疫苗在所建模的三个 HPV 组的保护中起核心作用：仅使用九价疫苗的策略可实现最大的疾病负担降低，而二价—九价组合在本模型假设下，在两个由模型导出的指标之间提供了较为有利的平衡。

title: Evidence-Conditioned Completion and Synthesis of Electronic Health Records
zh_title: EHRDiB：证据条件化的电子病历补全与合成
summary: 提出EHRDiB，用共享多模态表征与证据条件化潜在扩散桥统一EHR就诊补全与合成，在MIMIC-IV和Duke数据上对比多种方法（预印本）。
key_points: 区分原始缺失与人为屏蔽输入
对比3种补全与8种合成方法
补全多数对比中与真实数据分类器差距最小
reason: 有新意方法且基线对比充分，但为预印本、证据有限
abstract: Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. In synthesis, AUPRC gaps were 45.2% smaller for ten MIMIC-IV principal-diagnosis targets and 53.3% smaller for numerical Duke Health data relative to the best comparator. Synthesis with calibrated thresholding yielded the lowest marginal distribution error across all three datasets, with Coverage above 0.95 for both output rules. Across twelve evidence-fraction intervals in MIMIC-IV synthesis, membership-inference AUROC increased from 0.516 to 0.598 as the mean target evidence fraction rose from 0.20 to 0.50; utility gaps narrowed relative to the lowest evidence configuration but did not decrease monotonically. Our study provides a unified framework and empirical foundation for EHR generation that considers both its utility for clinical analysis and its information disclosure risk.
zh_abstract: 患者信息可以指导电子健康档案（EHR）的生成，但其信息量如何影响预测效用和信息披露风险，目前仍缺乏充分刻画。本文提出EHRDiB，该方法通过区分原始缺失与被保留的输入，并将共享的多模态表示与以证据为条件的潜在扩散桥（latent diffusion bridge）相结合，统一了就诊记录补全与合成。我们在MIMIC-IV以及数值型和离散化的Duke Health表示上，将EHRDiB与三种补全方法和八种合成方法进行了比较。评估涵盖两项任务的下游预测效用、生成多样性和分布保真度，以及合成任务的信息披露风险。在八项补全比较中的七项中，EHRDiB相对于以真实数据训练的分类器取得了最小的效用差距。在合成方面，相对于最佳对照方法，十个MIMIC-IV主要诊断目标的AUPRC差距缩小45.2%，数值型Duke Health数据缩小53.3%。采用校准阈值的合成在全部三个数据集中产生了最低的边际分布误差，两种输出规则下的覆盖率（Coverage）均高于0.95。在MIMIC-IV合成的十二个证据比例区间中，随着平均目标证据比例从0.20升至0.50，成员推断AUROC从0.516升至0.598；相对于最低证据配置，效用差距有所缩小，但并非单调下降。本研究为同时考虑临床分析效用及信息披露风险的EHR生成提供了统一框架和实证基础。

title: Multimodal AI in Healthcare: Review of Vision-Language Foundation Models for Real-World Medical Applications
zh_title: 医疗多模态AI：视觉-语言基础模型综述
summary: 综述医疗视觉-语言基础模型，给出分类体系并讨论其在影像解读、报告生成和问答等真实医疗应用中的潜力。
key_points: 聚焦视觉-语言基础模型
利用现有报告与影像减少人工标注依赖
提出医学VLM的分类体系
reason: 综述类上限6分，主题契合读者方向但属综述
abstract: The emergence of foundation models has marked a transformative shift in AI, enabling robust generalization across diverse downstream tasks through putative zero-shot learning. Large Language Models and Vision Language Models have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks such as image interpretation, report generation, and question answering by effectively learning from multimodal data-images paired with associated text often with minimal supervision. In the healthcare domain, this ability to align visual and textual information reduces the reliance on extensive manual annotations, as models can leverage existing clinical reports and imaging data to learn meaningful representations. This integration holds promise for improving diagnostic support, treatment planning, and overall patient care, even in data constrained settings. In this review, we provide a definitive taxonomy of the medical VLM landscape, tracing the evolution from early Contrastive Alignment and Generative MLLMs to the cutting edge frontiers of Dense Pixel Grounding, Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and Reasoning Incentivized (RL) architectures. We critically examine the "medical bottleneck" identifying the persistent challenges of data scarcity, the "hallucination" risks in generative diagnostics, the computational strain of 3D volumetric processing, and the lack of standardized, clinically grounded evaluation metrics.
zh_abstract: 基础模型的出现标志着人工智能领域的一次变革性转变，其通过所谓的零样本学习，使模型能够在多种下游任务中实现稳健的泛化。大语言模型（Large Language Models）和视觉语言模型（Vision Language Models）通过有效地从多模态数据（即与相关文本配对的图像）中学习，往往只需极少的监督，就在图像解读、报告生成和问答等任务中展现出强大的能力。在医疗健康领域，这种对齐视觉与文本信息的能力减少了对大量人工标注的依赖，因为模型可以利用现有的临床报告和影像数据来学习有意义的表征。即使在数据受限的情况下，这种整合也有望改善诊断支持、治疗规划和整体患者照护。在本综述中，我们对医学视觉语言模型（VLM）领域提出了一个明确的分类体系，追溯了从早期的对比对齐（Contrastive Alignment）和生成式多模态大语言模型（Generative MLLMs），到密集像素定位（Dense Pixel Grounding）、稀疏专家混合（Sparse Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）和推理激励（Reasoning Incentivized, RL）架构等前沿方向的演进。我们批判性地审视了“医学瓶颈”，指出其中长期存在的挑战，包括数据稀缺、生成式诊断中的“幻觉”风险、三维容积处理的计算压力，以及缺乏标准化且以临床为基础的评估指标。

title: Offline-First Quantized AI: Design and Evaluation of an On-Device Maternal-Health Assistant for Low-Connectivity Environments
zh_title: 离线优先量化AI：低连接环境下的孕产妇健康设备端助手
summary: 设计并评估集成量化语言模型与本地知识包的安卓离线孕产妇健康助手，比较Gemma与Qwen。
key_points: 45段对话、每配置312轮，含离线智能体基准
Gemma质量与安全更高，Qwen更快更省内存
150条Gemma回复中147条达接受标准
reason: 预印本，有临床医生评估与部署，规模有限
abstract: Offline language models could extend access to maternal-health information where internet connectivity is unreliable, but deployment requires both clinically appropriate responses and feasible local execution. This study presents an offline Android assistant integrating ready-made quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, conversational context, and model-initiated local retrieval. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 0.8B were compared across 45 conversations and 312 turns per configuration, including a dedicated offline agentic benchmark. Gemma achieved higher response-quality, context-retention, and safety scores; Qwen offered faster generation and lower memory use. Clinician assessment of 150 Gemma responses across nine clinical domains yielded a mean quality score of 3.80/4, with 147 responses meeting the acceptance criterion. A paired RAG-on/off experiment evaluated 74 questions: retrieval improved 11 responses, left 56 neutral, produced four adverse response changes, and left three pairs unassessable. RAG-on had descriptively higher mean usefulness, safety, correctness, and actionability in the conditional 70-pair subset excluding the four flagged pairs from both conditions. Physical-device testing demonstrated offline responses on a 6 GB Android handset, with a 14.3 s median latency, alongside successful reconnection synchronization in the integrated application. Together, the findings document clinical response quality and practical performance of the integrated offline maternal-health assistant.

title: What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment
zh_title: 跨模态对齐的关键因素：含胸片与CT的零配对分析
summary: 在五个数据集、四种模态上测试零配对对齐，仅COCO成功；医学影像最难，并提出LightAlign用少量图文对实现对齐。
key_points: 零配对对齐仅在COCO成功，其余四个数据集失败
医学影像共享子空间方差占比最小，最难对齐
LightAlign仅需少量图文对即可对齐
reason: 有新意的预印本分析，含医学影像多模态，证据有限
abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different modalities converge toward a shared representation. Related work aligns frozen image and text encoders on natural images without paired data. We test zero-pair alignment on five datasets across four modalities: natural images, environmental audio, chest radiographs, and 3D computed tomography (CT). It succeeds only on COCO and fails on the other four. We analyze the failures and find that alignment must first locate the subspace where the modalities co-vary and then orient the mapping within it. Consistent with previous studies, medical imaging is the hardest case: its shared subspace carries the smallest fraction of the variance. When this fraction is small, alignment needs image-text pairs, and random-matrix theory predicts how many pairs are needed. These findings motivate LightAlign: a few pairs let a ridge regression between two frozen encoders locate and orient the mapping simultaneously, and a classifier fitted only on report text then predicts findings from the mapped images. On 3D CT, LightAlign surpasses models trained end to end on image-report pairs without finding-level labels: with only 200 pairs, LightAlign outperforms CT-CLIP on CT-RATE (0.754 vs. 0.733 AUROC), and with only 100 CT-RATE pairs, it does so on RAD-ChestCT, an out-of-distribution dataset from a different hospital. On CheXpert, it reaches 0.862 mean AUROC with only about 5% as many pairs as models trained on MIMIC-CXR.

title: Objectify, Don't Delete: Complaint-Derived Evaluation of Ambient Clinical Notes
zh_title: 投诉衍生的AI临床笔记评估：重构而非删除
summary: 提出对从临床医生投诉中挖掘的复合评估标准进行“客观化”改写，拆成可判定的决策，用于评估环境式AI临床笔记。
key_points: ROUGE与专家清单未能反映医生实际投诉
高频投诉多为复合问题，LLM评判难以执行
客观化步骤将其改写为范围明确的判定集
reason: 有新意的评估方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Evaluating the quality of AI-generated clinical notes is hard: standard metrics like ROUGE measure lexical similarity to reference notes, while expert checklists encode what committees believe matters. Neither captures what clinicians actually complain about. Recent work has shown that evaluation criteria can be mined from user feedback and filtered to criteria that LLM judges can reliably enforce. We argue that this is where much of the value is lost. The criteria that fail enforceability are disproportionately the ones clinicians raise most often, because high-frequency complaints are stated as several questions glued together. No yes/no judgment can grade such composites as posed. We introduce an objectification step that rewrites such criteria into sets of scoped, determinate decisions. We demonstrate the approach through an evaluation pipeline that mines criteria from complaints, objectifies them, and deploys LLM judges against both planted defects and production notes. Across eleven defects planted into ACI-bench reference notes, objectified judges localize violations with median recall of 0.95, while reference metrics change by at most 0.037. Given the complaint as one broad question, the same judges still find every planted defect, but they also flag 70% of the unperturbed reference notes; one section-pair question per call raises Youden's J from 0.30 to 0.72 (by 0.19 to 0.26 with prompt effort matched). We release ACI-Defect, a perturbation benchmark; clinician-reviewed instance-level labels showing quality gaps in the ACI-bench gold standard (32 of 40 notes contain hallucinations; 40 of 40 omit discussed facts); and grounding-judge verdicts. On 1,446 production notes, mean instance-rate burden falls at every clinician-rating step (rho=-0.15), a small association. Defect counts have to be kept per span rather than collapsed into one pass/fail bit per note.
zh_abstract: 评估 AI 生成临床病历的质量很困难：ROUGE 等标准指标衡量的是与参考病历的词汇相似度，而专家清单体现的是委员会认为重要的内容。二者都无法反映临床医生实际抱怨的问题。近期研究表明，评估标准可以从用户反馈中挖掘，并筛选为大语言模型（LLM）评判者能够可靠执行的标准。我们认为，大量价值正是在这一步流失的。无法被可靠执行的标准，恰恰不成比例地是临床医生最常提出的那些，因为高频抱怨往往被表述为若干问题的拼接。没有任何是/否判断能够按原样对这类复合问题评分。我们引入一个客观化步骤，将此类标准改写为一组范围明确、可确定判断的决策。我们通过一个评估流程来展示该方法：从抱怨中挖掘标准，将其客观化，并让 LLM 评判者针对人为植入的缺陷和生产环境中的病历进行评估。在植入 ACI-bench 参考病历的十一种缺陷中，客观化后的评判者定位违规的召回率中位数为 0.95，而参考指标的变化至多为 0.037。若将抱怨作为一个宽泛问题提出，同样的评判者仍能发现每一种植入缺陷，但也会标记 70% 未被扰动的参考病历；每次调用只问一个章节对问题可使 Youden's J 从 0.30 提高到 0.72（在提示投入匹配的情况下提高 0.19 至 0.26）。我们发布了 ACI-Defect（一个扰动基准）；经临床医生审核的实例级标签，显示 ACI-bench 金标准存在质量缺口（40 份病历中有 32 份含有幻觉；40 份全部遗漏了讨论过的事实）；以及依据性（grounding）评判者的判定结果。在 1,446 份生产环境病历上，实例率负担的均值在临床医生评分的每一级都随之下降（rho=-0.15），关联较小。缺陷计数必须按片段（span）分别保留，而不能压缩为每份病历一个通过/不通过的比特。

title: Bioformer-RetroMAE: retrieval-oriented pretraining of a compact biomedical language model for literature search
zh_title: Bioformer-RetroMAE：面向文献检索的紧凑生物医学语言模型
summary: 在约3200万PubMed摘要上以RetroMAE继续预训练43M参数编码器，在BioASQ 12B检索上优于BioBERT和PubMedBERT双编码器。
key_points: 43M参数，面向检索的预训练
BioASQ 12B全PubMed检索评估
相同设置下各指标优于基线
reason: 有基线对比的新方法，紧凑领域模型，证据有限
abstract: Dense retrieval is increasingly used for biomedical literature search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Most biomedical bi-encoders are built on BERTBase-sized encoders pretrained with masked language modeling (MLM). These encoders are costly for corpus-scale indexing and latency-sensitive query encoding, and MLM does not explicitly train the [CLS] vector that a bi-encoder uses to represent a whole text. We present Bioformer-RetroMAE, a compact (43M-parameter) retrieval-oriented biomedical encoder obtained by continually pretraining Bioformer8L} with RetroMAE on approximately 32 million PubMed titles and abstracts. After bi-encoder fine-tuning with BM25 hard negatives, we evaluated it on BioASQ Task 12B test questions by retrieving from all PubMed abstracts. Bioformer-RetroMAE outperformed BioBERT and PubMedBERT bi-encoders fine-tuned under identical settings on all metrics, despite having about 40% of their parameters and producing 512-dimensional rather than 768-dimensional vectors. Compared with PubMedBERT, it improved mean average precision (MAP) by 37.0% and Recall@100 by 29.1%. Compared with the original Bioformer8L}, RetroMAE pretraining improved MAP by 53.6% and Recall@100 by 32.8% without changing model size or inference cost. In hybrid retrieval, fusing Bioformer-RetroMAE with BM25 through weighted reciprocal rank fusion improved MAP and NDCG@10 over BM25 alone by 4.9% and 4.6%, respectively, larger gains than those obtained by fusing BM25 with PubMedBERT or BioBERT.
zh_abstract: 稠密检索越来越多地用于生物医学文献检索和检索增强生成（RAG）。大多数生物医学双编码器（bi-encoder）基于采用掩码语言建模（MLM）预训练的 BERTBase 规模编码器构建。这类编码器在语料库规模的索引构建和对延迟敏感的查询编码方面成本较高，而且 MLM 并未显式训练双编码器用来表示整段文本的 [CLS] 向量。我们提出 Bioformer-RetroMAE，这是一种紧凑（4300 万参数）、面向检索的生物医学编码器，通过在约 3200 万条 PubMed 标题和摘要上，用 RetroMAE 对 Bioformer8L 进行持续预训练获得。在使用 BM25 困难负例进行双编码器微调后，我们在 BioASQ Task 12B 测试问题上，通过从全部 PubMed 摘要中检索对其进行了评估。在相同设置下微调的 BioBERT 和 PubMedBERT 双编码器相比，Bioformer-RetroMAE 在所有指标上均更优，尽管其参数量仅约为它们的 40%，且生成的是 512 维而非 768 维向量。与 PubMedBERT 相比，其平均精度均值（MAP）提高 37.0%，Recall@100 提高 29.1%。与原始 Bioformer8L 相比，RetroMAE 预训练在不改变模型大小或推理成本的情况下，使 MAP 提高 53.6%，Recall@100 提高 32.8%。在混合检索中，通过加权倒数排名融合（weighted reciprocal rank fusion）将 Bioformer-RetroMAE 与 BM25 融合，相比单独使用 BM25，MAP 和 NDCG@10 分别提高 4.9% 和 4.6%，其增益大于将 BM25 与 PubMedBERT 或 BioBERT 融合所获得的增益。

title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
zh_title: OpenAI推出ChatGPT for Healthcare新功能
summary: OpenAI介绍面向医疗的ChatGPT新增计算机操作智能体、改进的临床回答及跨医疗软件的插件。
key_points: 新增computer-use智能体
改进临床问答
新增医疗软件插件
reason: 厂商产品功能更新，无评测数据

title: Integrating Unsupervised Clustering with Transformer-Based Models for De Novo Cell Population Identification
zh_title: 无监督聚类结合Transformer模型识别新细胞群体
summary: 通过微调预训练Geneformer构建Nankai GeneRank分类器，并结合无监督聚类，识别训练数据中未预定义的细胞群体。
key_points: 微调预训练Geneformer模型
结合无监督聚类做从头细胞群识别
针对训练集注释不全问题
reason: 单细胞基础模型微调的新方法预印本，证据有限；领域偏好小幅加分
abstract: Single-cell transcriptome sequencing has been widely applied across the life sciences. It enables accurate and robust identification of cell types in heterogeneous biological tissues through unsupervised clustering, shallow learning, and deep learning. While deep learning does not outperform shallow learning in classification performance, it streamlines cell type identification by eliminating cumbersome preprocessing procedures. However, the availability of training datasets with comprehensive cell type annotations is always limited, so new datasets inevitably contain cell populations that are not pre-defined in the training data. To address this limitation, we integrated unsupervised clustering with transformer-based models to identify cell populations unrecognized by classical methods. Specifically, we developed the Nankai GeneRank Classifier by fine-tuning the pre-trained Geneformer-V1 model, and then clustered cells based on its softmax-normalized class probability matrix (SCPM). Applied to a public colorectal cancer dataset, the new method, named SCPM-based clustering, resolved cell populations that cannot be unambiguously identified by classical methods alone and led to the discovery of novel candidate markers of colorectal cancer stem cells, demonstrating its utility.
zh_abstract: 单细胞转录组测序已在生命科学领域得到广泛应用。通过无监督聚类、浅层学习和深度学习，它能够准确而稳健地识别异质性生物组织中的细胞类型。虽然深度学习在分类性能上并不优于浅层学习，但它省去了繁琐的预处理步骤，从而简化了细胞类型识别。然而，具有全面细胞类型注释的训练数据集始终有限，因此新数据集中不可避免地含有训练数据中未预先定义的细胞群。为解决这一局限，我们将无监督聚类与基于 Transformer 的模型相结合，以识别经典方法无法识别的细胞群。具体而言，我们通过微调预训练的 Geneformer-V1 模型开发了 Nankai GeneRank Classifier，然后基于其经 softmax 归一化的类别概率矩阵（softmax-normalized class probability matrix，SCPM）对细胞进行聚类。将这一新方法（称为基于 SCPM 的聚类）应用于一个公开的结直肠癌数据集，它解析出了仅靠经典方法无法明确识别的细胞群，并发现了结直肠癌干细胞的新候选标志物，证明了其实用性。

title: Revealing the transcriptomic organization of extrasomatic interfaces using SCOUBI
zh_title: SCOUBI：从空间转录组胞外RNA解析轴突-树突界面
summary: 提出SCOUBI计算框架，利用空间转录组中胞体外的RNA划分轴突与树突富集区并识别二者界面。
key_points: 脑空间转录组中可达一半转录本位于胞体外
用神经网络基于标志基因划分轴突/树突区室
以二者区室汇聚位点定义界面
reason: 新颖的空间转录组方法，预印本，证据有限
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) generates substantial transcript signal outside segmented cell bodies, which is generally discarded by analysis tools. This is especially problematic for brain ST data, as neuronal mRNAs can be localized far from somata - in axons, dendrites, and synaptic compartments - and up to half of the transcripts in ST data may lie outside cell bodies. Here, we present SCOUBI, a computational framework that identifies axon-dendrite interfaces from extrasomatic RNA in ST data, revealing a hitherto overlooked layer of molecular function in neural tissues. It first partitions extrasomatic space into axon- and dendrite-enriched compartments based on known marker genes, using a neural network trained to maximize marker specificity and inter-compartment communication signals. It then defines interfaces as loci where predicted axonal and dendritic compartments converge and exhibit ligand-receptor colocalization. Applied to mouse brain, SCOUBI creates maps of axonal and dendritic compartments and their interfaces that align with known spatial patterns of neurite and synaptic distribution. It identifies transcriptomic differences between interfaces and the surrounding extrasomatic space, revealing region-specific signatures of neuronal signaling and synaptic plasticity. By comparing interface transcript enrichment with local somatic expression, SCOUBI identifies genes that preferentially localize at sites of intercellular communication rather than simply reflecting nearby cell bodies. SCOUBI reveals interface-associated transcripts beyond established synaptic genes, with molecular signatures reproducible across independent samples and imaging platforms. In summary, SCOUBI transforms a substantial and often-discarded aspect of ST data into an interpretable readout of subcellular organization and neural signaling.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（ST）会产生大量位于已分割细胞体之外的转录本信号，而分析工具通常会将其舍弃。这对脑部 ST 数据尤其成问题，因为神经元 mRNA 可定位于远离胞体的位置——轴突、树突和突触区室——ST 数据中多达一半的转录本可能位于细胞体之外。在此，我们提出 SCOUBI，这是一个根据 ST 数据中的胞外体（extrasomatic）RNA 识别轴突-树突界面的计算框架，揭示了神经组织中此前被忽视的一层分子功能。它首先基于已知标志基因，利用一个以最大化标志物特异性和区室间通信信号为目标训练的神经网络，将胞体外空间划分为富含轴突和富含树突的区室；随后将界面定义为预测的轴突区室与树突区室汇聚且表现出配体-受体共定位的位点。应用于小鼠脑时，SCOUBI 生成的轴突和树突区室及其界面图谱与已知的神经突和突触分布空间模式一致。它识别出界面与周围胞体外空间之间的转录组差异，揭示了神经元信号传导和突触可塑性的区域特异性特征。通过比较界面转录本富集与局部胞体表达，SCOUBI 识别出优先定位于细胞间通信位点、而非仅仅反映邻近细胞体的基因。SCOUBI 揭示了已知突触基因之外的界面相关转录本，其分子特征在独立样本和成像平台间均可重复。总之，SCOUBI 将 ST 数据中大量且常被舍弃的部分转化为可解释的亚细胞组织和神经信号传导读数。

title: Know Thy Neighbour: Benchmarking Protein Language Model Embedding-Based Annotation Reveals Anisotropy Substantially Impacts Retrieval
zh_title: 蛋白语言模型嵌入注释基准：各向异性显著影响检索
summary: 对12个蛋白语言模型嵌入用于远缘同源检索进行基准测试，并与MMseqs2、Foldseek比较，发现各向异性影响检索。
key_points: 在Swiss-Prot和SCOPe数据集上评测
固定1%假阳性率阈值
未经检索训练的pLM最多召回15%远缘同源
reason: 规范基准评测有新见解，预印本
abstract: Functional annotation using protein language models (`pLMs') usually proceeds by transferring the function of a query's nearest neighbour in a reference database. A major drawback is that embedding-based annotation transfer has no null model, i.e. no accepted way to set a cosine-similarity threshold to control false positives. This contrasts with traditional bioinformatics methods, including sequence- and structure-based alignment tools, which rank hits with E-values derived from explicit null models. Here, we benchmark final-layer, mean-pooled embeddings from twelve models against MMseqs2 and Foldseek for remote-homology retrieval on curated datasets based on Swiss-Prot and SCOPe, fixing per-model thresholds at a 1% false-positive rate and probing the score with a ladder of synthetic decoys. On Swiss-Prot, pLMs without retrieval training recover at most 15% of remote homologs at this operating point, against 85% for MMseqs2, and for the ESM-2 and ESM-C families shuffled decoys have higher cosine similarities to their nearest database hits than real remote homologs do. These two pLM families exhibit extreme anisotropy, using fewer than 15 effective dimensions out of 640-2560, and low effective dimensionality is strongly associated with poor performance across models. Applying ZCA whitening, fit on the reference database, to the embeddings sharply raises threshold-free Top-1 superfamily retrieval, e.g. for ESM-2 650M from 59% to 88% on SCOPe, and generally improves remote homology sensitivity at a fixed false-positive rate. As correcting embedding anisotropy requires only the reference database and is compute cheap, it should be considered and tested for any pLM embedding-based annotation task.
zh_abstract: 使用蛋白质语言模型（pLM）进行功能注释通常是将查询序列在参考数据库中最近邻的功能进行转移。一个主要缺陷是，基于嵌入的注释转移没有零模型，即没有公认的方法来设定余弦相似度阈值以控制假阳性。这与传统生物信息学方法（包括基于序列和结构的比对工具）形成对比，后者利用由明确零模型推导的E值对匹配结果排序。在此，我们在基于Swiss-Prot和SCOPe整理的数据集上，以MMseqs2和Foldseek为对照，对十二个模型的末层、均值池化嵌入进行远缘同源检索的基准测试，将各模型的阈值固定在1%假阳性率，并用一系列梯度化的合成诱饵探查该得分。在Swiss-Prot上，未经检索训练的pLM在该工作点最多仅能找回15%的远缘同源序列，而MMseqs2为85%；对于ESM-2和ESM-C系列，打乱序列的诱饵与其数据库中最近匹配的余弦相似度高于真实远缘同源序列。这两个pLM系列表现出极端的各向异性，在640–2560维中使用的有效维度不足15个，并且低有效维度与各模型的不良表现密切相关。对嵌入应用基于参考数据库拟合的ZCA白化，可显著提高不依赖阈值的Top-1超家族检索表现，例如ESM-2 650M在SCOPe上从59%提高到88%，并且总体上改善了固定假阳性率下的远缘同源灵敏度。由于校正嵌入各向异性只需要参考数据库且计算成本低，对于任何基于pLM嵌入的注释任务，都应考虑并测试这一方法。

title: An apicomplexan-specific foundation model improves prediction of regulatory genomic signals in Plasmodium falciparum
zh_title: 顶复门特异基础模型改进恶性疟原虫调控基因组信号预测
summary: 在76种顶复门生物455个基因组上预训练GPN，并微调预测恶性疟原虫表观基因组特征，检验小基因组预训练的价值。
key_points: 掩码核苷酸重建预训练
预测TF结合、染色质可及性等
在留出染色体上评估
reason: 领域基础模型预印本，有新意但证据有限
abstract: Genomic foundation models learn transferable sequence representations through self-supervision, yet their practical value is contested. In data-rich mammalian genomes, task-specific models trained from scratch can match or exceed pretrained models on many regulatory prediction tasks. Whether self-supervised pretraining provides an advantage in small, data-sparse genomes has not been directly tested. We address this in the compact, 23Mbp, A/T-rich genome of the malaria parasite, Plasmodium falciparum. We trained a Genomic Pretrained Network (GPN) via masked-nucleotide reconstruction on 455 genome assemblies spanning 76 apicomplexan species. We then fine-tuned the model to predict a variety of epigenomic features in a held-out chromosome, including transcription factor binding sites, chromatin-accessibility, histone modifications, and 10 chromatin states. Pretraining followed by fine tuning improved prediction of most features, with most of the benefit concentrated on datasets with relatively little labeled data (fewer than 3,000 training examples). In contrast, a human-pretrained model transferred poorly, indicating that phylogenetically relevant pretraining, not foundation-model status alone, drives beneficial performance. Self-supervised pretraining on clade-specific assemblies is thus a practical route to data-efficient regulatory modeling in small genomes where training data is scarce.

title: YOLO11m-Based Artificial Intelligence Versus Orthopaedic Physician Panels for Arthroscopy-Referenced Three-Category MRI Classification of the Posterosuperior Rotator Cuff: A Multi-Reader Diagnostic Accuracy Study.
zh_title: YOLO11m模型与骨科医师组对肩袖MRI三分类的比较
summary: 单中心回顾性研究，以关节镜为参照，比较YOLO11m模型与不同经验医师组对冈上/冈下肌肩袖MRI三分类，AI总体准确率0.841。
key_points: 开发集300例，读片队列258例
12名盲法医师分四个三人组
reason: 关节镜参照、多读者对照，但单中心回顾性，设计规范
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) may support rotator cuff MRI interpretation; however, its performance relative to clinicians at different experience levels remains uncertain. We compared a locked YOLO11m-based model with prespecified orthopaedic physician panels using arthroscopy as the reference standard. Methods: This retrospective single-centre study included a separate 300-patient model-development dataset and an arthroscopy-referenced reader cohort of 258 patients (60 intact cuffs, 86 partial-thickness tears, and 112 full-thickness tears). Twelve blinded physicians were assigned to four three-reader experience panels, and panel diagnoses were defined by a two-of-three majority. Paired accuracy comparisons used exact McNemar tests with Holm adjustment. Results: AI achieved 0.841 overall accuracy (95% CI, 0.792-0.881). The senior-specialist panel had numerically higher accuracy (0.911), but the difference from AI was not statistically significant after adjustment (Holm p = 0.060); the junior-specialist panel also did not differ from AI (0.822; Holm p = 0.649). AI showed higher paired accuracy than the senior-resident (0.729; Holm p = 0.005) and junior-resident panels (0.671; Holm p < 0.001). Partial-thickness tears had the lowest AI sensitivity (0.709). Conclusions: In this restricted-cine, three-category benchmark, AI outperformed both resident panels, whereas neither specialist panel comparison reached the adjusted significance threshold. These findings do not establish equivalence to specialists or benefit from AI-assisted reading.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景/目的】人工智能（AI）可能有助于肩袖MRI的判读；然而，其相对于不同经验水平临床医生的表现仍不确定。我们以关节镜检查作为参考标准，将一个锁定的基于YOLO11m的模型与预先设定的骨科医师小组进行了比较。【方法】这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了一个独立的300例患者的模型开发数据集，以及一个以关节镜为参照的258例患者的阅片者队列（60例肩袖完整、86例部分厚度撕裂、112例全层撕裂）。12名盲法医师被分配到四个由三名阅片者组成的经验水平小组，小组诊断以三人中两人一致的多数意见确定。配对准确率比较采用精确McNemar检验并进行Holm校正。【结果】AI的总体准确率为0.841（95% CI，0.792-0.881）。资深专科医师小组的准确率在数值上更高（0.911），但校正后与AI的差异无统计学意义（Holm p = 0.060）；初级专科医师小组与AI亦无差异（0.822；Holm p = 0.649）。AI的配对准确率高于高年资住院医师小组（0.729；Holm p = 0.005）和低年资住院医师小组（0.671；Holm p < 0.001）。部分厚度撕裂的AI敏感性最低（0.709）。【结论】在这一受限电影序列、三分类的基准测试中，AI的表现优于两个住院医师小组，而与两个专科医师小组的比较均未达到校正后的显著性阈值。这些发现并不能证明AI与专科医师等效，也不能证明AI辅助阅片有益。

title: Agentic induction of common data elements and information extraction from sarcoma case report abstracts
zh_title: 智能体从肉瘤病例摘要归纳通用数据元素并抽取信息
summary: LLM智能体从24,588篇PubMed摘要中提出候选通用数据元素，整合后保留53个，并做带证据链接的抽取，人工评审显示正确性仍有限。
key_points: 72,909个候选整合为1,570个CDE
保留53个，专家认可正确性56.6%
抽样100篇，非空答案一致率94.9%
reason: 新颖智能体方法有人工评估，但仅摘要且正确性有限
abstract: Common data elements (CDEs) support clinical data comparability but are usually defined manually. We investigated whether large language model agents could derive a CDE schema from sarcoma case report abstracts and apply it at scale. An agent proposed 72,909 candidate CDEs from 24,588 PubMed abstracts; agentic consolidation yielded 1,570 CDEs. We retained 53 supported by at least 50 abstracts and attempted evidence-linked extraction across the corpus. Processing succeeded for all retained CDEs in 79.2% of abstracts, including responses indicating non-mention. Two human reviewers approved 83.0% of retained CDEs for relevance, 67.9% for clarity, and 56.6% for correctness. In 100 sampled abstracts, exact agreement with the value extracted by the LLM was 94.9% among 1,116 pairs with a non-empty answer (abstract-level bootstrap 95% CI, 93.0-96.4%). Errors concentrated in anatomical and temporal fields. These findings support agent-assisted schema drafting followed by expert curation before large-scale extraction.
zh_abstract: 通用数据元素（CDE）有助于临床数据的可比性，但通常需手工定义。我们研究了大语言模型智能体能否从肉瘤病例报告摘要中推导出CDE模式并大规模应用。一个智能体从24,588篇PubMed摘要中提出了72,909个候选CDE；经智能体整合后得到1,570个CDE。我们保留了至少有50篇摘要支持的53个CDE，并尝试在整个语料库中进行带证据链接的提取。在79.2%的摘要中，所有保留的CDE均处理成功，包括表示未提及的回答。两名人工评审者认定保留的CDE中，83.0%相关性合格，67.9%清晰度合格，56.6%正确性合格。在随机抽取的100篇摘要中，对于1,116个答案非空的配对，与LLM所提取值的完全一致率为94.9%（以摘要为单位的bootstrap 95% CI，93.0–96.4%）。错误集中在解剖部位和时间相关字段。这些发现支持先由智能体辅助起草模式，再经专家审定，然后进行大规模提取。

title: OmitEHR: Scalable Omission Detection in LLM-Generated Clinical Summaries
zh_title: OmitEHR：LLM临床摘要遗漏的可扩展检测
summary: OmitEHR从历史临床医生撰写的摘要中学习显著性，无参考地检测LLM生成住院摘要中的遗漏，基于一家大型学术机构5000次入院（预印本）。
key_points: 无需参考摘要的遗漏检测
学习临床医生纳入哪些原文句子
应用于简要住院经过摘要
reason: 针对LLM摘要主要失败模式的新方法，预印本且证据有限
abstract: Health systems increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to draft summaries of patient medical records, yet evaluations now find omissions, the absence of clinically important information, to be the most common failure mode. Detecting omissions in an LLM-generated summary requires knowing which facts in the record are salient, a signal that existing methods hand-specify, ignore, or recompute at inference with costly LLM judges. We present OmitEHR, a reference-free omission detector that learns clinical salience from historical clinician-written summaries predating widespread LLM use. OmitEHR learns to predict which source-note sentences clinicians include in their summaries, then surfaces high-salience sentences not covered by an LLM-generated summary as candidate omissions. We apply OmitEHR to brief hospital course (BHC) summarization using 5,000 admissions from a large academic medical center. On held-out admissions, OmitEHR outperformed all evaluated baselines at predicting salient source sentences, including a prompted LLM judge. The full omission detection pipeline took 17.7 to 19.5 seconds and cost \$0.03 to \$0.13 per summary depending on the base model, 1.6 to 1.7 times faster and 5.6 to 6.7 times cheaper than scoring every source sentence with an LLM judge. In a blinded review of 25 admissions, two board-certified clinicians confirmed a mean of 5.6 clinically meaningful omissions per summary surfaced by OmitEHR, compared with 3.3 for a full LLM pipeline, counting candidates confirmed by at least one clinician. The efficiency and validity of OmitEHR make it a practical tool for health systems to flag omissions before a summary reaches the clinician.
zh_abstract: 医疗系统越来越依赖大语言模型（LLM）来起草患者病历摘要，但目前的评估发现，遗漏（即缺少具有临床重要性的信息）是最常见的失败模式。要检测LLM生成摘要中的遗漏，需要知道病历中哪些事实是重要的，而这一信号在现有方法中要么由人工指定、要么被忽略，要么在推理时借助成本高昂的LLM评判器重新计算。我们提出了OmitEHR，一种无需参考摘要的遗漏检测器，它从LLM被广泛使用之前由临床医生撰写的历史摘要中学习临床重要性。OmitEHR学习预测临床医生会将哪些源病历句子纳入其摘要，然后将LLM生成的摘要未涵盖的高重要性句子作为候选遗漏呈现出来。我们将OmitEHR应用于简要住院病程（BHC）摘要任务，使用来自一家大型学术医疗中心的5,000例住院记录。在留出的住院病例上，OmitEHR在预测重要源句子方面优于所有被评估的基线方法，包括经提示的LLM评判器。完整的遗漏检测流程每份摘要耗时17.7至19.5秒，成本为0.03至0.13美元（取决于基础模型），比使用LLM评判器对每个源句子打分快1.6至1.7倍，便宜5.6至6.7倍。在对25例住院记录的盲法评审中，两名获得委员会认证的临床医生确认，OmitEHR每份摘要平均发现5.6处具有临床意义的遗漏，而完整LLM流程为3.3处（统计至少一名临床医生确认的候选项）。OmitEHR的高效性和有效性使其成为医疗系统在摘要送达临床医生之前标记遗漏的实用工具。

title: LABEL: Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits in Drug Knowledge and Language Models
zh_title: LABEL：药物知识文献与语言模型中疗效与禁忌的不对称
summary: 对574种药物的分析显示，维基百科与PubMed摘要提及适应症的频率约为禁忌症的两倍，语言模型也反映这一不对称。
key_points: 基于PrimeKG的574种药物
文献中疗效提及约为安全限制的2.19倍(优势比)
语言模型同样呈现该文献差距
reason: 预印本，有新意的分析与安全意义，证据有限
abstract: Every medication comes with two types of medical facts: indications, which describe what conditions the drug treats (benefits), and contraindications, which describe who must avoid it to prevent serious harm (safety limits). Although contraindications are critical for patient safety and FDA regulations require listing them as rigorously as indications, we find that contraindications are far less documented than indications in general prose. In this paper, we measure how often these texts contain both facts across 574 drugs from PrimeKG by comparing a drug's indications against its own contraindications. Across Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts, we find that reference prose names a drug's benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). We call this documentation gap LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits). Language models mirror this gap. As we scale Qwen2.5 from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, whereas accuracy on contraindications remains flat near random guessing. However, when we provide models with a retrieved passage that states the answer, they use safety facts just as effectively as benefits. Furthermore, routing safety questions to official FDA labels boosts accuracy by 15.8 points whenever the label states the fact. Overall, our findings show that models fail on medication safety not because they cannot reason about risk, but because free-text corpora lack safety facts. Clinical AI systems should therefore route medication-safety questions to official regulatory labels and structured databases rather than relying on general public records. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL.
zh_abstract: 每种药物都附带两类医学事实：适应证，即药物治疗哪些疾病（获益）；以及禁忌证，即哪些人必须避免使用该药以防止严重伤害（安全界限）。尽管禁忌证对患者安全至关重要，且美国 FDA 法规要求像列出适应证一样严格地列出禁忌证，但我们发现，在一般文本中禁忌证的记载远少于适应证。本文通过将药物的适应证与其自身的禁忌证进行比较，衡量这些文本同时包含这两类事实的频率，涉及 PrimeKG 中的 574 种药物。在维基百科文章和 PubMed 摘要中，我们发现参考性文本提及药物获益的频率约为提及其安全界限的两倍（药物内比值比 2.19）。我们将这种记载差距称为 LABEL（Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits，疗效与限制之间的文献不对称）。语言模型反映了这一差距。当我们将 Qwen2.5 从 0.5B 扩展到 14B 时，适应证的准确率提高了 18.3 个百分点，而禁忌证的准确率始终接近随机猜测水平，没有提升。然而，当我们为模型提供陈述答案的检索段落时，模型使用安全事实的效果与使用获益事实同样好。此外，只要药品标签陈述了相关事实，将安全性问题转交给 FDA 官方药品标签即可使准确率提高 15.8 个百分点。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，模型在药物安全方面的失败并非因为无法对风险进行推理，而是因为自由文本语料中缺乏安全事实。因此，临床人工智能系统应将药物安全问题转交给官方监管标签和结构化数据库，而不是依赖一般的公开记录。代码和数据见 https://github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL。

title: MemoryLane: Supporting Reminiscence Conversations Between Older Adults with Mild Dementia and Lay Caregivers Using a Simulated AI Agent
zh_title: MemoryLane：用模拟AI智能体辅助轻度痴呆回忆交流
summary: AI工具帮助非专业照护者与轻度痴呆老人开展回忆对话，由模拟的AI同伴智能体及生成的记忆图像参与三方交流。
key_points: 面向轻度痴呆老人与非专业照护者
模拟AI智能体充当患者同伴
无需预先整理照片，由AI生成记忆图像
reason: 痴呆方向智能体交互系统，摘要无评估信息
abstract: Reminiscence Therapy (RT) is a non-pharmacological intervention that invites patients to discuss and review past life experiences and memories to improve their emotional and mental well-being. In practice, many reminiscence conversations are led by lay caregivers, such as spouses and adult children. While traditional RT often relies on personal photographs, curating them can be tedious and difficult. In addition, caregivers who lack shared life experiences with the patient may struggle to facilitate engaging reminiscence conversations. This paper presents MemoryLane, an AI-integrated tool that helps lay caregivers facilitate reminiscence conversations without curated photographs. MemoryLane supports a triadic conversation among the patient, the caregiver, and a simulated AI agent that acts as the patient's peer. A shared interface shows the agent and AI-generated images of the memories being discussed, while a private smartphone interface lets the caregiver control the behavior of the simulated AI agent and moderate the AI-generated images. A preliminary focus group study with five dementia-care stakeholders suggested the value of MemoryLane's AI agent as a peer companion and of AI-generated images, as well as the feasibility of having caregivers moderate images and control the AI agent.
zh_abstract: 怀旧疗法（Reminiscence Therapy，RT）是一种非药物干预，邀请患者讨论并回顾过去的生活经历和记忆，以改善其情绪和心理健康。在实践中，许多怀旧对话由非专业照护者（如配偶和成年子女）主导。传统 RT 常依赖个人照片，但整理这些照片既繁琐又困难。此外，缺乏与患者共同生活经历的照护者可能难以促成有吸引力的怀旧对话。本文提出 MemoryLane，一种集成 AI 的工具，帮助非专业照护者在无需整理照片的情况下促成怀旧对话。MemoryLane 支持患者、照护者与一个扮演患者同伴的模拟 AI 智能体之间的三方对话。共享界面展示该智能体以及所讨论记忆的 AI 生成图像，而照护者的私人智能手机界面则可控制模拟 AI 智能体的行为并审核 AI 生成的图像。一项有五名痴呆照护相关利益方参与的初步焦点小组研究表明，MemoryLane 的 AI 智能体作为同伴陪伴以及 AI 生成图像具有价值，并且由照护者审核图像和控制 AI 智能体是可行的。

title: Multi-Assay Antibody Developability Prediction with Shared Structure-Language Representations
zh_title: 基于共享结构-语言表征的多检测抗体可开发性预测
summary: 提出MADM模型，结合结构物理化学描述符与蛋白语言模型嵌入，并用多检测共享主干预测抗体可开发性，在八项检测上评估。
key_points: 设计含电荷不对称等新项的残基级描述符
双流架构融合卷积网络与PLM嵌入
共享主干加各检测独立头以传递信息
reason: 有新意预印本方法，数据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Early assessment of antibody developability is critical in drug discovery, but computational approaches remain limited by the scarcity of experimental data. We explore two strategies for working within that limit. First, we designed per-residue physicochemical descriptors encoding the local structural environment, including new terms such as directional charge asymmetry and screened electrostatic potential. These feed a convolutional network, combined with protein language model (PLM) embeddings in a two-stream architecture: the two are encoded and predicted independently and merged only at the prediction stage. Second, a shared trunk with per-assay heads passes information between related assays. Both are implemented in the Multi-Assay Developability Model (MADM) and evaluated on eight assays: HIC, heparin affinity (HAC), AC-SINS, and polyspecificity ELISA against BVP, dsDNA, insulin, ovalbumin and soluble membrane proteins (SMP), with labels from 29 open sources. Structural descriptors match or exceed PLM embeddings (AbLang2, ESM2) on several assays; combining the streams gives a small but consistent gain in accuracy and reduces seed-to-seed variance. Multi-assay training raises Spearman rho for ovalbumin and SMP by about 0.1, where assays correlate and share sequence space. Under cluster-split cross-validation the strongest results are for HAC, ovalbumin, insulin, SMP and HIC (rho = 0.70-0.82); AC-SINS, BVP and dsDNA are weaker (0.50-0.55). In these three, sequence clusters largely coincide with data source, so a held-out fold measures transfer to differently calibrated measurements as well as to new sequences. On the 80-antibody GDPa3 hold-out, performance falls by rho around 0.1 for all but SMP (0.22). Transfer to the VHH panel of Ginkgo GDPa5 gives comparable results, and scFv validation against binary SMP labels yields F1 = 0.89, AUC = 0.95.
zh_abstract: 抗体可开发性的早期评估对药物发现至关重要，但计算方法仍受限于实验数据稀缺。我们探索了两种在此限制下开展工作的策略。第一，我们设计了编码局部结构环境的逐残基理化描述符，包括方向性电荷不对称和屏蔽静电势等新项。这些描述符输入卷积网络，并与蛋白质语言模型（PLM）嵌入组合成双流架构：二者分别独立编码和预测，仅在预测阶段合并。第二，采用带有各检测专属输出头的共享主干，在相关检测之间传递信息。两者均在多检测可开发性模型（Multi-Assay Developability Model，MADM）中实现，并在八项检测上评估：HIC、肝素亲和（HAC）、AC-SINS，以及针对 BVP、dsDNA、胰岛素、卵清蛋白和可溶性膜蛋白（SMP）的多特异性 ELISA，标签来自 29 个公开来源。结构描述符在若干检测上与 PLM 嵌入（AbLang2、ESM2）相当或更优；组合两条流在准确性上带来小幅但一致的提升，并降低了不同种子之间的方差。多检测训练使卵清蛋白和 SMP 的 Spearman rho 提高约 0.1，这两者的检测相互相关且共享序列空间。在聚类划分交叉验证下，HAC、卵清蛋白、胰岛素、SMP 和 HIC 的结果最强（rho = 0.70–0.82）；AC-SINS、BVP 和 dsDNA 较弱（0.50–0.55）。在这三项中，序列聚类在很大程度上与数据来源重合，因此留出折既衡量对新序列的迁移，也衡量对不同校准测量的迁移。在包含 80 个抗体的 GDPa3 留出集上，除 SMP（0.22）外，所有检测的性能下降约 rho 0.1。迁移到 Ginkgo GDPa5 的 VHH 面板得到了相当的结果；针对二元 SMP 标签的 scFv 验证得到 F1 = 0.89、AUC = 0.95。

title: Foundation Model Fine-Tuning with Attention-based Multi-View Fusion for Multi-Task Cardiac Function Assessment
zh_title: 基础模型微调与注意力多视角融合用于多任务心功能评估
summary: 在EchoPrime基础模型上端到端微调，融合心尖四腔与两腔视图，联合进行LVEF估计与左室功能不全分类。
key_points: 按心动周期做时间标准化采样
注意力融合多视角时空特征
面向肿瘤心脏病学的LVEF监测
reason: 基础模型微调应用，摘要无外部验证信息，属值得一看档
abstract: In cardio-oncology, left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is the standard biomarker for monitoring cardiac function during cancer therapy. However, its estimation from echocardiography is highly operator dependent, and clinically meaningful declines are often detected only after myocardial injury has progressed, motivating automated methods for standardized assessment and earlier detection of LV dysfunction. To address this need, we propose a multi-task framework integrating cardiac cycle-based temporal standardization, multi-view spatiotemporal feature extraction, and joint optimization for LVEF estimation and LV dysfunction classification. Apical four- and two-chamber echocardiographic sequences are temporally standardized by sampling a clip over an estimated cardiac cycle before being processed by the EchoPrime foundation model, which is fine-tuned end-to-end within the proposed architecture. View-specific features are fused through an attention-based aggregation module to generate a patient-level embedding, from which two task-specific prediction heads estimate continuous LVEF and binary LV dysfunction. To broaden the LVEF distribution encountered during training, samples from the MIMIC-IV-ECHO dataset are incorporated using a balanced sampling strategy. Evaluated on the EchoRisk-MICCAI Challenge, our method achieves an MAE of 4.003 for LVEF estimation (Task 1) and an AUC of 0.764 for LV dysfunction detection (Task 2) on the validation set, demonstrating the effectiveness of foundation model fine-tuning with attention-based multi-view fusion for automated cardiac function assessment in cardio-oncology.
zh_abstract: 在心脏肿瘤学中，左心室射血分数（LVEF）是癌症治疗期间监测心功能的标准生物标志物。然而，其超声心动图估计高度依赖操作者，具有临床意义的下降往往在心肌损伤已进展后才被发现，这促使人们需要用于标准化评估和更早发现左心室功能不全的自动化方法。为此，我们提出一个多任务框架，整合基于心动周期的时间标准化、多视图时空特征提取，以及用于 LVEF 估计和左心室功能不全分类的联合优化。心尖四腔和两腔超声心动图序列通过在估计的心动周期上采样一段片段进行时间标准化，然后由 EchoPrime 基础模型处理，该模型在所提架构中进行端到端微调。各视图特征通过基于注意力的聚合模块融合，生成患者层面的嵌入，由两个任务特定的预测头分别估计连续的 LVEF 和二元的左心室功能不全。为拓宽训练中遇到的 LVEF 分布，采用平衡采样策略纳入 MIMIC-IV-ECHO 数据集的样本。在 EchoRisk-MICCAI 挑战赛验证集上评估，我们的方法在 LVEF 估计（任务 1）上取得 MAE 4.003，在左心室功能不全检测（任务 2）上取得 AUC 0.764，证明了基础模型微调结合基于注意力的多视图融合在心脏肿瘤学自动心功能评估中的有效性。

title: LEAP-LLM: Preserving lead-time structure for question-conditioned ECG interpretation
zh_title: LEAP-LLM：保留导联时间结构的问题条件化心电解读
summary: 提出ECG-LLM架构，用临床问题引导心电特征提取并保留导联与时间结构，以改进心电语言模型的问答。
key_points: 以临床问题条件化ECG特征提取
避免跨导联聚合丢失导联特异信息
通过提示条件实现导联感知对齐
reason: 多模态ECG-LLM新方法，摘要无定量结果，属值得一看档
abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) records cardiac electrical activity across multiple leads and is used for detecting cardiac abnormalities. Recent ECG-language models enable large language models (LLMs) to interpret cardiac signals and answer clinically relevant questions. However, existing ECG-language models typically encode the ECG independently of the clinical question, forcing the ECG representation to retain broad and potentially irrelevant signal information. Moreover, these models often aggregate information across leads which can obscure lead-specific details needed for a particular question. To tackle these limitations, we introduce LEAP-LLM, an ECG-LLM architecture for Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning. LEAP-LLM uses the clinical question to guide ECG feature extraction while preserving explicit lead and temporal structure. Task-trained instruction representations distill information from the question and guide two complementary branches. The Lead branch captures question-relevant temporal patterns within each ECG lead, while the Temporal branch summarizes relevant information across leads at each temporal position. Together, they provide the LLM with compact, question-relevant ECG information while preserving lead and temporal structure. LEAP-LLM reduces modality-token count by 89.0% and prefill FLOPs by 7.2x on average relative to other ECG-LLMs baselines. Across four ECG benchmarks, LEAP-LLM achieves better performance, including a 3.4-percentage-point improvement in G12EC over the strongest prior ECG-specific method. We further show that the model adaptively emphasizes the clinically relevant anatomical lead groups for different cardiac abnormalities, with lead importance patterns consistent with established diagnostic knowledge, providing interpretable evidence that the predictions are supported by clinically meaningful ECG structure.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）记录多个导联的心脏电活动，用于检测心脏异常。近期的ECG-语言模型使大语言模型（LLM）能够解读心脏信号并回答临床相关问题。然而，现有ECG-语言模型通常独立于临床问题对ECG进行编码，迫使ECG表征保留广泛且可能无关的信号信息。此外，这些模型常常跨导联聚合信息，可能掩盖特定问题所需的导联特异性细节。为解决这些局限，我们提出LEAP-LLM，一种具有提示条件化的导联感知ECG对齐（Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning）的ECG-LLM架构。LEAP-LLM利用临床问题引导ECG特征提取，同时保留明确的导联和时间结构。经任务训练的指令表征从问题中提炼信息，并引导两个互补的分支。导联分支捕获每个ECG导联内与问题相关的时间模式，时间分支则在每个时间位置上汇总跨导联的相关信息。二者共同为LLM提供紧凑的、与问题相关的ECG信息，同时保留导联和时间结构。相对于其他ECG-LLM基线，LEAP-LLM平均将模态token数量减少89.0%，预填充FLOPs减少7.2倍。在四个ECG基准上，LEAP-LLM取得了更好的性能，其中在G12EC上比最强的既往ECG专用方法提高3.4个百分点。我们进一步表明，模型会针对不同心脏异常自适应地强调临床相关的解剖导联组，其导联重要性模式与既有诊断知识一致，为预测得到具有临床意义的ECG结构支持提供了可解释的证据。

title: Scaling Channel-Adaptive Self-Supervised Learning
zh_title: 扩展通道自适应自监督学习
summary: 研究在大规模数据上通道自适应自监督策略的表现，涉及生物、医学与卫星等非RGB科学影像，发现独立编码通道表现更优。
key_points: 针对通道数量与语义异质的科学影像
比较大规模训练下的通道自适应策略
发现独立通道编码优于联合编码（据摘要）
reason: 自监督/基础模型规模化研究，通用性强，医疗为部分场景
abstract: Recent advances in self-supervised pre-training of foundation models for natural images have made them a popular choice for various visual systems and applications. Self-supervised strategies are also promising in non-RGB scientific imaging domains such as in biology, medical and satellite imagery, but their broader application is hampered by heterogeneity in channel composition and semantics between relevant datasets: two datasets may contain different numbers of channels, and these may reveal distinct aspects of an object or scene. Recent works on channel adaptive strategies report substantial advantages for those that account for variable channel compositions without sacrificing the ability to jointly encode channels; yet, how these strategies behave at scale remains unclear. We here show that, surprisingly, trained across large-scale datasets, independent-encoding of channels outperforms joint-encoding methods by a substantial margin. We validate this result along an extensive set of experiments on various datasets from cell microscopy to geospatial imagery. Our DINO BoC approach sets a new state-of-the-art across challenging benchmarks, including generalization to out-of-distribution tasks and unseen channel combinations. We open-source code and model weights for a new general-purpose feature extractor for fluorescent microscopy.
zh_abstract: 面向自然图像的基础模型自监督预训练近来取得进展，使其成为各类视觉系统与应用的热门选择。自监督策略在生物学、医学和卫星影像等非RGB科学成像领域同样前景可期，但其更广泛的应用受到相关数据集之间通道组成与语义异质性的制约：两个数据集可能包含不同数量的通道，且这些通道可能揭示物体或场景的不同方面。近期关于通道自适应策略的研究报告称，那些能够处理可变通道组成、同时又不牺牲对通道进行联合编码能力的策略具有显著优势；然而，这些策略在大规模条件下的表现仍不清楚。我们在此表明，令人意外的是，在大规模数据集上训练时，通道独立编码方法大幅优于联合编码方法。我们通过一系列涵盖从细胞显微成像到地理空间影像的各类数据集的广泛实验验证了这一结果。我们的 DINO BoC 方法在多项具有挑战性的基准上达到了新的最先进水平，包括对分布外任务和未见过的通道组合的泛化。我们开源了用于荧光显微成像的新型通用特征提取器的代码和模型权重。

title: Conditional Endorsement: Simulating How Adults with Different Skills Evaluate Canada's National AI Strategy
zh_title: 条件性认可：模拟不同技能成年人如何评价加拿大国家AI战略
summary: 基于PIAAC第二轮样本构建3200个生成式智能体，模拟不同技能成年人对加拿大20项AI政策的评价；该预印本未经同行评审。
key_points: 以加权PIAAC样本构建3200个生成式智能体
智能体几乎支持所有政策
对提升AI素养及个人获益信心明显较低
reason: 大规模persona社会模拟，预印本无外部验证；命中偏好上调
abstract: Canada's 2026 national AI strategy, AI for All, commits to free AI training for everyone and to expanding business AI adoption, yet it is difficult to anticipate whether these policies will reach adults with uneven skills and circumstances. We ask how adults with diverse skills might rate these policies on support, effectiveness, and personal benefit, how their skills and circumstances shape these evaluations, and what implementation conditions they raise. We built 3,200 generative agents from a weighted sample of the Programme for the International Assessment of Adult Competencies (PIAAC) Cycle 2 respondents, collected their ratings and explanations for 20 policies, and analyzed dialogues between agents with contrasting ratings. The agents supported nearly every policy but were far less confident that they would improve adult AI literacy or benefit them personally. This gap widened as digital technology use declined: agents modeled on adults who had never used a digital device still endorsed the policies but rarely expected to benefit. Agents traced the gap to participation costs, hard-to-exercise rights, and limited community control, and their dialogues specified these conditions rather than resolving disagreement. We describe this pattern as conditional endorsement and argue that AI literacy policy should be designed and evaluated for adults with the fewest digital skills.

title: Future-Information Leakage in 30-Day Readmission Prediction: An Empirical Audit and a Calibrated Electronic Health Record Model in Medicare-Insured Adults
zh_title: 30天再入院预测中的未来信息泄漏：实证审计与校准模型
summary: 基于MIMIC-IV的23.7万例医保成人入院数据，审计发现某历史特征使用了未来住院信息造成泄漏，并构建了校准的再入院预测模型。
key_points: 回顾性研究，236,906例入院、87,750名患者
一项“前180天住院时长趋势”特征含后续入院信息
剔除泄漏特征及两个衍生项后测试AUC下降
reason: 回顾性、内部验证，但样本大且揭示方法学泄漏问题
abstract: Objective: To develop and internally validate a calibrated discharge model of 30-day within-system readmission in Medicare-insured adults, and to quantify how a future-information leak and outcome artifacts distorted performance, timing, and subgroup conclusions. Materials and Methods: Retrospective study of 236,906 Medicare-insured MIMIC-IV v3.1 admissions (87,750 patients; prevalence 21.4%). Predictors were audited for discharge-time availability; history features were tested for future information and recomputed from raw timestamps. A consensus gradient-boosted (XGBoost) model was selected inside patient-grouped folds; CIs used patient-cluster bootstrap. Results: A feature documented as a prior 180-day length-of-stay trend used each patient's whole record, including later admissions; removing it and two derived terms lowered test area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from 0.774 to 0.706. The corrected procedure reached an out-of-fold AUROC of 0.7057 (95% CI 0.7016 to 0.7102; primary); the 44-feature model scored 0.7056 on the historically exposed test partition (calibration slope 0.99), above reconstructed LACE and HOSPITAL (both P<.001). A day-1 discrimination peak largely reflected 2,368 probable administrative continuations within 1 hour of discharge; merging these into the preceding stay gave test AUROC 0.698 (0.702 after refitting). The White minus Black AUROC difference was 0.003 (95% CI -0.018 to 0.024); specificity was lower for Black patients (0.61 vs 0.69). Discussion: Documentation audits and patient-grouped validation missed a leak that inflated discrimination and created spurious subgroup and calendar-period differences; simple empirical checks found it. Conclusion: Empirical leakage checks should accompany availability audits. The corrected model is calibrated, moderately discriminating, and needs external validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并内部验证一个经校准的、针对参加医疗保险（Medicare）成人患者的出院时 30 天系统内再入院预测模型，并量化未来信息泄漏和结局伪影如何扭曲模型性能、时间趋势及亚组结论。【材料与方法】对 MIMIC-IV v3.1 中 236,906 次参加 Medicare 的入院记录（87,750 名患者；患病率 21.4%）进行回顾性研究。对预测变量审核其在出院时是否可获得；对病史特征检验是否含有未来信息，并根据原始时间戳重新计算。在按患者分组的折内选择共识梯度提升（XGBoost）模型；置信区间采用患者聚类自助法（bootstrap）。【结果】一个被记录为既往 180 天住院时长趋势的特征使用了每位患者的整份病历，包括之后的入院记录；去除该特征及两个衍生项后，测试集受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）由 0.774 降至 0.706。校正后的流程获得折外 AUROC 为 0.7057（95% CI 0.7016 至 0.7102；主要结果）；44 个特征的模型在曾暴露过的历史测试分区上得分为 0.7056（校准斜率 0.99），高于重建的 LACE 和 HOSPITAL 评分（均 P<.001）。第 1 天出现的区分度峰值主要反映了出院后 1 小时内 2,368 次可能属于行政性延续的入院；将这些记录合并入前一次住院后，测试集 AUROC 为 0.698（重新拟合后为 0.702）。白人与黑人的 AUROC 差值为 0.003（95% CI -0.018 至 0.024）；黑人患者的特异度较低（0.61 对 0.69）。【讨论】文档审核和按患者分组的验证都未能发现这一夸大区分度的泄漏，该泄漏还造成了虚假的亚组及日历时期差异；简单的经验性检查则发现了它。【结论】除可获得性审核外，还应进行经验性泄漏检查。校正后的模型经过校准，区分度中等，在临床使用前需要外部验证。

title: TotalSegmentator Aorta Report: Automated Aortic Diameter Measurement at 11 Standardized Landmarks on CT Images
zh_title: TotalSegmentator主动脉报告：CT上11个标准位点的自动测径
summary: 开源工具基于TotalSegmentator分割，在CT上自动测量主动脉11个标准位点直径；单中心回顾性评估239例CTA，以放射科医师校正结果为参考。
key_points: 开源工具，按指南定义11个位点
单中心回顾性，239例CTA/230名患者
以MAE、偏差及>2mm差异评估一致性
reason: 开源实用工具，但单中心回顾性小样本，属值得一看档
abstract: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fully automated, open-source tool that measures aortic diameters at 11 standardized landmarks from the aortic annulus to the bifurcation on any CT image, following current guideline recommendations. Materials and Methods: This retrospective single-center study included 239 arterial phase CT angiography examinations of 230 patients (median age, 65 years [range, 18-99 years]; 163 men) performed between April 2025 and October 2026 (209 electrocardiographically [ECG] gated). The tool locates landmarks from TotalSegmentator segmentations of aortic branches and vertebrae and measures the maximum diameter at each. A senior radiologist reviewed and, where needed, corrected the automated measurements to create the reference standard. Agreement was assessed with mean absolute error (MAE), bias, and differences greater than 2 mm. Results: Across all landmarks, MAE was 1.06 mm (95% CI: 0.91, 1.22), and 86.6% (95% CI: 84.4, 88.5) of differences were 2 mm or less. The tool measured slightly larger diameters (bias, 0.45 mm [95% CI: 0.34, 0.57]). The sinuses of Valsalva had the largest MAE (2.17 mm [95% CI: 1.59, 2.86]). For 1.2% of landmarks, the automatic measurement failed. Examination-level MAE did not differ significantly by pathology, atherosclerosis grade (P=.95), or ECG gating (P=.14). Examinations with mural thrombus more often had an MAE greater than 2 mm (50% [95% CI: 31, 69] vs 20%; P=.03). Conclusion: The tool measured aortic diameters at 11 landmarks along the entire aorta with an MAE of about 1 mm, below published interreader variability. Agreement was lower at the aortic root and with mural thrombus. Code availability: The tool is open source and freely available at https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator.

title: MamaReason: Unfinished Reasoning and Answer Recovery in Clinical Language Models
zh_title: MamaReason：临床语言模型中未完成推理与答案恢复
summary: 在母婴健康基准MamaBench的217个配对病例上，研究临床语言模型未完成推理中已出现诊断、续写可恢复答案的现象。
key_points: 基于Gemma 4 31B改造
RL失败案例94例中75例含明确诊断
续写与该诊断在67/75例一致
reason: 新颖的预印本分析，规模有限且无外部验证
abstract: Answer continuation often returns a diagnosis already stated in unfinished clinical reasoning. We study this behavior in MamaReason, adapted from dense Gemma 4 31B, on MamaBench's 217 paired maternal and child-health presentations. An explicit-commitment extractor identifies a diagnosis in 75 of 94 failed RL first passes and 75 of 93 failed SFT first passes. The continuation matches that diagnosis in 67/75 RL cases and 58/75 SFT cases, using diagnosis strings alone. Reading these commitments without additional generation recovers 30 of the 40 RL pairs restored by continuation under the archived correctness labels. Recurrence controls distinguish routine mentions from repeated answer selection. An offline second-commitment trigger measures the tradeoff between earlier readout and paired accuracy. The resulting decomposition separates diagnostic content already present in a trace, completion of an accepted answer, and paired diagnostic correctness. For clinical language-model evaluation, these are distinct outcomes that become visible when the same reasoning trace is examined through multiple readouts.
zh_abstract: 答案续写（answer continuation）常常会返回未完成的临床推理中已经陈述过的诊断。我们在 MamaReason（由稠密的 Gemma 4 31B 改造而来）上，利用 MamaBench 的 217 对配对的母婴健康病例，研究了这一行为。显式承诺提取器（explicit-commitment extractor）在 94 个失败的 RL 首次生成中识别出 75 个诊断，在 93 个失败的 SFT 首次生成中识别出 75 个诊断。仅使用诊断字符串，续写结果与该诊断在 RL 的 67/75 例和 SFT 的 58/75 例中一致。在存档的正确性标签下，无需额外生成、仅读取这些承诺，即可恢复续写所恢复的 40 个 RL 配对中的 30 个。复现（recurrence）对照可区分常规提及与重复的答案选择。一种离线的第二次承诺触发机制衡量了更早读出与配对准确率之间的权衡。由此得到的分解将推理轨迹中已存在的诊断内容、已接受答案的补全以及配对诊断正确性区分开来。对于临床语言模型评估而言，这些是不同的结果，当通过多种读出方式检查同一推理轨迹时，它们才会显现出来。

title: Explanations that Transfer: Interpreting Medical Retrieval with Sparse AutoEncoders
zh_title: 用稀疏自编码器解释可迁移的医学检索
summary: 将稀疏自编码器用于医学信息检索，把稠密嵌入转为可解释表示，并结合重构与InfoNCE对比损失，在六个医学检索数据集上评估。
key_points: 重构目标结合InfoNCE对比损失保留相关性
评估三种嵌入模型、六个医学检索数据集
兼顾域内与域外迁移，提升可解释性
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线对比，证据有限
abstract: Medical AI systems that answer users' queries rely on retrieving medical knowledge from large document collections. In this context, finetuning general models on medical datasets can improve retrieval relevance. Yet the dense embeddings underlying modern retrieval systems remain largely opaque, making it difficult to understand the mechanics behind their results. Moreover, adapting to a specific medical dataset risks losing transferability to new clinical corpora. In this work, we tackle these issues by applying Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to medical information retrieval, transforming dense text embeddings into semantically interpretable representations. To do so, our model combines a reconstruction objective with an InfoNCE contrastive loss that directly preserves query-document relevance. We evaluate three embedding models across six medical retrieval datasets, both in-domain and out-of-domain. Trained on a medical corpus, our sparse codes improve in-domain retrieval over the original embeddings, and lose less out-of-domain performance than their dense counterparts, especially when the target corpus is distant from the training one. Importantly, our experiments show that the method yields interpretable features whose semantic content can be inferred from the queries and documents that activate them most strongly. The interpretation of these features sheds light on why a particular document was retrieved, and transfers beyond the training distribution.

title: When Copying Is Hard to Beat: A Negative Result in Clinical Assessment Forecasting
zh_title: 复制难以超越：临床评估次日预测的负面结果
summary: 在2.97万ICU日对、45个条目的次日临床评估预测中，所评模型相对持续性基线无稳定优势，属负面结果。
key_points: 生理信息门控模型macro-F1仅+0.0019，准确率下降
调整时间窗或评分口径后优势消失
四个检查点跨三类模型均不及持续性基线
reason: 规范的负面结果，样本较大，但仅预印本、无外部验证
abstract: We report a negative result in next-day clinical assessment forecasting: the evaluated models show no consistent advantage over strong persistence-based baselines. Clinicians can view the previous day's questionnaire answers, a plausible source of documentation persistence. Predicting 45 items on 29,715 ICU day-pairs with patient-disjoint splits, a physiology-informed gated model improves item-macro-F1 over a one-line clinical rule by +0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031], while losing accuracy. No macro-F1 advantage is established when the physiology window ends at the previous form's reference time (+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]), or when scoring excludes the 68.5% of cells derived from parent answers; combining both changes yields a small disadvantage. Four checkpoints across three families underperform persistence, and a fine-tuned one differs from it on only two cells. A categorical read-out raises changed-cell accuracy eightfold, but a state-only read-out scores higher overall than forecast-only decoding and matches a transition matrix. This negative result highlights how the documentation process, input cutoff, observation mask and decoding rule shape conclusions about forecasting recorded assessments.

title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models

abstract: Neural networks are powerful predictors, yet their opacity limits their usefulness in science, where the goal is explanation rather than mere prediction. In neuroscience, for example, deep encoding models accurately predict brain activity in response to natural stimuli, but struggle to reveal which stimulus features drive those predictions. Here we introduce interpretable weight-space programming (iWSP), a method in which an LLM agent iteratively builds interpretable models by explicitly programming their weights and features in code, without gradient-based training (backpropagation). Without backpropagation to tune parameters, the agent must draw on its prior knowledge and reason over previous trials to hypothesize, hand-craft, and refine human-interpretable computations mirroring the workflow of a human scientist. LLM audits confirm the interpretability of the hand-crafted models. We first validate iWSP by tasking it with constructing transformers for canonical benchmarks such as arithmetic and sentiment classification, finding that LLM agents can successfully craft compact, accurate networks directly. Next, we apply iWSP to build neural encoding models across vision, language, and audition. In the visual cortex, iWSP outpredicts existing interpretable baselines, uncovers distinct computations across early/higher visual areas, and generalizes to unseen data. In language fMRI, iWSP surfaces a confound in the data and in auditory ECoG, it systematically discovers interpretable acoustic features that predict neural activity. Together, these results establish iWSP as a general paradigm for aligning high predictive performance with human-interpretable scientific discovery.

abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Coronary artery disease (CAD) remains the leading cause of death worldwide, yet the landscape is rapidly evolving as artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to its detection, diagnosis, and management. This review surveys the expanding role of AI across the full spectrum of CAD care. In screening, deep-learning electrocardiography and electronic health record-based digital markers enable earlier identification of clinically significant disease. In noninvasive imaging, AI-driven coronary computed tomography angiography automates calcium scoring, derives fractional flow reserve without invasive wires, and quantifies high-risk plaque features that predict incident adverse events. Within the cardiac catheterization laboratory, angiography-derived physiologic assessment and AI-guided intravascular imaging segmentation support real-time procedural decision-making. Beyond diagnosis, machine-learning models integrating multimodality imaging data improve risk stratification over conventional clinical scores, while pharmacogenomic algorithms and wearable-based digital rehabilitation platforms enable patient-centric secondary prevention. Despite this progress, significant challenges persist, including limited evidence from randomized trials, algorithmic bias in underrepresented populations, regulatory uncertainty surrounding software-as-a-medical-device frameworks, and the risk of clinician de-skilling. AI has the potential to act as a collaborative tool that augments-rather than replaces-physician judgment. Future directions include foundation models, multiomics integration, agentic AI workflows, and equity-centered deployment strategies to ensure that AI-driven advances benefit all individuals with CAD.
zh_abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] 冠状动脉疾病（CAD）仍是全球首要死因，但随着人工智能（AI）越来越多地应用于其检测、诊断和管理，这一领域正在迅速演变。本综述概述了AI在CAD全程诊疗中不断扩大的作用。在筛查方面，基于深度学习的心电图以及基于电子健康档案的数字标志物可更早识别具有临床意义的疾病。在无创影像方面，AI驱动的冠状动脉CT血管造影可自动完成钙化积分，无需有创导丝即可推导血流储备分数，并量化可预测不良事件发生的高危斑块特征。在心导管室内，基于血管造影的生理学评估和AI引导的血管内影像分割可支持术中实时决策。在诊断之外，整合多模态影像数据的机器学习模型相较传统临床评分改善了风险分层，而药物基因组学算法和基于可穿戴设备的数字化康复平台则可实现以患者为中心的二级预防。尽管取得了这些进展，仍存在重大挑战，包括随机试验证据有限、在代表性不足人群中的算法偏倚、围绕软件即医疗器械框架的监管不确定性，以及临床医生技能退化的风险。AI有潜力成为增强而非取代医生判断的协作工具。未来方向包括基础模型、多组学整合、智能体（agentic）AI工作流程以及以公平为中心的部署策略，以确保AI驱动的进步惠及所有CAD患者。

abstract: [African journal of reproductive health] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping global healthcare, offering unprecedented opportunities to strengthen diagnostics, clinical decision making, population health surveillance, and health system efficiency. Its promise is particularly significant for low and middle income countries, where AI enabled tools can help bridge gaps in workforce capacity, disease monitoring, and access to specialized care. Yet these advances carry profound risks. Algorithmic bias, opaque decision pathways, data governance failures, and widening digital inequities threaten to undermine trust and exacerbate existing disparities. Without robust ethical stewardship, AI may amplify structural vulnerabilities rather than alleviate them. This editorial examines AI's dual trajectory in global health-its transformative potential and emerging hazards-and argues for a coordinated governance framework grounded in transparency, accountability, equity, and human rights. As nations accelerate digital adoption, ethical leadership must become a central pillar of global health strategy to ensure AI serves collective benefit rather than drives unintended harm.
zh_abstract: [African journal of reproductive health] 人工智能（AI）正在迅速重塑全球医疗卫生，为加强诊断、临床决策、人群健康监测和卫生系统效率提供了前所未有的机遇。其前景对低收入和中等收入国家尤为重要，AI赋能的工具有助于弥合劳动力能力、疾病监测和获得专科医疗服务方面的差距。然而，这些进步也伴随着深远的风险。算法偏见、不透明的决策路径、数据治理失灵以及不断扩大的数字不平等，可能损害信任并加剧现有差距。若缺乏有力的伦理监管，AI可能放大而非缓解结构性脆弱性。本社论审视了AI在全球卫生领域的双重走向——其变革潜力与新出现的危害——并主张建立以透明、问责、公平和人权为基础的协调治理框架。随着各国加速数字化应用，伦理领导力必须成为全球卫生战略的核心支柱，以确保AI服务于集体利益，而不是造成意外伤害。

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is entering gynecologic and obstetric imaging, risk prediction, decision support, robotic surgery, remote monitoring, and patient communication. An estimated 260,000 maternal deaths occurred worldwide in 2023, and in England obstetric claims account for 11% of clinical negligence claims but 55% of their value. AI errors, bias, or opacity in this specialty therefore carry major clinical and legal consequences. Objective: To synthesize the principal medico-legal and bioethical challenges associated with AI in gynecology and obstetrics and to propose a lifecycle governance framework for responsible clinical adoption. Methods: A narrative review with thematic synthesis was conducted. PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched for records published from January 2020 to August 2026, supplemented by citation chaining and official legal databases. Two reviewers screened 131 records against predefined eligibility criteria; 41 sources (36 publications and 5 legal instruments) were included and analyzed thematically. Selection is reported in a PRISMA-style flow diagram. Results: Six connected risk domains were derived from five prespecified themes, namely validation and generalizability; professional competence and automation bias; distributed liability and evidentiary opacity; informed consent and patient autonomy; privacy and cybersecurity of reproductive data; and discrimination, access, and reproductive justice. Generative AI adds risks of hallucination, non-reproducibility, persuasive framing, and undocumented use. Existing law does not eliminate clinician responsibility: accountability is shared across developers, institutions, and professionals, but clinical judgment and documented oversight remain central. In the European Union, Medical Device Regulation and GDPR obligations already apply, whereas AI Act requirements for AI-enabled medical devices apply from August 2028 and the revised Product Liability Directive covers products placed on the market after 9 December 2026; causation and professional fault remain governed by national law. Conclusions: Safe adoption requires more than technical accuracy. We translate the findings into seven actionable institutional requirements, namely accountable ownership, minimum local validation, role-specific training, auditable documentation, equity monitoring, post-deployment surveillance, and incident reporting. abstract: Background: Quantifying myocardial strains from Displacement ENcoding with Stimulated Echoes (DENSE) MRI provides insight into left ventricular performance, but current data processing pipelines remain limited in automation, robustness, and full left ventricle coverage. Methods: We present a fully automated framework for voxel-wise displacement and strain analysis of the left ventricle from DENSE MRI. Our method integrates a multi-channel nnU-Net model trained on both magnitude and phase images for segmentation, an automated phase unwrapping approach, an adaptation of the regularized spatiotemporal least squares (RSTLS) formulation for displacement computation, and strain calculations based on radial basis function interpolation. The proposed framework enables the estimation of displacements and strains across the left ventricle from a full stack of short-axis images. Results: Validation using a computational phantom shows the framework's overall resilience to data noise. Following computational phantom evaluation, the proposed framework is applied to analyze DENSE MRI short-axis slices acquired in forty-seven (N=47) healthy volunteers and covering the full left ventricle. Circumferential, longitudinal, and radial strains are presented throughout the cardiac cycle and at peak systole, showcasing the performance of the proposed framework. Results show that circumferential and longitudinal strains are computed accurately. However, challenges persist when estimating radial strain, especially in the subendocardial layer. A group-wise strain comparison is also performed based on volunteers' sex and age showing a significant effect of sex on circumferential and longitudinal strains. Conclusions: Overall, the proposed framework provides an automated and modular pipeline to compute displacements and strains from DENSE MR images that can be scaled and generalized toward clinical applications.
