abstract: Prediction of drug-target interaction (DTI) has become a very crucial part of drug discovery. With the increase in the data volume, it has become very important to improve prediction accuracy by integrating multiple data sources. In this regard, utilising multiple resources in the form of heterogeneous information network to address DTI prediction can be rewarding. In this work, we propose a heterogeneous information network based multi-task DTI prediction model which leverages the advantages of relation graph convolutional network (RGCN). To achieve this, the model employs drug-target interaction network, drug-drug similarity network and protein-protein similarity network to construct a heterogeneous information network. Moreover, we use a knowledge graph embedding scoring functions to model interactions between drug and targets, specifically DistMult and ComplEx as decoders over the learned node representations. We performed extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets and compared with state-of-the-art methods. We observed that the proposed model shows competitive performance, thereby confirming the effectiveness of our approach. The codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/Dheeran-S/MT-RGCN-DTI/.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: To evaluate ChatGPT-generated (GPT-5) simplifications of shoulder MRI reports from the perspectives of orthopedic surgeons and non-healthcare volunteers. Methods: In this single-center retrospective study, 100 de-identified shoulder MRI reports issued between June 2024 and June 2025 were simplified with ChatGPT in February 2026 using a standardized prompt. Between 10 March and 10 April 2026, three orthopedic surgeons independently rated each simplified text against the original report for accuracy, completeness, understandability, and misleading potential on a 5-point Likert scale (higher scores indicating better ratings). In a second arm, 100 adult non-healthcare volunteers each reviewed one simplified report and completed a six-item questionnaire on perceived clarity, comprehensibility, usefulness, and appropriateness. Results: Median expert scores were 5.0 in all domains, and all three raters assigned scores ≥ 4 in 86-98% of reports. Gwet's AC2 ranged from 0.93 to 0.98, whereas Krippendorff's α ranged from -0.02 to 0.05. Among volunteers, agreement ranged from 47% for understanding report terms to 80% for the appropriateness of the text. Health literacy correlated positively with most items (r = 0.329-0.429, p ≤ 0.001), and age correlated negatively with understanding report terms (r = -0.352, p < 0.001). Conclusions: The simplified reports were rated favorably by orthopedic surgeons and were perceived as useful by non-healthcare volunteers. However, the study was limited by its single-center design, the use of a single model and prompt, the absence of a comparison with the original reports in the volunteer arm, and the reliance on self-reported rather than objectively tested comprehension; therefore, it does not demonstrate improved patient comprehension or clinical safety. Such texts should supplement, not replace, the original report and physician consultation.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景/目的】从骨科医生和非医疗背景志愿者的角度，评估ChatGPT（GPT-5）生成的肩关节MRI报告简化版本。【方法】在这项单中心回顾性研究中，2026年2月使用标准化提示，用ChatGPT对2024年6月至2025年6月期间出具的100份去标识化肩关节MRI报告进行了简化。2026年3月10日至4月10日期间，三名骨科医生独立将每份简化文本与原始报告对照，按5分Likert量表（分数越高评价越好）就准确性、完整性、易懂性和误导可能性进行评分。在第二个研究组中，100名成年非医疗背景志愿者每人阅读一份简化报告，并完成一份包含六个条目的问卷，内容涉及感知的清晰度、可理解性、实用性和适当性。【结果】各领域专家评分的中位数均为5.0，三名评分者在86%-98%的报告中均给出≥4分。Gwet's AC2为0.93至0.98，而Krippendorff's α为-0.02至0.05。在志愿者中，认同比例从理解报告术语的47%到文本适当性的80%不等。健康素养与大多数条目呈正相关（r = 0.329-0.429，p ≤ 0.001），年龄与理解报告术语呈负相关（r = -0.352，p < 0.001）。【结论】简化后的报告获得骨科医生的良好评价，并被非医疗背景志愿者认为有用。然而，本研究存在局限：为单中心设计，仅使用单一模型和单一提示，志愿者组未与原始报告进行比较，且依赖自我报告而非客观测试的理解程度；因此，本研究并未证明患者理解的改善或临床安全性。此类文本应作为原始报告和医生咨询的补充，而非替代。

abstract: [European radiology experimental] Ultrahigh-resolution (UHR) coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) using a photon-counting detector (PCD) provides excellent spatial resolution but is limited by increased image noise. We evaluated whether deep learning (DL)-based denoising and contrast enhancement can further improve UHR-CCTA image quality. UHR-CCTA scans from 25 patients with coronary artery disease were retrospectively analyzed. Images were reconstructed at 0.2-mm slice thickness without and with quantum iterative reconstruction (QIR, Qoff-Q4), and subsequently processed using a DL tool for denoising and increasing iodine contrast enhancement. Subjective image quality (sharpness, noise, vessel wall delineation, and overall quality) was assessed by three radiologists using a 5-point Likert scale. Objective analysis included signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and coronary wall sharpness. Differences between image sets were analyzed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. DL-based CCTA demonstrated significantly superior subjective image quality across all parameters compared to standard reconstructions, with an overall median image quality ([interquartile interval, IQR]: 4 [3-5] versus 2 [2-3], p < 0.001). SNR and CNR were significantly higher for DL-based CCTA across all QIR levels (all p < 0.001). The highest values were observed for DL-based CCTAQ4 versus UHR-CCTAQ4 (SNR: 258.0 ± 147.5 versus 145.2 ± 50.1; CNR: 25.8 ± 17.1 versus 11.1 ± 4.5; both p < 0.001). Coronary wall sharpness was improved for DL-based CCTA for Q1-4 (all p < 0.027). DL-based denoising and iodine contrast enhancement effectively reduce noise and improve anatomic detail in UHR-CCTA, providing incremental value beyond vendor-specific reconstruction, particularly at high QIR strength levels. Question Deep learning reduces noise and enhances contrast in ultrahigh-resolution coronary CT angiography. Findings Image quality improves beyond standard iterative reconstruction methods, and vessel wall sharpness and diagnostic clarity significantly increase. Relevance statement This study aimed to determine at which levels of vendor-specific iterative reconstruction, DL-based denoising and contrast enhancement perform best in UHR CCTA, providing a foundation for future investigations on how these technical improvements may translate into diagnostic benefits.
zh_abstract: [European radiology experimental] 采用光子计数探测器（PCD）的超高分辨率（UHR）冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）具有出色的空间分辨率，但受限于图像噪声增加。我们评估了基于深度学习（DL）的去噪和对比增强是否可以进一步改善UHR-CCTA的图像质量。回顾性分析了25例冠状动脉疾病患者的UHR-CCTA扫描。图像以0.2 mm层厚重建，分别不使用和使用量子迭代重建（QIR，Qoff-Q4），随后使用DL工具进行去噪并增强碘对比增强。三名放射科医师采用5分Likert量表评估主观图像质量（锐利度、噪声、血管壁显示和整体质量）。客观分析包括信噪比（SNR）、对比噪声比（CNR）和冠状动脉壁锐利度。图像组之间的差异采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验分析。与标准重建相比，基于DL的CCTA在所有参数上的主观图像质量均显著更优，整体图像质量中位数（[四分位间距，IQR]）为：4 [3-5] 对 2 [2-3]，p < 0.001。在所有QIR水平下，基于DL的CCTA的SNR和CNR均显著更高（均p < 0.001）。最高值见于基于DL的CCTAQ4与UHR-CCTAQ4比较（SNR：258.0 ± 147.5 对 145.2 ± 50.1；CNR：25.8 ± 17.1 对 11.1 ± 4.5；均p < 0.001）。在Q1-4下，基于DL的CCTA的冠状动脉壁锐利度均有改善（均p < 0.027）。基于DL的去噪和碘对比增强可有效降低UHR-CCTA的噪声并改善解剖细节，在厂商特定重建之外提供了额外价值，尤其是在高QIR强度水平下。问题 深度学习可降低超高分辨率冠状动脉CT血管造影的噪声并增强对比。发现 图像质量的改善超过标准迭代重建方法，血管壁锐利度和诊断清晰度显著提高。相关性声明 本研究旨在确定在UHR CCTA中，厂商特定迭代重建的哪些水平下基于DL的去噪和对比增强表现最佳，为今后研究这些技术改进如何转化为诊断获益奠定基础。

title: Explainable deep learning localizes age-discriminative candidate regions on hand radiographs of adult women.
zh_title: 可解释深度学习定位成年女性手部X线年龄判别区域
summary: 回顾性单中心研究纳入2221名女性，用深度学习区分年轻与年长，并通过Grad-CAM与皮质测量识别候选解剖区域。
key_points: 比较五种架构，选DenseNet121做可解释分析
探索性单中心回顾性设计
reason: 单中心回顾性探索研究，仅内部测试，属增量档
abstract: [Skeletal radiology] To determine whether deep learning can distinguish younger from older adult women on hand radiographs and to identify candidate anatomical regions for age-group discrimination using explainable artificial intelligence and quantitative cortical measurements. This retrospective, single-center, exploratory study included 2,221 women sampled consecutively within each age group during 2020-2023 (1,134 aged 20-45 and 1,087 aged 55-80 years at radiography). Patients contributed one posteroanterior radiograph and were assigned to mutually exclusive training, validation, or test sets. Five architectures were evaluated on the same 334 held-out test radiographs (171 younger; 163 older), with performance averaged across five random-seed runs. DenseNet121 was selected by descriptive comparison for gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) and ray-based analyses with retraining. Manual cortical measurements of test radiographs yielded metacarpal and proximal phalangeal indices for candidate rays identified by Grad-CAM. DenseNet121 achieved the highest mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, 0.996; 95% CI, 0.992-0.999). Grad-CAM showed prominent activation around the third proximal phalanx, with additional activation in the second and fourth rays. Performance remained high after ray masking; the third-ray-only model achieved the highest mean accuracy among single-ray models. The third proximal phalangeal index had the highest AUC among the six indices (0.956; 95% CI, 0.937-0.976). Grad-CAM, ray-based analyses, and quantitative cortical measurements support the third proximal phalanx as an anatomically interpretable candidate region for age-group discrimination in adult women. Integrating explainable artificial intelligence with quantitative radiographic assessment provides an exploratory workflow for investigating hand skeletal aging, with potential relevance to broader musculoskeletal imaging research.

title: SEAT: Sign-Type Evidence-Audited Transport for Multi-Label Tongue Diagnosis
zh_title: SEAT：多标签舌诊的证据审计最优传输框架
summary: 基于冻结DINOv2特征，结合掩码引导注意力与颜色原型最优传输，针对多标签舌象识别并验证预测是否基于临床相关证据。
key_points: 按证据类型匹配专用预测机制
颜色原型的半松弛最优传输通路
强调预测依据可审计
reason: 新颖方法但摘要无外部验证，增量档
abstract: Automated tongue-sign recognition can improve the consistency of non-invasive examinations that otherwise rely on subjective visual judgment. A single tongue image often exhibits multiple coexisting signs characterized by heterogeneous evidence, including localized morphology, global chromaticity, and inter-label dependence. However, existing methods typically rely on shared representations and uniform multi-label heads, making it difficult to verify whether predictions stem from clinically relevant evidence rather than spurious visual correlations. We propose SEAT, an evidence-audited framework that matches distinct evidence types with dedicated prediction and evaluation mechanisms. Built on frozen DINOv2 patch features, SEAT couples mask-guided sign-specific attention for localized morphology, a semi-relaxed optimal transport pathway over LAB/HSV color prototypes to enhance pale-tongue recognition, and a co-occurrence-aware transport regularizer to shape the batch-level predicted label marginal. These components are evaluated through audits matched to their evidence types. On the TongueDx benchmark, SEAT achieves a mean macro-F1 of 72.59 with a standard deviation of 1.04 across six random seeds, with a six-model ensemble reaching 74.15. The ensemble outperforms a backbone-matched baseline and a larger, domain-specialized vision-language model by 8.06 and 2.99 percentage points, respectively. Our results demonstrate that aligning dedicated prediction pathways and audits with sign-specific characteristics improves multi-label accuracy while offering more targeted evidential grounding than uniform post-hoc spatial explanations. Code is available at https://github.com/NEU-TCM-Lab/Sign-type-Evidence-Audited-Transport.

title: DBHiCo: Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning for MRI Image Classification
zh_title: DBHiCo：用于MRI图像分类的双分支层次对比学习
summary: 提出双分支层次对比学习框架DBHiCo，利用解剖多视角配对增强结构一致性与语义判别，用于MRI分类。
key_points: 针对采集噪声与个体间结构相似问题
改进对比学习中刚性二元划分的负样本处理
利用跨视角结构一致性实现细粒度对齐
reason: 方法增量型预印本，摘要无外部验证信息
abstract: Automated Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) image classification provides a crucial non-invasive approach for neurological diagnosis, yet it is fundamentally challenged by inherent acquisition noise and high inter-subject structural similarity, which obscure subtle pathological variations, thereby limiting the performance of deep neural networks. While contrastive learning (CL) offers a promising mitigation strategy, existing paradigms rely on rigid binary partitions that ignore negative sample heterogeneity, and they fail to capture the cross-view structural consistency vital for fine-grained anatomical alignment. To address these barriers, we propose Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning (DBHiCo), a novel framework explicitly designed to collaboratively enforce structural consistency and semantic discrimination. Specifically, DBHiCo leverages a natural anatomical multi-view pair (original and skull-stripped MRI scans), processing them through a dual-branch architecture to seamlessly integrate holistic structural robustness with localized intracranial details. Crucially, we introduce a hierarchical contrastive loss that discards conventional binary constraints in favor of a margin-ranked similarity hierarchy. This mechanism explicitly orders positive and negative pairs based on their structural and semantic difficulty, thereby amplifying the fine-grained semantic discriminability of the learned representations. Extensive experiments across three diverse neurological datasets demonstrate that DBHiCo achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming existing MRI multi-view representation learning and advanced contrastive fine-tuning methods.
zh_abstract: 自动化磁共振成像（MRI）图像分类为神经系统疾病诊断提供了重要的无创手段，但其从根本上受到固有采集噪声和受试者间高度结构相似性的挑战，这些因素掩盖了细微的病理变化，从而限制了深度神经网络的性能。对比学习（CL）虽然是一种有前景的缓解策略，但现有范式依赖僵化的二元划分，忽略了负样本的异质性，并且未能捕捉对细粒度解剖对齐至关重要的跨视图结构一致性。为解决这些障碍，我们提出了双分支层次对比学习（DBHiCo），这是一个专门设计用于协同增强结构一致性与语义区分能力的新框架。具体而言，DBHiCo利用天然的解剖多视图配对（原始MRI扫描与去颅骨MRI扫描），通过双分支架构对其进行处理，以无缝整合整体结构鲁棒性与局部颅内细节。关键在于，我们引入了一种层次对比损失，它摒弃传统的二元约束，转而采用基于间隔排序的相似性层次结构。该机制依据结构和语义上的难度对正负样本对进行显式排序，从而增强所学表征的细粒度语义可区分性。在三个不同的神经系统数据集上的大量实验表明，DBHiCo取得了最先进的性能，始终优于现有的MRI多视图表征学习方法和先进的对比微调方法。

title: ProtFlap: Structure-based Deep Learning Prediction of Protein Flexibility from Atomic Energy Networks
zh_title: ProtFlap：基于原子能量网络的蛋白柔性结构预测
summary: ProtFlap是图神经网络框架，将蛋白表示为残基相互作用图，直接从静态结构预测残基水平的相对柔性，以替代昂贵的分子动力学模拟。
key_points: 以残基相互作用图表示蛋白
直接从静态结构预测相对残基柔性
旨在规模化替代分子动力学采样
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见充分验证细节
abstract: Protein flexibility is a key determinant of molecular recognition, catalysis, and regulation, yet remains difficult to characterise at scale. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations provide detailed descriptions of time-dependent dynamics but are computationally expensive. Although recent AI-based structure prediction methods have substantially improved access to high-quality static protein structures, they inherently lack information regarding the dynamic fluctuations essential for functional understanding. There is therefore a need for scalable, structure-based computational approaches that can infer intrinsic protein flexibility without explicit dynamical sampling. We present ProtFlap, a graph neural network framework for predicting relative residue-level flexibility directly from static protein structures. ProtFlap represents proteins as residue interaction graphs and integrates empirical atomic energy features extracted from a single energy-minimised snapshot with structural and sequence-derived descriptors. Central to our approach is the hypothesis that the local atomic energy network encoded in a frozen protein structure contains sufficient information to estimate structural flexibility. Trained using atomic mobility labels, quantified via normalised root-mean-square fluctuation (RMSF) derived from short MD simulations, ProtFlap achieves robust and accurate flexibility prediction across diverse protein domains. Feature attribution analysis reveals that van der Waals-related energy terms are the dominant contributors to the prediction.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质柔性是分子识别、催化和调控的关键决定因素，但在大规模上仍难以表征。分子动力学（MD）模拟可对随时间变化的动力学提供详细描述，但计算成本高昂。尽管近期基于人工智能的结构预测方法大大提高了获得高质量静态蛋白质结构的便利性，但它们本质上缺乏对功能理解至关重要的动态涨落信息。因此，需要可扩展的、基于结构的计算方法，在无需显式动力学采样的情况下推断蛋白质的内在柔性。我们提出了 ProtFlap，一个可直接从静态蛋白质结构预测残基水平相对柔性的图神经网络框架。ProtFlap 将蛋白质表示为残基相互作用图，并将从单个能量最小化快照中提取的经验原子能量特征与结构及序列衍生描述符相整合。我们方法的核心假设是：冻结的蛋白质结构中所编码的局部原子能量网络包含足以估计结构柔性的信息。ProtFlap 使用原子迁移率标签（通过由短时 MD 模拟得到的归一化均方根涨落（RMSF）进行量化）进行训练，在多种蛋白质结构域上实现了稳健而准确的柔性预测。特征归因分析显示，与范德华相关的能量项是预测的主要贡献者。

title: Machine Learning-Enhanced Mucosal Luminal Interface Metaproteomics Reveals Diagnostic Potential of Microbial Proteins in Pediatric Inflammatory Bowel Disease
zh_title: 机器学习结合黏膜腔界面宏蛋白质组学诊断儿童炎症性肠病
summary: 分析儿童IBD患者与健康对照的人源蛋白质组和微生物宏蛋白质组，用特征选择与机器学习构建区分IBD及亚型的诊断panel。
key_points: 采集黏膜腔界面样本
分别分析人源蛋白与微生物蛋白
目标为诊断IBD并区分CD与UC
reason: 预印本，样本信息有限，未见外部验证
abstract: Abstract: Background: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), a chronic gastrointestinal disorder with two main subtypes, Crohn's Disease (CD) and Ulcerative Colitis (UC), is associated with more aggressive phenotypes and greater diagnostic complexity in pediatric patients. Conventional diagnostic biomarkers, lack sufficient distinguishing power between IBD subtypes. This study aimed to investigate and compare proteomic and metaproteomic profiles of pediatric IBD (PIBD) patients and healthy controls to develop a diagnostic panel capable of accurately diagnose IBD and distinguish its subtypes. Methods: We performed an in-depth evaluation of mucosal luminal interface samples from PIBD patients and healthy individuals, separately analyzing both the human proteome and microbial metaproteome data. The study involved selecting appropriate protein sets, employing feature selection techniques and machine learning across three intestinal regions: the terminal ileum, ascending colon, and descending colon. Results: Notably, panels composed solely of microbial biomarkers outperformed both human-only and combined human-microbial panels, achieving highly accurate results. Furthermore, the ascending colon emerged as the optimal sampling site, a result that aligns with the rich microbial diversity revealed in its taxonomic profile. Conclusions: Using a machine learning-based strategy on combined proteomics and metaproteomics, this study uncovered disease-relevant signaling pathways and delivered taxonomic as well as functional insights into the microbial dysbiosis of PIBD. A diagnostic panel built around microbial proteins (particularly those originating from the ascending colon) emerges as a promising tool for more precise stratification of PIBD subtypes. Larger, prospective studies are now needed to validate these candidate biomarkers and translate them into clinically deployable diagnostic panels. Keywords: Metaproteome, Biomarker, Pediatric Inflammatory bowel disease, Machine learning, Mucosal luminal interface.
zh_abstract: 【背景】炎症性肠病（IBD）是一种慢性胃肠道疾病，有克罗恩病（CD）和溃疡性结肠炎（UC）两种主要亚型，在儿科患者中与更具侵袭性的表型和更高的诊断复杂性相关。传统诊断生物标志物在区分IBD亚型方面能力不足。本研究旨在调查并比较儿童IBD（PIBD）患者与健康对照的蛋白质组和宏蛋白质组谱，以建立能够准确诊断IBD并区分其亚型的诊断组合。【方法】我们对PIBD患者和健康个体的黏膜腔面样本进行了深入评估，分别分析人类蛋白质组和微生物宏蛋白质组数据。研究包括选择合适的蛋白集，并在三个肠段（回肠末端、升结肠和降结肠）采用特征选择技术和机器学习。【结果】值得注意的是，仅由微生物生物标志物组成的组合优于仅含人类蛋白和人类–微生物联合的组合，取得了高度准确的结果。此外，升结肠被确定为最佳采样部位，这一结果与其分类学谱所显示的丰富微生物多样性一致。【结论】本研究采用基于机器学习的策略，对蛋白质组和宏蛋白质组数据进行联合分析，揭示了与疾病相关的信号通路，并提供了PIBD微生物失调的分类学和功能层面的见解。以微生物蛋白（尤其是来源于升结肠者）为核心构建的诊断组合，有望成为更精确分层PIBD亚型的工具。目前需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来验证这些候选生物标志物，并将其转化为可临床应用的诊断组合。关键词：宏蛋白质组；生物标志物；儿童炎症性肠病；机器学习；黏膜腔面。

title: Spatial causal discovery reveals novel mechanisms of cellular senescence in human liver
zh_title: 空间因果发现揭示人肝细胞衰老新机制
summary: 预印本利用具理论保证的机器学习因果发现算法分析Visium空间转录组数据，构建肝组织细胞衰老的因果与效应模型。
key_points: 分析人肝Visium空间转录组数据
使用具正确性保证的因果发现算法
生成衰老成因与效应的数据驱动模型
reason: 新颖因果方法的预印本，摘要缺少验证细节
abstract: The complex network of mechanisms that surround cellular senescence, such as its precise causes and effects, are not entirely understood at present. Senescence occurs when a cell permanently ceases dividing, halts apoptosis, stops performing its normal functions, and begins secreting chemicals that can induce other cells in its environment to also become senescent. Senescent cells are present in both healthy and unhealthy tissue, but their abundance is positively correlated with disease and age. A better understanding of senescence could lead to healthier aging, improved recovery from chemotherapy, or increased lifespan. This study used novel machine learning algorithms - with guaranteed properties of correctness under broad assumptions - to investigate senescence in human liver tissue by analyzing Visium spatial transcriptomics data. This produced data-driven models of the causes and effects of senescence, both locally and from nearby tissue. This report includes an assessment of whether the data meet key requirements for causal analysis, the transcripts identified by causal analyses as causes and effects of senescence marker genes, and pathway analyses of those gene sets.
zh_abstract: 围绕细胞衰老的复杂机制网络（例如其确切的原因和影响）目前尚未被完全理解。衰老发生时，细胞永久停止分裂，停止凋亡，不再执行其正常功能，并开始分泌可诱导其所处环境中其他细胞同样发生衰老的化学物质。衰老细胞存在于健康组织和病变组织中，但其丰度与疾病和年龄呈正相关。更好地理解衰老可能带来更健康的衰老过程、化疗后更好的恢复或寿命的延长。本研究使用在宽泛假设下具有正确性保证的新型机器学习算法，通过分析 Visium 空间转录组学数据来研究人类肝组织中的衰老。由此得到了衰老的原因和影响（包括局部以及来自邻近组织的原因和影响）的数据驱动模型。本报告包括：对数据是否满足因果分析关键要求的评估；因果分析所识别出的、作为衰老标志基因的原因和影响的转录本；以及对这些基因集的通路分析。

title: Learning curve analysis of artificial intelligence-assisted ultrasound for teaching popliteal fossa sciatic nerve block to novice anesthesiologists: a pilot randomized educational study.
zh_title: AI辅助超声教学腘窝坐骨神经阻滞的学习曲线：随机教育先导研究
summary: 一项上海的先导随机教育研究，纳入21名麻醉住院医师，比较AI辅助与常规超声培训；CUSUM分析显示AI组约12次操作出现拐点。
key_points: 21名新手麻醉医师，AI组10人、常规组11人
评估图像获取与解读、复盘时间、学员发言时间等
AI组CUSUM拐点约12次，常规组未见可比拐点
reason: 单中心小样本先导教育研究，无临床结局，属增量档
abstract: [PeerJ] Artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted ultrasound may improve ultrasound-guided regional nerve blocks, but its effect on novice learning curves is unclear. In this pilot randomized educational study (June-August 2025), inexperienced anesthesiology residents from Shanghai General Hospital were assigned to AI-assisted or conventional training groups. The AI group used an ultrasound system with an AI module and received additional ethics and principles training, while the conventional group received standard training. Image acquisition and interpretation, debriefing time, trainee speaking time, and feedback were evaluated. Twenty-one trainee anesthesiologists were recruited (AI, n = 10; conventional, n = 11). The group-level cumulative sum (CUSUM) analysis identified an estimated turning point (TP) at approximately 12 attempts in the AI group. No comparable TP was identified within the 15-attempt training period in the conventional group. No statistically significant between-group differences were detected in participant-level phase-specific success rates (all P > 0.05). Compared with the conventional group, the AI group reported higher post-training feedback scores for training content (4.7 ± 0.5 vs. 3.6 ± 1.0, P = 0.0076), satisfaction (4.9 ± 0.3 vs. 3.5 ± 0.8, P < 0.0001), and confidence (5.0 ± 0.0 vs. 4.5 ± 0.7, P = 0.0216). Compared with the conventional group, the AI group also had a shorter participant-level mean debriefing time (7.33 ± 0.34 vs. 10.65 ± 0.61 min, P < 0.0001) and a greater proportion of trainee speaking time during debriefing (69.5% (65.70, 70.55) vs. 49.0% (46.70, 49.70), P < 0.0001). AI-assisted ultrasound training might enhance post-training feedback, increase satisfaction and confidence, and reduce debriefing time among inexperienced anesthesiology residents, suggesting its potential utility in the medical education of ultrasound.
zh_abstract: [PeerJ] 人工智能（AI）辅助超声可能改善超声引导下区域神经阻滞，但其对初学者学习曲线的影响尚不明确。在这项试点随机教育研究（2025年6月至8月）中，来自上海市总医院、缺乏经验的麻醉科住院医师被分配至 AI 辅助培训组或常规培训组。AI 组使用带有 AI 模块的超声系统，并接受额外的伦理与原则培训，而常规组接受标准培训。研究评估了图像获取与解读、复盘（debriefing）时间、学员发言时间及反馈。共招募 21 名麻醉科学员（AI 组 n = 10；常规组 n = 11）。组水平累积和（CUSUM）分析显示，AI 组的估计转折点（TP）约在第 12 次操作；而常规组在 15 次操作的培训期内未发现可比的转折点。在参与者水平的各阶段成功率方面，未检测到组间存在统计学显著差异（所有 P > 0.05）。与常规组相比，AI 组在培训后反馈评分中，培训内容（4.7 ± 0.5 vs. 3.6 ± 1.0，P = 0.0076）、满意度（4.9 ± 0.3 vs. 3.5 ± 0.8，P < 0.0001）和信心（5.0 ± 0.0 vs. 4.5 ± 0.7，P = 0.0216）得分更高。与常规组相比，AI 组参与者水平的平均复盘时间更短（7.33 ± 0.34 vs. 10.65 ± 0.61 分钟，P < 0.0001），复盘期间学员发言时间所占比例更高（69.5%（65.70，70.55）vs. 49.0%（46.70，49.70），P < 0.0001）。AI 辅助超声培训可能改善缺乏经验的麻醉科住院医师的培训后反馈，提高其满意度和信心，并缩短复盘时间，提示其在超声医学教育中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Remote Monitoring After Cardiac Surgery: A Prospective Single-Centre Feasibility Study with Retrospective Wound Image Classification.
zh_title: 心脏手术后AI增强远程监测：单中心前瞻可行性研究
summary: 76例患者进行30天术后远程监测，并对735张伤口照片回顾性训练卷积网络集成分类器，评估其分诊准确性。
key_points: 前瞻性单中心，76例患者监测30天
评估可行性、可接受度与依从性
735张照片、88处伤口回顾性训练分类器
reason: 单中心小样本可行性研究，AI部分为回顾性
abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Background/Objectives: Unplanned readmission within 30 days affects 12-20% of patients after cardiac surgery, largely through complications developing at home. We evaluated the feasibility, acceptability, and adherence of a 30-day post-discharge remote monitoring programme. In a separate retrospective analysis that did not inform patient care, we also assessed how accurately an investigational AI-based classifier triages the programme's wound photographs. Methods: In this prospective single-centre study, 76 of 85 screened patients were monitored for 30 days with twice-daily blood pressure and pulse, daily weight, electrocardiography (ECG), and alternate-day wound photographs, all reviewed daily by a study clinician. Retrospectively, 735 photographs of 88 wounds from 71 patients, labelled by two blinded clinicians, were used to train an ensemble of five convolutional neural networks, tested on a patient-disjoint test set of 147 images from 15 patients. Results: All 76 eligible patients enrolled and 75 (99%) completed the programme, with 82% adherence to the core measurements and an acceptability score of 6.3 (SD 0.5) of 7. Daily review produced 494 teleconsultations, 10 emergency referrals, and 6 admissions (7.9%), and atrial fibrillation was confirmed in 18 episodes in 11 patients. Agreement between the two wound labelling clinicians was κ 0.89. On the test set, the classifier achieved an area under the precision-recall curve of 0.747 (95% CI 0.402-1.000), image-level sensitivity 73.3% (11/15; 95% CI 33.3-100%), precision 73.3%, and wound-level sensitivity 5/6; the one confirmed wound complication in the test set was flagged. Conclusions: Intensive remote monitoring with daily clinician review was feasible after cardiac surgery and was sustained by patients. Daily review identified arrhythmias and wound problems, most of which were managed remotely or in the outpatient clinic. The classifier is a proof of concept for automated triage of such photographs by reproducing clinicians' visual judgment; given the wide confidence intervals, larger multicentre validation is needed.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine]【背景/目的】心脏手术后 12–20% 的患者发生 30 天内非计划再入院，主要是由于在家中出现并发症。我们评估了一项出院后 30 天远程监测方案的可行性、可接受性和依从性。在一项不影响患者诊疗的单独回顾性分析中，我们还评估了一种研究性的基于人工智能的分类器对该方案中伤口照片进行分诊的准确性。【方法】在这项前瞻性单中心研究中，85 名筛查患者中的 76 名接受了 30 天监测，包括每日两次血压和脉搏、每日体重、心电图（ECG）以及隔日伤口照片，所有数据均由一名研究临床医生每日审阅。回顾性地，使用由两名盲法临床医生标注的来自 71 名患者 88 处伤口的 735 张照片训练了由五个卷积神经网络组成的集成模型，并在来自 15 名患者的 147 张图像构成、与训练集患者互不重叠的测试集上进行测试。【结果】76 名符合条件的患者全部入组，75 名（99%）完成了该方案，核心测量的依从率为 82%，可接受性评分为 6.3（SD 0.5）分（满分 7 分）。每日审阅产生了 494 次远程会诊、10 次急诊转诊和 6 次入院（7.9%），并在 11 名患者中确认了 18 次心房颤动发作。两名伤口标注临床医生之间的一致性为 κ 0.89。在测试集上，分类器的精确率-召回率曲线下面积为 0.747（95% CI 0.402–1.000），图像水平敏感性为 73.3%（11/15；95% CI 33.3–100%），精确率为 73.3%，伤口水平敏感性为 5/6；测试集中唯一一例确认的伤口并发症被标记出。【结论】心脏手术后由临床医生每日审阅的强化远程监测是可行的，并且患者能够坚持。每日审阅发现了心律失常和伤口问题，其中大多数通过远程或门诊处理。该分类器是通过再现临床医生视觉判断来对此类照片进行自动分诊的概念验证；鉴于置信区间较宽，需要更大规模的多中心验证。

title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
zh_title: 从AI远程患者监测迈向具身智能体机器人：范围综述
summary: 范围综述认为成熟的智能体式照护尚未出现，多数系统仍由人主导，具身AI多停留在原型和试点阶段，治理与临床整合是关键。
key_points: 多数系统仍为人主导，决策-行动耦合较弱
具身AI基本局限于原型与试点
强调安全、可互操作架构与人类监督
reason: 范围综述属综述类，信息泛化，预印本
abstract: AI-enabled remote patient monitoring is evolving beyond passive data collection toward agentic AI systems that interpret patient states, coordinate care, and initiate action across domestic and clinical settings. This structured scoping review finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged: Most systems remain human led, while stronger decision-action coupling and embodied AI remain largely confined to prototypes and pilots. Healthcare robotics makes the transition from monitoring to action especially visible by translating AI-generated recommendations and decisions into speech, movement, prompting, physical assistance, escalation, and care coordination, making embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight, and governance fundamental design requirements. Further progress requires safe and interoperable care architectures in which intelligent components operate through clinically validated and accountable workflows. We propose agentic robotics as a future direction for supervised systems embedded in the care ecosystem, connecting AI agents and robots with clinicians, caregivers, and patients through auditable workflows that can be interrupted and remain subject to human oversight and explicit AI governance.
zh_abstract: 人工智能赋能的远程患者监测正从被动数据收集向能够解读患者状态、协调照护并在家庭和临床环境中启动行动的能动型（agentic）人工智能系统演进。这项结构化范围综述发现，成熟的能动型照护尚未出现：大多数系统仍以人为主导，而更强的决策-行动耦合和具身人工智能在很大程度上仍局限于原型和试点。医疗机器人使从监测到行动的转变尤为明显，它将人工智能生成的建议和决策转化为言语、动作、提示、身体协助、升级上报和照护协调，使具身性、临床整合、人工监督和治理成为基本的设计要求。进一步的进展需要安全且可互操作的照护架构，使智能组件通过经临床验证且可问责的工作流程运行。我们提出将能动型机器人作为未来方向：在照护生态系统中运行的受监督系统，通过可审计、可中断并持续受人工监督和明确人工智能治理约束的工作流程，将人工智能代理和机器人与临床医生、照护者及患者连接起来。

title: Between Obligations and Evidence: A Participatory Study of Translating the EU AI Act into Technical Requirements
zh_title: 将欧盟AI法案转化为技术要求的参与式研究
summary: 通过32人参与的工作坊，以医疗等场景考察如何把欧盟AI法案义务转化为可衡量的技术要求与合规证据。
key_points: 参与者含研究者、政策制定者和从业者
场景涵盖医疗、招聘和公共交通
发现义务转化、责任监督与证据有效性间的张力
reason: 监管主题的定性研究，医疗仅为场景之一，预印本
abstract: The EU AI Act imposes technical and organizational requirements for high-risk AI systems, but applying these requirements involves contextual choices about what to measure and what evidence supports a compliance claim. We investigate these challenges through a participatory workshop involving 32 researchers, policymakers, and practitioners from different disciplines, using realistic scenarios in healthcare, recruitment, and public transport to examine how regulatory obligations are interpreted, translated into technical requirements, and evaluated in practice. Through a thematic analysis of workshop data, we identify recurring tensions between how regulatory obligations are translated into measurable system properties, how responsibility and human oversight are exercised in practice, and how the validity of compliance evidence is affected by changing operational conditions and system uses. For example, participants highlighted how fairness metrics could conceal discrimination in recruitment, how time pressure and limited information could undermine human oversight in public transport, and how changes in patient populations could invalidate previously established evidence of system performance. Our findings suggest that technical, organizational, and evidentiary challenges are interdependent, and that establishing and maintaining compliance requires attention not only to technical assessments but also to how AI systems are used, governed, and monitored over time. We discuss implications for supporting context-sensitive and ongoing compliance.
zh_abstract: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act）对高风险人工智能系统提出了技术和组织方面的要求，但落实这些要求需要在衡量什么以及何种证据可支持合规声明方面做出结合具体情境的选择。我们通过一次参与式研讨会来探讨这些挑战，研讨会汇集了来自不同学科的32名研究人员、政策制定者和从业者，采用医疗、招聘和公共交通领域的现实场景，考察监管义务如何被解读、转化为技术要求并在实践中进行评估。通过对研讨会数据的主题分析，我们识别出若干反复出现的矛盾：监管义务如何转化为可衡量的系统属性、责任与人工监督在实践中如何履行，以及合规证据的有效性如何受到运行条件和系统用途变化的影响。例如，参与者指出，公平性指标可能掩盖招聘中的歧视；时间压力和信息有限可能削弱公共交通中的人工监督；患者群体的变化可能使先前确立的系统性能证据失效。我们的研究结果表明，技术、组织和证据方面的挑战相互依存，建立并维持合规不仅需要关注技术评估，还需要关注人工智能系统如何随时间被使用、治理和监测。我们讨论了这些发现对支持具有情境敏感性且持续进行的合规工作的意义。

title: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
zh_title: 基于动态形状控制的多视图超声心动图AI合成
summary: 提出形状可控的多视图超声心动图序列合成框架，从动态全心网格提取多视图截面，再经两阶段AI流程生成超声样外观。
key_points: 针对标注数据稀缺，用合成数据缓解
突破现有方法依赖左心室形状或特定视图的限制
保持多视图跨心腔一致性
reason: 预印本合成方法，摘要未见临床验证，增量档
abstract: Although automated methods have improved echocardiographic workflows, progress remains constrained by the need for large, well-annotated datasets. As the development of clinical databases is often limited by ethical and logistical challenges, synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising alternative. However, existing approaches commonly rely on left ventricle shape-based supervision or are tailored to specific cardiac views, limiting the generation of additional standard and unconventional imaging planes and the preservation of multi-view consistency across cardiac chambers. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework for shape-controlled synthesis of multi-view echocardiographic sequences. First, multi-view cross-sections are extracted from dynamic whole-heart meshes. Ultrasound-like appearance is then introduced through a two-stage AI-based pipeline. In Stage 1, an unpaired GAN-diffusion model translates these cross-sections into realistic echocardiographic frames. As this translation is performed independently at the frame level, Stage 2 employs masked video reconstruction to improve temporal coherence and cardiac motion. Evaluation demonstrated high frame-level realism for both stages, while the integration of Stage 2 substantially improved video-level motion quality and temporal consistency. Overall, the proposed framework enables the generation of realistic multi-view echocardiographic sequences from diverse cardiac models, providing a scalable source of annotated data for dataset augmentation and the development of multi-view cardiac assessment methods.
zh_abstract: 尽管自动化方法已改善超声心动图工作流程，但进展仍受限于对大规模、标注良好的数据集的需求。由于临床数据库的建立常受伦理和后勤方面的挑战所限，合成数据生成已成为一种有前景的替代方案。然而，现有方法通常依赖基于左心室形状的监督，或针对特定心脏切面量身定制，从而限制了更多标准及非常规成像平面的生成，也限制了跨心腔多视角一致性的保持。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种用于形状可控的多视角超声心动图序列合成的新框架。首先，从动态全心网格中提取多视角截面。随后通过基于人工智能的两阶段流程引入类超声外观。在第1阶段，一个非配对的GAN-扩散模型将这些截面转换为逼真的超声心动图帧。由于这一转换是在帧级别独立进行的，第2阶段采用掩码视频重建来改善时间连贯性和心脏运动。评估显示，两个阶段均具有较高的帧级真实感，而第2阶段的整合显著提升了视频级的运动质量和时间一致性。总体而言，所提出的框架能够从多样的心脏模型生成逼真的多视角超声心动图序列，为数据集扩充及多视角心脏评估方法的开发提供了可扩展的带标注数据来源。

title: Towards Explainable Sleep Stage Classification using Single-Channel Electroencephalogram
zh_title: 基于单通道脑电的可解释睡眠分期
summary: 扩展SleepXAI框架，比较五种XAI方法，并以AASM脑电频段作为参照评估归因保真度，在Sleep-EDF与DREAMT数据集上实验。
key_points: 比较五种可解释方法
以Spearman相关对照AASM频段评估归因
DREAMT按AHI分四个OSA严重度组
reason: 预印本，公开基准数据集，有可解释性评估但无外部临床验证，增量档
abstract: Automated sleep staging has achieved strong bench- mark accuracy; however, clinical adoption remains limited due to a lack of interpretability. In this work, we fill the research gap by extending the SleepXAI sleep staging framework to systematically compare five different XAI methods. Further, attribution fidelity is evaluated using Spearman rank correlation with AASM-defined EEG frequency bands, serving as clinically grounded reference signals. In this paper, we focus on single- channel Electroencephalogram (EEG), which is more amenable to practical clinical deployment compared to full polysomnography setups. Experiments are conducted on the Sleep-EDF benchmark dataset and the DREAMT dataset. In DREAMT, we stratified subjects based on OSA into four Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI) severity groups. We observed that the SleepXAI model achieves strong classification performance on both datasets. Among the evaluated methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) consistently achieves the highest mean attribution fidelity across all five sleep stages on Sleep-EDF and across all AHI groups on DREAMT, outperforming all other evaluated methods under the Spearman rank correlation metric. These findings highlight the importance of attribution method selection as a key factor for ensuring reliable and clinically interpretable automated sleep staging systems.
zh_abstract: 自动睡眠分期已取得出色的基准准确率；然而，由于缺乏可解释性，其临床应用仍然有限。在本研究中，我们通过扩展 SleepXAI 睡眠分期框架，系统比较五种不同的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法，以填补这一研究空白。此外，我们以美国睡眠医学会（AASM）定义的脑电图（EEG）频带作为具有临床依据的参考信号，采用 Spearman 等级相关评估归因保真度。本文聚焦于单通道脑电图（EEG），与完整的多导睡眠图配置相比，其更适合实际临床部署。实验在 Sleep-EDF 基准数据集和 DREAMT 数据集上进行。在 DREAMT 中，我们根据阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）将受试者按呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）严重程度分为四组。我们观察到，SleepXAI 模型在两个数据集上均取得了较强的分类性能。在所评估的方法中，积分梯度（Integrated Gradients，IG）在 Sleep-EDF 的全部五个睡眠分期以及 DREAMT 的全部 AHI 分组中，始终获得最高的平均归因保真度，在 Spearman 等级相关指标下优于所有其他被评估方法。这些发现凸显了归因方法的选择是确保自动睡眠分期系统可靠且具有临床可解释性的关键因素。

title: CONTEXT-PCa: Evaluating the role of clinical context in MRI-based AI for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer (study protocol)
zh_title: CONTEXT-PCa：临床背景对前列腺癌MRI AI的作用（研究方案）
summary: 研究方案，在固定权重的PI-CAI-2B纯影像模型上加入43项临床变量，基于UCLH 6022例bpMRI评估对有临床意义前列腺癌检测的影响。
key_points: 4540例患者，4834例留作内部测试
主要终点为图像加背景与纯影像AUROC差
变量来自结构化记录、信件、报告和影像测量
reason: 仅为研究方案无结果，样本大但单中心
abstract: The objective of this study is to investigate the role of clinical variables - their breadth, source, and quality - in the development, utility, and generalisability of an AI system for bi-parametric MRI (bpMRI)-based diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa). Clinical context is added to the published PI-CAI-2B image-only model, whose weights are fixed. The study cohort comprises 6,022 biparametric MRI cases from 4,540 patients at University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (2019-2024), of which 4,834 cases (3,632 patients) are held out for internal testing. Forty-three clinical variables are drawn from structured health records, clinical letters, MRI reports, and automated image measurements. The primary endpoint is the difference in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) between the image-context and image-only models on the internal test set. Secondary analyses compare combining strategies, the contribution of individual variables, and performance across subgroups. All models are further tested on five external cohorts from primary diagnosis and population-based screening.

title: Learned Regularization for Sparse-View CT: Accuracy, Lesion Detectability and Distribution Shift of a Plug-and-Play Prior against Tuned Total Variation
zh_title: 稀疏视角CT学习正则化：与调优TV的准确性、病灶可检测性及分布偏移
summary: 在合成数据上比较即插即用DnCNN先验与调优TV等方法，发现先验优势在分布偏移下缩小甚至反转。
key_points: 中等噪声下先验较TV约高3.4 dB
分布偏移时MNIST训练先验低于TV 3.1–4.6 dB
含病灶插入的可检测性评估
reason: 主要为合成小图像实验，缺乏真实临床数据
abstract: Learned image priors are often proposed to replace hand-crafted regularizers in sparse-view computed tomography (CT), yet they are usually judged by PSNR on data resembling their training set. We evaluate one noise-conditioned DnCNN denoiser used as a Plug-and-Play prior against filtered back-projection (FBP), Tikhonov and total-variation (TV) regularization, with every method tuned on validation data and all differences paired. On synthetic 28x28 digit images, the prior beats box-constrained TV by about 3.4 dB at moderate noise (sigma = 0.05, 20 angles), but the advantage shrinks at low noise and reverses under distribution shift: an MNIST-trained prior is 3.1 dB (Fashion-MNIST) and 4.3-4.6 dB (Shepp-Logan phantom) below TV, whereas a Fashion-MNIST-trained prior beats TV by 2.2 dB on Fashion-MNIST, consistent with prior mismatch rather than a failure of PnP itself. In a lesion-insertion test the prior detects lesions worse than TV in distribution despite its higher PSNR, and under mismatch it produces more lesion-like false blobs than box-constrained TV for seven of eight lesion types. On real LoDoPaB-CT slices (patient-disjoint split; 30, 60 and 120 angles; three dose levels; 40 test patients), the prior does not consistently outperform a well-tuned TV in PSNR (-0.93 to +0.33 dB) and has lower SSIM in eight of nine conditions. Its lesion-detection AUC is higher than this TV's in all nine conditions (significant in six) but never significantly higher than that of Hann-filtered FBP, which the PSNR-tuned TV falls below in detection in all nine conditions (seven significant). On non-anatomical phantoms its PSNR falls below TV in all six conditions. PSNR and lesion detectability thus rank the methods differently. Our conclusions concern one small denoiser, and the CT analysis was developed after seeing results, without pre-specified primary comparisons.
zh_abstract: 学习得到的图像先验常被提议用于取代稀疏视角计算机断层成像（CT）中手工设计的正则项，但它们通常是在与其训练集相似的数据上以 PSNR 来评判。我们将一个以噪声为条件的 DnCNN 去噪器作为即插即用（Plug-and-Play）先验，与滤波反投影（FBP）、Tikhonov 正则和全变分（TV）正则进行比较，所有方法均在验证数据上调参，且所有差异均为配对比较。在合成的 28x28 数字图像上，在中等噪声（sigma = 0.05，20 个角度）下，该先验比带盒约束的 TV 好约 3.4 dB，但在低噪声时优势缩小，并在分布偏移下反转：以 MNIST 训练的先验比 TV 低 3.1 dB（Fashion-MNIST）和 4.3-4.6 dB（Shepp-Logan 体模），而以 Fashion-MNIST 训练的先验在 Fashion-MNIST 上比 TV 好 2.2 dB，这与先验失配一致，而非 PnP 本身的失败。在病灶植入测试中，尽管该先验 PSNR 更高，其在分布内检测病灶的能力却不如 TV；在失配情况下，对八种病灶类型中的七种，它比带盒约束的 TV 产生更多类似病灶的假斑块。在真实 LoDoPaB-CT 切片上（患者互不重叠的划分；30、60 和 120 个角度；三种剂量水平；40 名测试患者），该先验在 PSNR 上并不始终优于调好参的 TV（-0.93 至 +0.33 dB），并在九种条件中的八种中 SSIM 更低。其病灶检测 AUC 在全部九种条件下均高于该 TV（六种显著），但从未显著高于 Hann 滤波 FBP，而经 PSNR 调参的 TV 在检测方面在全部九种条件下均低于 Hann 滤波 FBP（七种显著）。在非解剖学体模上，其 PSNR 在全部六种条件下均低于 TV。因此，PSNR 与病灶可检测性对方法的排序并不相同。我们的结论仅涉及一个小型去噪器，且 CT 分析是在看到结果之后才展开的，未预先设定主要比较。

title: Quantifying Membership Inference Risks in Genomic Data Sharing: The Role of Attacker's Auxiliary Information
zh_title: 量化基因组数据共享中的成员推断风险：攻击者辅助信息的作用
summary: 提出基于PCA的服务器辅助发布前审计框架，结合本地差分隐私，在5%假阳性率下估计成员推断攻击效力。
key_points: 在共享低维空间中应用拉普拉斯机制的本地差分隐私
使用距离阈值攻击估计攻击力
关注攻击者辅助信息对风险的影响
reason: 隐私审计方法预印本，摘要无大规模验证
abstract: Genomic data sharing is essential for biomedical research but introduces significant privacy risks, including membership inference attacks, in which an adversary determines whether a specific individual's data was used in a study. Existing privacy protections are typically applied after a release format has already been chosen, leaving researchers without a principled method to assess dataset-specific risk beforehand. We propose a server-assisted, principal component analysis-based pre-release auditing framework that maps genomic data into a shared low-dimensional space, applies epsilon-local differential privacy via the Laplace mechanism with a formally derived sensitivity for principal component analysis scores, and estimates membership inference attack power at a controlled 5% false-positive rate using a distance-threshold attack. A membership-neutrality diagnostic based on Unbiased Reconstruction Robustness is reported alongside attack power, precision, and recall. Experiments using the openSNP and 1000 Genomes Project datasets across multiple dimensionalities and privacy budgets show that separation between the researcher's dataset and public auxiliary data in principal component analysis space is a dominant determinant of attack success, exceeding the effect of perturbation level alone. Comparison against a genome-wide association study-style likelihood ratio test baseline further contextualizes the measured risk. This framework enables researchers, data repositories, and institutional review bodies to quantify dataset-specific membership inference risk before genomic data publication, supporting more informed and privacy-aware biomedical data-sharing decisions.
zh_abstract: 基因组数据共享对生物医学研究至关重要，但会带来显著的隐私风险，包括成员推断攻击，即攻击者判断某一特定个体的数据是否被用于某项研究。现有隐私保护通常在发布格式已确定之后才应用，使研究者缺乏事先评估特定数据集风险的原则性方法。我们提出一种服务器辅助的、基于主成分分析的发布前审计框架：将基因组数据映射到共享的低维空间，通过拉普拉斯机制并利用为主成分分析得分正式推导的敏感度应用ε-局部差分隐私，并使用距离阈值攻击在受控的5%假阳性率下估计成员推断攻击的效力。除攻击效力、精确率和召回率外，还报告基于无偏重构鲁棒性（Unbiased Reconstruction Robustness）的成员中立性诊断。使用openSNP和1000 Genomes Project数据集，在多种维度和隐私预算下进行的实验表明，研究者数据集与公共辅助数据在主成分分析空间中的分离程度是攻击成功的主要决定因素，其影响超过扰动水平本身。与全基因组关联研究式似然比检验基线的比较进一步为所测得的风险提供了参照。该框架使研究者、数据存储库和机构审查机构能够在基因组数据发布前量化特定数据集的成员推断风险，从而支持更明智且注重隐私的生物医学数据共享决策。

title: Interactive deep-learning based interface for brain tumour segmentation
zh_title: 基于深度学习的交互式脑肿瘤分割界面
summary: 提出默认全自动、可由用户便捷修正的交互式脑肿瘤MRI分割系统，以应对不同MR序列带来的分割失误。
key_points: 默认全自动，支持人工校正
针对不同厂商MR序列差异导致的错误
面向手术切除与放疗的精准分割需求
reason: 预印本，交互式分割方法，评估信息有限，增量档
abstract: Brain tumour segmentation from MR images is an integral part of their treatment, either through surgical resection or radiotherapy. Both applications require a high degree of precision that can be difficult to ensure for all patients due to the high degree of variability in the size, shape, number, and location of these tumours. This leads to difficulties with their automatic segmentation via deep learning, which can display catastrophic segmentation errors when presented with images that differ, even subtly, in terms of the specific MR sequence used, which varies from vendor to vendor. This article presents a deep-learning-based interactive segmentation system that, while being fully automatic by default, has the capability of being easily corrected by human users, allowing them ensure sufficiently high brain tumour segmentation accuracy for all patients. This interface is evaluated both in terms of the accuracy of its automatic approach as well as its usability through a preliminary observational expert user study.
zh_abstract: 从MR图像中分割脑肿瘤是其治疗（无论是手术切除还是放射治疗）中不可或缺的一部分。这两种应用都需要高度的精确性，但由于这些肿瘤在大小、形状、数量和位置上存在高度变异，难以对所有患者都确保这一点。这给通过深度学习进行自动分割带来了困难，当面对在所用特定MR序列上哪怕存在细微差异（不同厂商间各不相同）的图像时，深度学习可能出现灾难性的分割错误。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的交互式分割系统，该系统默认完全自动，同时可由人工用户方便地进行修正，使其能够确保所有患者获得足够高的脑肿瘤分割准确性。通过一项初步的观察性专家用户研究，对该界面的自动方法准确性及其可用性进行了评估。

title: CardioTrace: Motion-Aware Cine Synthesis via Coupled Tracing and Segmentation
zh_title: CardioTrace：耦合追踪与分割的运动感知心脏电影合成
summary: 提出由像素翻译、形变场与分割分支组成的框架，从有限输入合成完整心脏cine MRI序列并显式建模心脏运动。
key_points: 像素翻译分支以残差形式预测帧
流场分支估计形变以提供可解释运动对应
分割分支用于保持解剖合理性
reason: 新颖方法预印本，摘要未见外部验证，增量偏上
abstract: Cardiac cine MRI provides time-resolved visualization of cardiac motion and is essential for evaluating ventricular function and anatomy. In routine clinical acquisition, however, cine sequences are frequently temporally sparse or degraded by arrhythmia, motion, and scan-time constraints, which can hinder reliable quantification and downstream analysis. We present CardioTrace, a motion-aware cine synthesis framework that generates a full cardiac cine sequence from limited input while explicitly modeling and tracing cardiac motion. CardioTrace couples two complementary pathways: a pixel-translation branch that directly predicts cine frames in a residual formulation, and a flow-field branch that estimates time-resolved deformation fields from a reference phase to provide interpretable motion correspondences across frames. To further preserve anatomical plausibility, a segmentation branch supervises clinically meaningful cardiac structures at key phases, and a cross-branch consistency objective encourages the synthesized appearance dynamics to follow the explicit motion guidance, mitigating temporal drift and unrealistic shape transitions over long sequences. The framework also supports prompt-style conditioning to incorporate auxiliary patient or acquisition information, improving robustness across heterogeneous multi-center data. Experiments on public cardiac cine MRI datasets demonstrate that CardioTrace improves perceptual quality and temporal coherence over representative GAN- and diffusion-based baselines, while better preserving ventricular morphology throughout the cardiac cycle. \textit{Our codes are available after review}.
zh_abstract: 心脏电影MRI可对心脏运动进行时间分辨的可视化，对于评估心室功能和解剖结构至关重要。然而，在常规临床采集中，电影序列常常在时间上稀疏，或因心律失常、运动和扫描时间限制而质量下降，这可能妨碍可靠的定量和下游分析。我们提出了CardioTrace，一种运动感知的电影合成框架，它可从有限输入生成完整的心脏电影序列，同时显式地建模并追踪心脏运动。CardioTrace结合了两条互补的通路：一条是像素转换分支，以残差形式直接预测电影帧；另一条是流场分支，估计从参考相位出发的时间分辨形变场，以提供跨帧的可解释运动对应关系。为进一步保持解剖学合理性，分割分支在关键相位对具有临床意义的心脏结构进行监督，同时跨分支一致性目标促使合成的外观动态遵循显式的运动引导，从而减轻长序列中的时间漂移和不真实的形状过渡。该框架还支持提示式条件输入，以纳入辅助的患者或采集信息，提高在异质多中心数据上的稳健性。在公开心脏电影MRI数据集上的实验表明，与具有代表性的基于GAN和扩散模型的基线方法相比，CardioTrace改善了感知质量和时间连贯性，同时在整个心动周期中更好地保持了心室形态。我们的代码将在评审后公开。

title: Vessel2Brain: Edge-Aware Multi-Scale Flow Matching for 3D Brain Image Generation from Vessel Masks
zh_title: Vessel2Brain：由血管掩膜生成3D脑MRI的流匹配方法
summary: 提出边缘感知多尺度条件流匹配框架，仅以血管标签图合成完整3D脑MRI，用于数据增强与仿真。
key_points: 仅以血管标签图为条件
边缘感知多尺度条件流匹配
面向数据增强与神经影像分析
reason: 预印本，新方法但摘要未显示充分对比或临床验证
abstract: Generating realistic 3D brain MRI volumes from sparse anatomical priors is a highly ill-posed yet clinically valuable problem, with important applications in data augmentation, simulation, and downstream neuroimaging analysis. In this work, we investigate the challenging task of synthesising full 3D brain MRI volumes conditioned solely on vascular label maps. While vascular structures provide strong anatomical and topological cues, they occupy only a small fraction of the brain volume and offer no direct information about surrounding tissue appearance. To address this challenge, we propose Vessel2Brain, an edge-aware multi-scale conditional flow matching framework that explicitly incorporates vascular structure information into the generative process. Our approach formulates vessel-guided brain image synthesis as a conditional continuous flow, enabling stable training and flexible generation while preserving structural correspondence. A multi-scale flow matching strategy is introduced to jointly model global anatomical coherence and fine-grained local details, with auxiliary velocity predictions providing additional supervision across spatial resolutions. Furthermore, we design an edge-aware objective that emphasises vascular boundaries during training, encouraging anatomically faithful tissue synthesis around vessel structures. We evaluate Vessel2Brain on two public 3D brain MRI datasets with paired vascular annotations. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative models in terms of reconstruction accuracy, structural consistency, and distributional realism.
zh_abstract: 从稀疏的解剖先验生成逼真的三维脑部 MRI 容积是一个高度不适定但具有临床价值的问题，在数据增强、模拟及下游神经影像分析中具有重要应用。在本研究中，我们探讨了仅以血管标签图为条件合成完整三维脑部 MRI 容积这一具有挑战性的任务。血管结构虽能提供较强的解剖和拓扑线索，但仅占脑容积的一小部分，且不能直接提供周围组织外观的信息。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Vessel2Brain，这是一种边缘感知的多尺度条件流匹配框架，可将血管结构信息显式纳入生成过程。我们的方法将血管引导的脑图像合成表述为条件连续流，在保持结构对应关系的同时实现稳定训练和灵活生成。我们引入多尺度流匹配策略，以联合建模全局解剖一致性和细粒度局部细节，并通过辅助速度预测在不同空间分辨率上提供额外监督。此外，我们设计了一种边缘感知目标函数，在训练中强调血管边界，促使血管结构周围的组织合成在解剖上更为真实。我们在两个带有配对血管标注的公开三维脑部 MRI 数据集上评估了 Vessel2Brain。大量定量和定性实验表明，在重建精度、结构一致性和分布真实性方面，我们的方法始终优于最先进的生成模型。

title: When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI
zh_title: 临床AI中评估成为干预
summary: 文章指出，当AI评判模型用于选择提示词或训练模型时，评判者本身成为干预的一部分，选择可能偏向其忽略的错误，并提出评判报告应包含的内容及每次改动所需的独立临床检验。
key_points: AI评判者按量表给其他系统输出打分
用评判结果选提示或训练会使评判成为干预
评判报告需包含特定内容并配独立临床检验
reason: 观点类预印本，议题有价值但无实证数据，属增量档
abstract: AI judges, models that grade another system's output against a rubric, extend clinical review to the scale at which clinical AI writes. When teams use judge assessments to select a prompt or train a model, the judge becomes part of the intervention. Selection can then favor errors the judge overlooks. We describe what a judge's report must contain and the independent clinical test each judge-driven change needs.
zh_abstract: AI 评判者（AI judges）是依据评分标准对另一系统的输出进行评分的模型，可将临床审查扩展到临床 AI 生成内容的规模。当团队利用评判者的评估来选择提示词（prompt）或训练模型时，评判者便成为干预的一部分。这样一来，选择过程可能偏向评判者所忽略的错误。我们阐述了评判者的报告必须包含的内容，以及每一项由评判者驱动的改动所需要的独立临床检验。

title: Multimodal Fusion: A Review of Breast Cancer Advanced and Traditional Modalities
zh_title: 多模态融合：乳腺癌先进与传统成像模态综述
summary: 预印本综述了15余种乳腺癌成像模态及AI在数据、特征、决策层面的多模态融合方法。
key_points: 涵盖钼靶、超声、MRI及热成像、光声等新兴模态
各模态提供互补的结构与功能信息
AI支持数据、特征与决策层融合
reason: 预印本综述，信息有限；多模态方向略加分
abstract: Purpose: Multimodal medical imaging fusion (MMIF) is an increasingly important approach to breast cancer detection (BCD), as different imaging modalities rely on different physical principles and provide complementary information. No single modality can capture all the structural, functional, and biological information needed for accurate diagnosis and characterization. Methods: This review examines more than 15 imaging modalities used in breast cancer detection, including conventional techniques such as mammography, ultrasound, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), as well as emerging approaches such as thermal imaging, photoacoustic imaging, microwave imaging, and multimodal microscopy. Results: Mammography, ultrasound, and MRI remain among the most widely used modalities, providing complementary structural and functional information. Recent AI advances have enabled fusion at the data, feature, and decision levels, with applications in detection, classification, segmentation, prognosis, and personalized cancer management. Multimodal approaches increasingly combine imaging data with clinical, histopathological, and genomic information. However, important challenges remain, including limited availability of large and diverse multimodal datasets, variations in imaging protocols, missing modalities, limited external validation, and the need for interpretable and clinically reliable AI models. Conclusion: MMIF offers promising opportunities to improve breast cancer detection and characterization by combining complementary imaging and non-imaging information. Future research should prioritize robust fusion strategies, standardized and diverse datasets, multicenter validation, explainable and privacy-preserving AI, and the integration of imaging with clinical and molecular data to facilitate reliable translation into clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 【目的】多模态医学影像融合（MMIF）在乳腺癌检测（BCD）中日益重要，因为不同成像模态基于不同的物理原理并提供互补信息。没有任何单一模态能够涵盖准确诊断和特征描述所需的全部结构、功能和生物学信息。【方法】本综述考察了乳腺癌检测中使用的15种以上成像模态，包括乳腺X线摄影、超声和磁共振成像（MRI）等传统技术，以及热成像、光声成像、微波成像和多模态显微镜等新兴方法。【结果】乳腺X线摄影、超声和MRI仍是应用最广泛的模态，可提供互补的结构和功能信息。近期AI的进展使得在数据、特征和决策层面的融合成为可能，应用于检测、分类、分割、预后以及个体化癌症管理。多模态方法越来越多地将影像数据与临床、组织病理学和基因组信息相结合。然而，仍存在重要挑战，包括大型且多样化的多模态数据集有限、成像方案存在差异、模态缺失、外部验证有限，以及需要可解释且临床可靠的AI模型。【结论】MMIF通过结合互补的影像和非影像信息，为改善乳腺癌的检测和特征描述提供了有前景的机会。未来研究应优先关注稳健的融合策略、标准化且多样化的数据集、多中心验证、可解释且保护隐私的AI，以及影像与临床和分子数据的整合，以促进可靠地转化为临床实践。

title: Personalized and Adaptive Federated Learning for Canine Cardiomegaly Keypoint Prediction
zh_title: 个性化自适应联邦学习用于犬心脏肥大关键点预测
summary: 提出PAFL框架，通过关键点预测计算椎体心脏评分并分类心脏肥大，用参数分解架构应对跨机构异质性。
key_points: 关键点预测后基于几何计算VHS
分离共享表征与客户端特定适配模块
面向犬胸部X线的跨机构联邦训练
reason: 兽医场景联邦学习方法，证据有限，属增量档
abstract: In the field of medical imaging, limited data and cross-institutional heterogeneity remain major challenges for training robust deep learning models. Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising approach that enables collaborative training across institutions while preserving data privacy by keeping datasets local. In this work, we propose a structure-aware personalized and adaptive federated learning framework, PAFL, for automatic vertebral heart score (VHS) estimation and cardiomegaly classification from canine thoracic X-rays. Our method treats the task as anatomical keypoint prediction followed by geometry-based VHS computation, introducing implicit structural consistency and improving interpretability. To address cross-institutional heterogeneity, we adopt a parameter-decomposed architecture that separates shared feature representations from client-specific adaptation modules. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive, quality-aware aggregation strategy that dynamically weights client contributions based on both dataset size and model quality, thereby enhancing robustness to non-IID data distributions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed PAFL framework improves models' predictive performance compared to isolated training and to conventional and existing personalized federated learning (PFL) methods. Our results demonstrate the potential of integrating structure-aware modeling with PFL for reliable and interpretable medical image analysis.
zh_abstract: 在医学影像领域，数据有限和机构间异质性仍是训练稳健深度学习模型的主要挑战。联邦学习（FL）已成为一种有前景的方法，它通过将数据集保留在本地，在保护数据隐私的同时实现跨机构协作训练。在本研究中，我们提出一种结构感知的个性化自适应联邦学习框架PAFL，用于根据犬胸部X线片自动估计椎体心脏评分（VHS）并分类心脏扩大。我们的方法将该任务视为解剖关键点预测，随后进行基于几何的VHS计算，从而引入隐式结构一致性并提高可解释性。为应对机构间异质性，我们采用参数分解架构，将共享特征表征与客户端特异性适配模块分开。此外，我们引入一种自适应的、质量感知的聚合策略，根据数据集大小和模型质量动态加权各客户端的贡献，从而增强对非独立同分布（non-IID）数据分布的稳健性。实验结果表明，与独立训练以及传统和现有的个性化联邦学习（PFL）方法相比，所提出的PAFL框架提高了模型的预测性能。我们的结果证明了将结构感知建模与PFL相结合，用于可靠且可解释的医学图像分析的潜力。

title: Artificial Intelligence in the Urology Residency Match: Use, Perceptions, and Implications.
zh_title: 泌尿外科住院医师匹配中AI的使用与认知
summary: 对单一项目70名申请者的调查显示，51%在申请过程中使用AI，且高估了同伴的使用率。
key_points: 70份有效问卷，应答率45%
ChatGPT使用最多(83%)

reason: 单中心小样本问卷，与医疗AI关系较弱
abstract: [Journal of surgical education] To evaluate artificial intelligence (AI) use and perceptions among urology applicants during the 2025 to 2026 residency match cycle. An anonymous survey was distributed to all applicants at a single academic urology residency program after rank list submission and before match day. A 29-item subset of the survey was analyzed, which assessed applicant demographics, application components, AI use patterns, and perceptions regarding various AI-related issues. Both descriptive and between-group comparison statistics were utilized to summarize responses. Seventy complete responses were analyzed, resulting in a 45% response rate. Overall, 51% of applicants reported using AI during the application process, but inaccurately perceived higher rates of use among their peers. ChatGPT was the most used AI tool (83%). Inaccurate or misleading AI-generated information was common, and though 86% encountered it at least once, only 44% of applicants always verified AI outputs. AI was most often used for personal statement writing, application content, and interview preparation, with these also rated as most helpful. Among AI users, 61% reported at least slight improvement in application material quality, whereas only 44% reported the same for interview preparation. Few respondents supported restricting applicant AI use (23%), while the majority (54%) supported prohibiting AI use by residency programs. Urology applicants report wide but varied use of AI across the residency match cycle, with modest perceived benefits despite mixed opinions on allowing AI use going forward. Nevertheless, thoughtfully designed and ethically integrated AI tools have immense potential to increase efficiency, equity, and outcomes in the competitive urology match process.

title: The Evaluation of Developmental Dysplasia of Hip from Pediatric Ultrasound Images by Key Point-Based Deep Learning.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) is a common hip disorder in infants. Ultrasound is the primary imaging modality for infants younger than 6 months, but measurements using the Graf and Harcke methods depend on examiner experience. This study aimed to develop and internally validate a key point-based deep learning model for the automated measurement of the Graf α and β angles and femoral head coverage. Methods: A total of 300 standard-plane hip ultrasound images from 165 infants aged 0-6 months were retrospectively collected at a single tertiary center, and reference key points were determined by consensus of pediatric orthopedic surgeons. We developed a dual-branch network, named "DDH-KPNet," which combines a UNet++ convolutional branch and a transformer branch fused with attention modules. Performance was evaluated with fivefold cross-validation at three levels: accuracy of key point localization; intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC); and DDH classification. Results: The experimental results demonstrated that Graf-based classification achieved accuracy = 0.903, sensitivity = 0.81, and specificity = 0.9497 (under 95% conference interval); Harcke classification achieved accuracy = 0.942, sensitivity = 0.888, and specificity = 0.968 (under 95% conference interval); and ICCs for α = 0.832, β = 0.728, and coverage = 0.923. Conclusions: The proposed model showed promising agreement with expert measurements under internal validation. Multicenter external validation and independent diagnostic analysis by different physicians are required before clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 【背景】发育性髋关节发育不良（DDH）是婴儿常见的髋关节疾病。超声是6个月以下婴儿的主要影像学检查方式，但采用Graf法和Harcke法的测量依赖检查者经验。本研究旨在开发并内部验证一种基于关键点的深度学习模型，用于自动测量Graf α角和β角以及股骨头覆盖率。【方法】在单一三级中心回顾性收集了165名0-6个月婴儿的300幅标准切面髋关节超声图像，参考关键点由小儿骨科医生共识确定。我们开发了名为“DDH-KPNet”的双分支网络，该网络结合了UNet++卷积分支和通过注意力模块融合的Transformer分支。采用五折交叉验证在三个层面评估性能：关键点定位准确性；组内相关系数（ICC）；以及DDH分类。【结果】实验结果显示，基于Graf的分类准确率=0.903，敏感性=0.81，特异性=0.9497（95%置信区间下）；Harcke分类准确率=0.942，敏感性=0.888，特异性=0.968（95%置信区间下）；α角、β角和覆盖率的ICC分别为0.832、0.728和0.923。【结论】在内部验证下，所提出的模型与专家测量结果显示出良好的一致性。在临床应用之前，需要进行多中心外部验证以及由不同医生进行的独立诊断分析。

title: Estimating Outpatient Visit Prices from Hospital Price Transparency Data using Large Language Models

abstract: Objective: Hospital care prices in the United States have increased substantially, yet patients lack effective tools to access and compare costs. We aimed to develop and evaluate an LLM-based approach for improving access to and use of hospital price transparency (PT) data. Materials and Methods: To estimate visit prices, we used a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework to analyze PT files from three major hospitals in Maryland and the surrounding region. We compared BM25, OpenAI embedding models, and a GPT-BM25 hybrid against a no-RAG baseline for cost estimation of individual procedures and procedure groups, then evaluated the best approach for symptom-based visit cost estimation using synthetic simulations. Results: Across hospitals, the GPT-BM25 retriever achieved the best performance, with average price MAPE of 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for groups, compared with 147.98% and 82.82%, respectively, for the no-RAG baseline. In simulations, our framework correctly identified approximately 50% of reference procedures and reduced MAPE relative to the LLM-only baseline at two of the three hospitals, while achieving comparable performance at the third. Discussion: Our framework uses RAG to improve care price estimation in real-world settings. Compared with the no-RAG baseline, it substantially improved cost estimates for both individual procedures and procedure groups. Improvements were smaller in synthetic simulations, likely because inferring procedures from clinical information is more complex. Practical challenges remain, including heterogeneous PT file formats, unexplained duplicate entries, and limited availability of insurer-negotiated rates. Conclusion: LLMs that effectively integrate PT data show strong potential to provide patients with more accessible and accurate healthcare cost estimates.

title: Dynamic infrared thermography and computed tomography angiography fusion for DIEP flap perforator selection: a novel measurement system

abstract: Accurate perforator selection is critical for successful deep inferior epigastric artery perforator (DIEP) flap breast reconstruction. While computed tomography angiography (CTA) provides high-resolution anatomical detail, it lacks functional perfusion assessment. Dynamic infrared thermography (DIRT), in contrast, captures superficial rewarming dynamics but lacks objective anatomical validation. This study presents a standardized multimodal measurement system enabling automated fusion of DIRT with CTA-derived perforator coordinates. The framework integrates controlled thermographic acquisition, real-time hotspot detection, metric spatial calibration, and global one-to-one assignment of thermal hotspots to CTA perforators within a predefined periumbilical region of interest. The workflow was evaluated in 12 patients. Of 46 CTA perforators within the region of interest, 84.8% were successfully linked to thermographic hotspots, with a median spatial offset of 14.74 mm. Automated assignment excluded 76.1% of detected hotspots due to lack of anatomical correspondence, thereby reducing subjective interpretation. The proposed system enables quantitative multimodal validation of functional and anatomical imaging and provides objective support for perforator selection in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 准确选择穿支血管对于腹壁下深动脉穿支（DIEP）皮瓣乳房重建的成功至关重要。计算机断层扫描血管造影（CTA）可提供高分辨率的解剖细节，但无法评估功能性灌注。相比之下，动态红外热成像（DIRT）可捕捉浅表复温动态，但缺乏客观的解剖学验证。本研究提出一种标准化多模态测量系统，可实现DIRT与源自CTA的穿支血管坐标的自动融合。该框架整合了受控的热成像采集、实时热点检测、公制空间校准，以及在预定义的脐周感兴趣区域内将热点与CTA穿支血管进行全局一对一匹配。该工作流程在12例患者中进行了评估。在感兴趣区域内的46条CTA穿支血管中，84.8%成功与热成像热点相关联，中位空间偏移为14.74 mm。自动匹配因缺乏解剖学对应而排除了76.1%检测到的热点，从而减少了主观解读。所提出的系统可实现功能影像与解剖影像的定量多模态验证，并为临床实践中的穿支血管选择提供客观支持。

abstract: In this work, we study high-dimensional transfer learning with unaligned ordinal responses, allowing different domain-specific regression coefficients, cumulative links and thresholds. We develop the sample-split and full-target algorithms that pool source and target likelihoods and then estimate a target correction. Under suitable conditions, our algorithms achieve minimax-optimal rates for parameter estimation and excess risk. Simulations favor the full-target algorithm over the sample-split algorithm for finite-sample estimation and prediction. An application to a medical dataset further demonstrates the predictive gains of our full-target algorithm over the target-only and pooled baselines when transferring information from the five-category source data to binary hospital mortality.

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] This study examined knowledge, attitudes, comfort, perceived usefulness, and institutional context regarding artificial intelligence (AI) among speech-language pathology (SLP) students and clinicians in Saudi Arabia. This exploratory cross-sectional online survey used a questionnaire informed by Austin et al. and was distributed through snowball sampling. Data from 122 participants (75 students, 16 interns, and 31 practicing clinicians) were analyzed. Groups were compared using Kruskal-Wallis tests with Holm correction and linear regression with HC3-robust standard errors adjusted for gender and frequency of ChatGPT use. The majority (97.5%) of the participants had used ChatGPT, and 77% used it three or more times per week, yet self-rated knowledge was moderate. Comfort with AI was moderate to high, and concern about AI replacing SLPs was low to moderate. The participants were uncertain about AI's ability to administer and analyze assessments and rated administrative tasks as its most useful application. After Holm correction, only perceived usefulness differed across the three group comparisons, with interns rating it higher than students. Across 16 adjusted group comparisons, only perceived student academic use was rated higher by interns than by students. No group differences were significant among participants aged 18-24 years. Most participants (70.5%) reported having no institutional AI guidelines. Participants used AI frequently and held generally positive but cautious views, with few group differences. These findings support AI literacy training in SLP curricula and SLP-specific guidelines for responsible AI use.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] 本研究调查了沙特阿拉伯言语语言病理学（SLP）学生和临床医生对人工智能（AI）的知识、态度、舒适度、感知有用性以及机构环境。这项探索性横断面在线调查采用了参考 Austin 等人的问卷，并通过滚雪球抽样发放。共分析了 122 名参与者的数据（75 名学生、16 名实习生和 31 名在职临床医生）。各组之间采用 Kruskal-Wallis 检验（Holm 校正）以及采用 HC3 稳健标准误的线性回归进行比较，并对性别和 ChatGPT 使用频率进行了调整。大多数参与者（97.5%）使用过 ChatGPT，77% 每周使用三次或以上，但自评知识水平为中等。对 AI 的舒适度为中到高，对 AI 取代 SLP 的担忧为低到中。参与者对 AI 实施和分析评估的能力不确定，并认为行政事务任务是其最有用的应用。经 Holm 校正后，在三组比较中仅感知有用性存在差异，实习生的评分高于学生。在 16 项调整后的组间比较中，仅有感知到的学生学业使用一项，实习生的评分高于学生。在 18–24 岁的参与者中，各组差异均无显著性。大多数参与者（70.5%）报告所在机构没有 AI 指南。参与者频繁使用 AI，总体持积极但谨慎的看法，组间差异很少。这些发现支持在 SLP 课程中开展 AI 素养培训，并制定针对 SLP 的负责任使用 AI 的指南。

title: Large language models in radiology workflows: OpenEvidence dotflows as an accessible, evidence-centered resource.
source: PubMed · Current problems in diagnostic radiology

summary: 介绍 OpenEvidence 的 dotflows 模板在放射科中的应用，如依据 ACR 适宜性标准进行检查方案制定和病例教学，并说明需纠正之处。

abstract: [Current problems in diagnostic radiology] As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into radiology workflows, radiologists need to know which tools add value for which tasks. OpenEvidence (OE) is a literature-grounded clinical LLM platform, free to verified U.S. clinicians, that recently introduced "dotflows," customizable and shareable instruction templates designed to streamline clinical tasks. In this review, we propose that the distinctive value of OE dotflows lies in tasks that depend on retrieval of peer-reviewed literature and guidelines. We illustrate two such applications with examples from our own use, examination protocoling anchored to the American College of Radiology Appropriateness Criteria and case-based clinical teaching, including what worked and what required correction, and briefly address guideline-concordant recommendations in impressions. We distinguish these from tasks that restructure text the radiologist has already supplied, such as converting free dictation into a structured report, drafting an impression from supplied findings, or checking a report for internal inconsistencies, for which dotflows mainly offer the convenience of reusable instructions. We also describe how dotflow instructions can be drafted with a separate general-purpose LLM and outline the steps an institution must take before protected health information can be entered under a business associate agreement. All AI-generated content requires radiologist validation, and future studies should compare dotflow outputs with those of general-purpose LLMs given identical instructions and inputs.
zh_abstract: [Current problems in diagnostic radiology] 随着大语言模型（LLM）日益融入放射科工作流程，放射科医生需要了解哪些工具对哪些任务有价值。OpenEvidence（OE）是一个以文献为基础的临床LLM平台，对经认证的美国临床医生免费，最近推出了“dotflows”，即可自定义、可共享的指令模板，旨在简化临床任务。在本综述中，我们提出OE dotflows的独特价值在于依赖检索同行评审文献和指南的任务。我们结合自身使用经验，举例说明了两种此类应用：以美国放射学院适宜性标准（ACR Appropriateness Criteria）为依据的检查方案制定，以及基于病例的临床教学，包括哪些方面效果良好、哪些方面需要纠正，并简要讨论了在诊断印象中给出符合指南的建议。我们将这些与重构放射科医生已提供文本的任务区分开来，例如将自由口述转换为结构化报告、根据所提供的检查所见起草诊断印象，或检查报告的内部不一致之处；对于这些任务，dotflows主要提供可重复使用指令的便利。我们还介绍了如何借助另一个通用型LLM起草dotflow指令，并概述了机构在依据业务伙伴协议输入受保护的健康信息之前必须采取的步骤。所有AI生成的内容都需要放射科医生验证，未来的研究应在相同指令和输入下，将dotflow的输出与通用型LLM的输出进行比较。

summary: 综述比较欧洲与亚太在房颤流行病学、卒中预防、消融、数字健康与AI心电图及卫生体系六方面的差异。

abstract: [JACC. Asia] Atrial fibrillation affects approximately 60 million people worldwide, and Europe and the Asia-Pacific region together carry most of that burden. This state-of-the-art review compares the 2 regions across 6 domains: epidemiology and risk factors, lifestyle and comorbidity management, stroke prevention, rhythm control and catheter ablation, digital health and artificial intelligence-electrocardiogram, and health system infrastructure and policy. Practice diverges in all 6. European management follows European Society of Cardiology guidelines, whereas Asia-Pacific region care varies across socioeconomic settings and rests on population-scale evidence, with region-wide guidance so far limited to topic-specific Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) consensus statements until the first APHRS guideline was released in 2026. Anticoagulation gaps have narrowed in both regions, yet disparities in financing, electrophysiology capacity, and digital access persist, and differences within each region rival those between them. Closing these gaps requires region-specific, resource-adapted strategies and mutual adoption of evidence generated in each region.
zh_abstract: [JACC. Asia] 心房颤动影响全球约6000万人，欧洲和亚太地区合计承担了其中大部分负担。这篇前沿综述从6个方面比较了这两个地区：流行病学和危险因素、生活方式和合并症管理、卒中预防、节律控制和导管消融、数字健康和人工智能心电图，以及卫生系统基础设施和政策。两地在这6个方面的实践均存在差异。欧洲的管理遵循欧洲心脏病学会指南，而亚太地区的诊疗在不同社会经济环境中存在差异，并依赖人群规模的证据；在2026年发布首部亚太心律学会（APHRS）指南之前，全区域层面的指导仅限于针对特定主题的APHRS共识声明。两个地区的抗凝治疗差距均已缩小，但在资金投入、电生理能力和数字化可及性方面的差异依然存在，且各地区内部的差异不亚于两地区之间的差异。弥合这些差距需要针对不同地区、适应资源条件的策略，以及相互借鉴各自地区产生的证据。
